verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युञ्जयं महादेवं मोक्षप्रदं महेश्वरम् |
अक्षयं शाश्वतं देवं प्रणतोऽस्मि महेश्वरम् ||
verses.transliteration:
mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahādevaṃ mokṣapradaṃ maheśvaram |
akṣayaṃ śāśvataṃ devaṃ praṇato'smi maheśvaram ||
verses.translation: I bow to Maheshvara — the conqueror of death, the great God, the giver of liberation, the imperishable, the eternal.
verses.hindi: मैं मृत्युञ्जय (मृत्यु को जीतने वाले) महादेव को, मोक्षदाता महेश्वर को, अक्षय और शाश्वत देव को प्रणाम करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: Markandeya's prayer encapsulates his story's teaching. He did not pray to escape death — he prayed to the one who has conquered death (Mritunjaya). The difference is decisive: fear of death is not conquered by avoidance or denial but by recognising the deathless consciousness at the heart of existence. His "immortality" is a symbol — whoever recognises the eternal Self is no longer bound by the anxiety of mortality.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय | तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय | असतो मा सद्गमय ||
verses.transliteration: mṛtyormā amṛtaṃ gamaya | tamaso mā jyotirgamaya | asato mā sadgamaya ||
verses.translation: From death lead me to immortality; from darkness lead me to light; from the unreal lead me to the Real.
verses.hindi: मुझे मृत्यु से अमरता की ओर ले चलो; अंधकार से प्रकाश की ओर; असत्य से सत्य की ओर।
verses.commentary: The great prayer from the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad, repeated throughout the Markandeya Purana in the context of Markandeya's story. The three movements — from death to immortality, from darkness to light, from unreal to Real — are not three separate requests but one request with three faces. Each points to the same transition: from the contracted, fearful, identified ego to the open, luminous, deathless awareness that is our true nature.

verses.sanskrit: या देवी सर्वभूतेषु मातृरूपेण संस्थिता | नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ||
verses.transliteration: yā devī sarvabhūteṣu mātṛrūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of Mother — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
verses.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में माता के रूप में स्थित हैं — उन्हें नमस्कार, नमस्कार, नमस्कार, बार-बार नमस्कार।
verses.commentary: From the Devi Mahatmyam in the Markandeya Purana: the Goddess is not distant but present in every being as Mother. This is the repeated refrain that appears for each form of the Goddess — Shakti, Buddhi, Nidra, Kshudha, Chhaya, Trishna, Kshanti, and Matri. The Mother form is perhaps the most accessible: everyone has experienced being held, nourished, and sustained. To recognise the divine as Mother is to recognise that the universe is not hostile or indifferent but fundamentally nurturing.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गे स्मृता हरिदुर्गे दुर्गादेवी सर्वशः | दुर्गोत्तिरित्यभिध्याते दुर्गापादान सर्वदा ||
verses.transliteration: durge smṛtā haridurge durgādevī sarvaśaḥ | durgottirityabhidhyāte durgāpādāna sarvadā ||
verses.translation: Remembered in difficulties, the Goddess is called Durga — she who is difficult to cross over. She is the refuge in all difficulties, always accessible.
verses.hindi: कष्ट में याद की जाती हैं, देवी को दुर्गा कहा जाता है — जिसे पार करना कठिन है। वह सभी कष्टों में शरण हैं, सदैव पहुँच से बाहर।
verses.commentary: The Markandeya Purana explains the name "Durga" — she who is difficult to cross over, like a fortress. The paradox: she is the refuge in difficulties, yet she herself is the difficulty to cross over. This means that the Devi is both the obstacle and the means of crossing it. The ego is the obstacle; the Devi as consciousness is the means of transcending the ego. Remembering her in difficulties is the practice of recognising the consciousness that witnesses the difficulty.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डी चण्डिता चैव चण्डमुण्डविनाशिनी | चण्डिका परमेशानी चण्डी चण्डात्मिका शुभा ||
verses.transliteration: caṇḍī caṇḍitā caiva caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī | caṇḍikā parameśānī caṇḍī caṇḍātmikā śubhā ||
verses.translation: Chandi, Chandita, the destroyer of Chanda-Munda — Chandika, the supreme goddess, Chandi, the embodiment of fierce power, the auspicious one.
verses.hindi: चण्डी, चण्डिता, चण्ड-मुण्ड की विनाशिनी — चण्डिका, परमेश्वरी, चण्डी, उग्र शक्ति की अवतारी, शुभा।
verses.commentary: The Markandeya Purana describes the Devi as Chandi — the fierce one who destroys the demons Chanda and Munda. The names accumulate: Chandita (fierce), Chandika (little fierce one), the supreme goddess, the embodiment of fierce power, the auspicious one. The paradox: she is both fierce and auspicious. Her fierceness is not cruelty but the power to destroy what obstructs the good. Her auspiciousness is the good that emerges when obstruction is removed.
verses.wordMeaning: The Markandeya Purana describes the Devi as Chandi — the fierce one who destroys the demons Chanda and Munda. verses.sanskrit:
यस्मिन् देशे न विद्वांसो न वैश्याः न च पार्थिवाः |
न नदी न गुरुर्नार्यस्तत्र वासो न कारयेत् ||
verses.transliteration:
yasmin deśe na vidvāṃso na vaiśyāḥ na ca pārthivāḥ |
na nadī na gururmāryastatrā vāso na kārayet ||
verses.translation: One should not make one's home in a place that has no learned people, no merchants, no governance, no river, and no wise teachers.
verses.hindi: जिस देश में विद्वान न हों, व्यापारी न हों, शासन न हो, नदी न हो, और गुरु न हो — वहाँ निवास नहीं करना चाहिए।
verses.commentary: The Markandeya Purana identifies five essential elements for a genuinely liveable community: intellectual life (vidvans), economic vitality (vaishyas), governance and order (parthivas), access to natural resources/clean water (nadi), and mentorship and wisdom transmission (guru). This is ancient urban planning philosophy at its most practical. All five must be present for genuine human flourishing.
verses.wordMeaning: The Markandeya Purana identifies five essential elements for a genuinely liveable community: intellectual life (vidvans), economic vitality (vaishyas), governance and order (parthivas), access to natural resources/clean water (nadi), and mentorship and wisdom transmission (guru). verses.sanskrit: आत्मनः प्रतिकूलानि परेषां न समाचरेत् | एष धर्मः समासेन सर्वेषां गुह्यमुत्तमम् ||
verses.transliteration: ātmanaḥ pratikūlāni pareṣāṃ na samācaret | eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena sarveṣāṃ guhyamuttamam ||
verses.translation: Do not do to others what is disagreeable to yourself. This, in brief, is dharma — the supreme secret for all.
verses.hindi: जो अपने लिए प्रतिकूल (अप्रिय) लगे, वह दूसरों के प्रति भी न करो। यही संक्षेप में धर्म है — सबके लिए परम रहस्य।
verses.commentary: The Markandeya Purana's distillation of dharmic community into a single principle: the Golden Rule. Across every major civilisation — Confucian, Stoic, Jewish, Christian, Islamic, Hindu — this same principle appears as the core of ethical life. The Markandeya Purana calls it "guhyam uttamam" — the supreme secret. The secret is not esoteric; it is hidden in plain sight, known to all, practiced by few.

verses.sanskrit: महामाया हरेश्चैषा तया सम्मोह्यते जगत् | ज्ञानिनामपि चेतांसि देवी भगवती हि सा ||
verses.transliteration: mahāmāyā hareścaiṣā tayā sammohyate jagat | jñānināmapi cetāṃsi devī bhagavatī hi sā ||
verses.translation: This is the Mahamaya of Hari — she bewilders the world. Even the minds of the wise are drawn by force into delusion — for she is Bhagavati, the Goddess.
verses.hindi: यह हरि की महामाया है, जिससे सम्पूर्ण संसार मोहित हो जाता है। ज्ञानियों का भी चित्त उसके द्वारा बलपूर्वक खींच लिया जाता है — क्योंकि वह स्वयं भगवती देवी ही है।
verses.commentary: Sage Medhas's opening teaching to the king and the merchant. Their suffering — being betrayed by family and clinging to those who hurt them — is not unique. It is Mahamaya. Even the wise are not exempt; the cosmic delusion does not bypass intelligence. The Devi is not the cause of cruelty but of the bewilderment by which we cling to what hurts us. To recognise her power is the first step toward freedom from it.

verses.sanskrit: या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता | नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ||
verses.transliteration: yā devī sarvabhūteṣu śaktirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of Shakti — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
verses.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में शक्ति के रूप में स्थित हैं — उन्हें नमस्कार, नमस्कार, नमस्कार, बार-बार नमस्कार।
verses.commentary: The Devi Mahatmyam's great refrain — repeated for each form of the Goddess across all beings: Shakti (power), Buddhi (intelligence), Nidra (sleep), Kshudha (hunger), Chhaya (shadow), Trishna (thirst), Kshanti (forgiveness). The Goddess is not a figure in a distant heaven; she is the living force within every being, expressed as every quality of existence. To bow to the Devi is to bow to the power of life itself — in all its forms, including the difficult ones.

The names accumulate: Chandita (fierce), Chandika (little fierce one), the supreme goddess, the embodiment of fierce power, the auspicious one. The paradox: she is both fierce and auspicious. Her fierceness is not cruelty but the power to destroy what obstructs the good. Her auspiciousness is the good that emerges when obstruction is removed.
verses.wordMeaning: The Markandeya Purana describes the Devi as Chandi — the fierce one who destroys the demons Chanda and Munda. The names accumulate: Chandita (fierce), Chandika (little fierce one), the supreme goddess, the embodiment of fierce power, the auspicious one. The paradox: she is both fierce and auspicious. Her fierceness is not cruelty but the power to destroy what obstructs the good. Her auspiciousness is the good that emerges when obstruction is removed.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यृषेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा मार्कण्डेयस्य जैमिनिः । जगाम विन्ध्यशिखरं यत्र ते धर्मपक्षिणः

verses.sanskrit: स्थानसौष्ठवसम्पन्नं जितश्वासमविश्रमम् । विस्पष्टमपदोषञ्च पठ्यते द्विजसत्तमैः

verses.wordMeaning: dvijas standing on a ledge of the rock. Looking at them as they were reading, their faces free from blemish, he then addressed them all, with mingled sorrow and joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: dvijas standing on a ledge of the rock. Looking at them as they were reading, their faces free from blemish, he then addressed them all, with mingled sorrow and joy.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते जैमिनिं सर्वे पाद्यार्घ्याभ्यामपूजयन् । अनामयञ्च पप्रच्छुः प्रणिपत्य महामुनिम्

verses.sanskrit: अथोचुः खगमाः सर्वे व्यासशिष्यं तपोनिधिम् । सुखोपविष्टं विश्रान्तं पक्षानिलहतक्लमम्
verses.transliteration: athocuḥ khagamāḥ sarve vyāsaśiṣyaṃ taponidhim / sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ pakṣānilahataklamam
verses.translation: questioned him with deep respect. Then all the birds address- ed him, the disciple of Vyasa, rich in austerities, as he sat at ease, resting himself, with his fatigue mitigated by the breeze from their wings.
verses.hindi: जैमिनि बोले--पक्षियो! आपलोगोंका अन्तःकरण निर्मल है। महाभारतमें मेरे लिये जो सन्दिग्ध बातें हैं, उन्हें बताता हूँ; सुनिये और सुनकर उनकी व्याख्या कीजिये। सर्वव्यापी भगवान् जनार्दन सम्पूर्ण जगत्के आधार, समस्त कारणोंके भी कारण और निर्गुण होते हुए भी मनुष्य-शरीरको कैसे प्राप्त हुए?
verses.wordMeaning: questioned him with deep respect. Then all the birds address- ed him, the disciple of Vyasa, rich in austerities, as he sat at ease, resting himself, with his fatigue mitigated by the breeze from their wings.
verses.commentary: Sense: questioned him with deep respect. Then all the birds address- ed him, the disciple of Vyasa, rich in austerities, as he sat at ease, resting himself, with his fatigue mitigated by the breeze from their wings.

verses.transliteration: pitṛkopāgnirudbhūto yo no deheṣu vartate / so 'dya śāntiṃ gato vipra yuṣmaddarśanavāriṇā

verses.transliteration: kaccit te kuśalaṃ brahmannāśrame mṛgapakṣiṣu / vṛkṣeṣvatha latā-gulma-tvaksāra-tṛṇajātiṣu

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादञ्च कुरुष्वात्र ब्रूह्यागमनकारणम् । देवानामिव संसर्गो भवतो ऽभ्युदयो महान् । केनास्मद्भाग्यगुरुण आनीतो दृष्टिगोचरम्

verses.transliteration: eteṣu gocaro 'smākaṃ buddherbrāhmaṇasattama / pratijñāntu samāroḍhuṃ tathāpi nahi śaknumaḥ
verses.translation: in these does our intellect range, 0 best of brahmans; but
verses.hindi: आदि और भी बहुत-से अवतार हैं, जिनकी गणना करनेमें हम असमर्थ हैं। इस समय भगवानने मथुरामें श्रीकृष्णरूपमें अवतार लिया है। इस तरह भगवान्की वह सात््विकी मूर्ति ही भिन्न-भिन्न अवतार धारण करती है। यह आपके पहले प्रश्नका उत्तर बतलाया गया कि भगवान् पूर्णकाम होते हुए भी धर्म आदिकी
verses.wordMeaning: in these does our intellect range, 0 best of brahmans; but
verses.commentary: Sense: in these does our intellect range, 0 best of brahmans; but

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वदस्व विश्रब्धं सन्दिग्धं यद्वि भारते । वक्ष्यामस्तव धर्मज्ञ न चेन्मोहो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmādvadasva viśrabdhaṃ sandigdhaṃ yadvi bhārate / vakṣyāmastava dharmajña na cenmoho bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: nevertheless we are not able to give a promise. Therefore declare fearlessly what is doubtful in the Mahabhdrata; we will declare it to thee, 0 thou who art wise in the law; if not there will be bewilderment."
verses.hindi: रक्षाके लिये सदा स्वेच्छासे ही अवतीर्ण होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: nevertheless we are not able to give a promise. Therefore declare fearlessly what is doubtful in the Mahabhdrata; we will declare it to thee, 0 thou who art wise in the law; if not there will be bewilderment."
verses.commentary: Sense: nevertheless we are not able to give a promise. Therefore declare fearlessly what is doubtful in the Mahabhdrata; we will declare it to thee, 0 thou who art wise in the law; if not there will be bewilderment."

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच सन्दिग्धानीह वस्तूनि भारतं प्रति यानि मे । शृणुध्वममलास्तानि श्रुत्वा व्याख्यातुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca sandigdhānīha vastūni bhārataṃ prati yāni me / śṛṇudhvamamalāstāni śrutvā vyākhyātumarhatha
verses.translation: " Hear, 0 ye pure ones! the matters in connexion with the Mahabhdrata, which are doubtful to me here; having heard,
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मन! पूर्वकालमें त्वष्टा प्रजापतिके पुत्र विश्वरूप इन्द्रके हाथसे मारे गये थे, इसलिये ब्रह्महत्याने इन्द्रको धर दबाया। इससे उनके तेजकी बड़ी क्षति हुई। इस अन्यायके कारण इन्द्रका तेज धर्मराजके शरीरमें प्रवेश कर गया, अतः इन्द्र निस्तेज हो गये। तदनन्तर अपने पुत्रके मारे जानेका समाचार सुनकर त्वष्टा
verses.wordMeaning: " Hear, 0 ye pure ones! the matters in connexion with the Mahabhdrata, which are doubtful to me here; having heard,
verses.commentary: Sense: " Hear, 0 ye pure ones! the matters in connexion with the Mahabhdrata, which are doubtful to me here; having heard,

verses.sanskrit: कस्मान्मानुषतां प्राप्तो निर्गुणो ऽपि जनार्दनः । वासुदेवो ऽखिलाधारः सर्वकारणकारणम्
verses.transliteration: kasmānmānuṣatāṃ prāpto nirguṇo 'pi janārdanaḥ / vāsudevo 'khilādhāraḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam
verses.translation: deign to explain them. Why is Jandrdana Vdsudeva, who is
verses.hindi: प्रजापतिको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ। उन्होंने अपने मस्तकसे एक जटा उखाड़कर सबको सुनाते हुए यह बात कही--“आज देवताओंसहित तीनों लोक मेरे पराक्रमको देखें। वह खोटी बुद्धिवाला ब्रह्मघाती इन्द्र भी मेरी शक्तिका साक्षात्कार कर ले; क्योंकि उस दुष्टने अपने ब्राह्मणोचित कर्ममें लगे हुए मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: deign to explain them. Why is Jandrdana Vdsudeva, who is
verses.commentary: Sense: deign to explain them. Why is Jandrdana Vdsudeva, who is

verses.sanskrit: कस्माच्च पाण्डुपुत्राणामेका सा द्रुपदात्मजा । पञ्चानां महिषी कृष्णा सुमाहनत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: kasmācca pāṇḍuputrāṇāmekā sā drupadātmajā / pañcānāṃ mahiṣī kṛṣṇā sumāhanatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: though devoid of qualities, endued with humanity? And why was Drupada’s daughter Krishna the common wife of- the five sons of Pandu? On this point there is very great perplexity.
verses.hindi: पुत्रका वध किया है।” यों कहकर क्रोधसे लाल आँखें किये प्रजापतिने वह जटा अग्निमें होम दी। फिर तो उस होमकुण्डसे वृत्र नामक महान् असुर प्रकट हुआ, जिसके शरीरसे सब ओर आगकी लपटें निकल रही थीं। विशाल देह, बड़ी-बड़ी दाढ़ें और कटे-छँटे कोयलेके ढेरकी भाँति शरीरका रंग था। उस महान् असुर
verses.wordMeaning: though devoid of qualities, endued with humanity? And why was Drupada’s daughter Krishna the common wife of- the five sons of Pandu? On this point there is very great perplexity.
verses.commentary: Sense: though devoid of qualities, endued with humanity? And why was Drupada’s daughter Krishna the common wife of- the five sons of Pandu? On this point there is very great perplexity.

verses.sanskrit: भेषजं ब्रह्महत्याया बलदेवो महाबलः । तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन कस्माच्चक्रे हलायुधः
verses.transliteration: bheṣajaṃ brahmahatyāyā baladevo mahābalaḥ / tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena kasmāccakre halāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: Why did the mighty Baladeva Haldyudha expiate his brah-
verses.hindi: वृत्रासुरको अपने वधके लिये उत्पन्न देख इन्द्र भयसे व्याकुल हो उठे। उन्होंने सन्धिकी इच्छासे सप्तर्षियोंको उसके पास भेजा। सम्पूर्ण भूतोंके हितसाधनमें संलग्न रहनेवाले वे महर्षि बड़ी प्रसन्नताके साथ गये और उन्होंने कुछ शर्तोंके साथ इन्द्र और वृत्रासुरमें मित्रता करा दी। इन्द्रने सन्धिकी शर्तोंका उल्लड्घन
verses.wordMeaning: Why did the mighty Baladeva Haldyudha expiate his brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: Why did the mighty Baladeva Haldyudha expiate his brah-

verses.sanskrit: कथं च द्रौपदेयास्ते ऽकृतदारा महारथाः । पाण्डुनाथा महात्मानो वधमापुरनाथवत्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca draupadeyāste 'kṛtadārā mahārathāḥ / pāṇḍunāthā mahātmāno vadhamāpuranāthavat
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: करके जब वृत्रासुरको मार डाला, तब पुनः उनपर ब्रह्महत्याका आक्रमण हुआ। उस समय उनका सारा बल नष्ट हो गया। इन्द्रके शरीरसे निकला हुआ बल वायुदेवतामें समा गया। तदनन्तर जब इन्द्रने गौतमका रूप धारण करके उनकी पत्नी अहल्याके सतीत्वका नाश किया, उस समय उनका रूप भी नष्ट हो गया।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं कथ्यतां मे सन्दिग्धं भारतं प्रति । कृतार्थोहं सुखं येन गच्छेयं निजमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ kathyatāṃ me sandigdhaṃ bhārataṃ prati / kṛtārthohaṃ sukhaṃ yena gaccheyaṃ nijamāśramam
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: उनके अड्ज-प्रत्यड्रका लावण्य, जो बड़ा ही मनोरम था, व्यभिचार-दोषसे दूषित देवराज इन्द्रको छोड़कर दोनों अश्विनीकुमारोंके पास चला गया। इस प्रकार इन्द्र अपने धर्म, तेज, बल और रूपसे वज्चित हो गये। यह जानकर हैत्योंने उन्हें जीतनेका उद्योग आरम्भ किया।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिण ऊचुः नमस्कृत्य सुरेशाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे । पुरुषायाप्रमेयाय शाश्वतायाव्ययाय च
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ namaskṛtya sureśāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave / puruṣāyāprameyāya śāśvatāyāvyayāya ca
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: महामुने! उन दिनों पृथ्वीपर जो अधिक पराक्रमी राजा थे, उन्हींके कुलोंमें देवराजको जीतनेकी इच्छा रखनेवाले अत्यन्त बलशाली हैत्य उत्पन्न हुए। कुछ कालके अनन्तर यह पृथ्वी पापके भारी भारसे पीड़ित हो मेरुपर्वतके शिखरपर, जहाँ देवताओंकी दिव्य सभा है, गयी। वहाँ पहुँचकर उसने दानवों और हैत्योंसे
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्व्यूहात्मने तस्मै त्रिगुणायागुणाय च । वरिष्ठाय गरिष्ठाय वरेष्यायामृताय च
verses.transliteration: caturvyūhātmane tasmai triguṇāyāguṇāya ca / variṣṭhāya gariṣṭhāya vareṣyāyāmṛtāya ca
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: होनेवाले अपने खेदका कारण बतलाया। वह बोली--'देवताओ! आपने पूर्वकालमें जिन महापराक्रमी असुरोंका वध किया है, वे सब इस समय मनुष्यलोकमें जाकर राजाओंके घरमें उत्पन्न हुए हैं। ऐसे हैत्योंकी अनेक अक्षौहिणी सेनाएँ हैं। मैं उनके भारसे पीड़ित होकर नीचेकी ओर धँसी जाती हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादणुतरं नास्ति यस्मान्नास्ति बृहत्तरम् । येन विश्वमिदं व्याप्तमजेन जगदादिना
verses.transliteration: yasmādaṇutaraṃ nāsti yasmānnāsti bṛhattaram / yena viśvamidaṃ vyāptamajena jagadādinā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: आपलोग ऐसा कोई उपाय करें, जिससे मुझे शान्ति मिले।'
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: आविर्भाव-तिरोभाव-दृष्टादृष्ट-विलक्षणम् । वदन्ति यद् सृष्टमिदं तथैवान्ते च संहृतम्
verses.transliteration: āvirbhāva-tirobhāva-dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa-vilakṣaṇam / vadanti yad sṛṣṭamidaṃ tathaivānte ca saṃhṛtam
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: पक्षी कहते हैं--पृथ्वीके यों कहनेपर सम्पूर्ण देवता अपने-अपने तेजके अंशसे पृथ्वीपर अवतार लेने लगे। उनके अवतारके दो ही उद्देश्य थे-- प्रजाजनोंका उपकार और पृथ्वीके भारका अपहरण। इन्द्रके शरीरसे जो तेज प्राप्त हुआ था, उसे स्वयं धर्मराजने कुन्तीके गर्भमें स्थापित किया। उसीसे
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणे चादिदेवाय नमस्कृत्य समाधिना । ऋक्सामान्युद्गिरन् वक्त्रैर्यः पुनाति जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇe cādidevāya namaskṛtya samādhinā / ṛksāmānyudgiran vaktrairyaḥ punāti jagattrayam
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: महातेजस्वी राजा युधिष्ठिरका जन्म हुआ। फिर वायु देवताने इन्द्रके ही बलको कुन्तीके उदरमें स्थापित किया। उससे भीम उत्पन्न हुए। इन्द्रके आधे अंशसे
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य तथेशानमेकबाणविनिर्जितैः । यस्यासुरगणैर्यज्ञा विलुप्यन्ते न यज्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: praṇipatya tatheśānamekabāṇavinirjitaiḥ / yasyāsuragaṇairyajñā vilupyante na yajvinām
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: अर्जुनका जन्म हुआ। इसी प्रकार इन्द्रका ही सुन्दर रूप अभश्विनीकुमारोंद्वारा माद्रीके गर्भमें स्थापित किया गया था, जिससे अत्यन्त कान्तिमान् नकुल और सहदेव उत्पन्न हुए। इस प्रकार देवराज इन्द्र पाँच रूपोंमें अवतीर्ण हुए। उनकी पत्नी शची ही महाभागा कृष्णाके रूपमें अग्निसे प्रकट हुईं। अतः कृष्णा
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: प्रवक्ष्यामो मतं कृत्स्नं व्यासस्याद्भुतकर्मणः । येन भारतमुद्दिश्य धर्माद्याः प्रकटीकृताः
verses.transliteration: pravakṣyāmo mataṃ kṛtsnaṃ vyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ / yena bhāratamuddiśya dharmādyāḥ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: एकमात्र इन्द्रकी ही पत्नी थी और किसीकी नहीं। योगीश्वर भी अनेक शरीर धारण कर लेते हैं। फिर इन्द्र तो देवता हैं, उनके पाँच शरीर धारण कर लेनेमें क्या सन्देह है। इस प्रकार पाँच पाण्डवोंकी जो एक पत्नी हुई, उसका रहस्य
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः । अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ / ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: स देवो भगवान् सर्वं व्याप्य नारायणो विभुः । चतुर्धा संस्थितो ब्रह्मन् सगुणो निर्गुणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sa devo bhagavān sarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ / caturdhā saṃsthito brahman saguṇo nirguṇastathā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: राजा हरिश्रुन्द्रका चरित्र
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: एका मूर्तिरनिर्देश्या शुक्लां पश्यन्ति तां बुधाः । ज्वालामालोपरुद्धाङ्गी निष्ठा सा योगिनां परा
verses.transliteration: ekā mūrtiranirdeśyā śuklāṃ paśyanti tāṃ budhāḥ / jvālāmāloparuddhāṅgī niṣṭhā sā yogināṃ parā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: पक्षी कहते हैं--पहलेकी बात है, त्रेतायुगमें हरिश्वन्द्र नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक राजर्षि रहते थे। वे बड़े धर्मात्मा, भूमण्डलके पालक, सुन्दर कीर्तिसे युक्त और सब प्रकारसे श्रेष्ठ थे। उनके राज्यकालमें कभी अकाल नहीं पड़ा, किसीको रोग नहीं हुआ, मनुष्योंकी अकालमृत्यु नहीं हुई और पुरवासियोंकी कभी अधर्ममें
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: दूरस्था चान्तिकस्था च विज्ञेया सा गुणातिगा । वासुदेवाभिधानासौ निर्ममत्वेन दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: dūrasthā cāntikasthā ca vijñeyā sā guṇātigā / vāsudevābhidhānāsau nirmamatvena dṛśyate
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: रुचि नहीं हुई। उस समय प्रजावर्गके लोग धन, वीर्य और तपस्याके मदसे उन्मत्त नहीं होते थे। कोई भी स्त्री ऐसी नहीं देखी जाती थी, जो पूर्ण यौवनावस्थाको प्राप्त किये बिना ही सन्‍्तानको जन्म देती रही हो। एक दिन महाबाहु राजा हरिश्वन्द्र जंगलमें शिकार खेलने गये थे। वहाँ शिकारके पीछे दौड़ते हुए उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: रूपवर्णादयस्तस्या न भावाः कल्पनामयाः । अस्त्येव सा सदा शुद्धा सुप्रतिष्ठैकरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: rūpavarṇādayastasyā na bhāvāḥ kalpanāmayāḥ / astyeva sā sadā śuddhā supratiṣṭhaikarūpiṇī
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: बारंबार कुछ स्त्रियोंकी कातरवाणी सुनी। वे कह रही थीं, “हमें बचाओ, बचाओ।' राजाने शिकारका पीछा छोड़ दिया और उन स्ट्रियोंको लक्ष्य करके कहा--'डरो मत, डरो मत। कौन ऐसा दुष्टबुद्धिवाला पुरुष है जो मेरे शासनकालमें भी ऐसा अन्याय करता है?” यों कहकर स्त्रियोंके रोनेके शब्दका
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीया पृथिवीं मूद्र्घ्ना शेषाख्या धारयत्यधः । तामसी सा समाख्याता तिर्यक्त्वं समुपाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: dvitīyā pṛthivīṃ mūdrghnā śeṣākhyā dhārayatyadhaḥ / tāmasī sā samākhyātā tiryaktvaṃ samupāśritā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: अनुसरण करते हुए राजा उसी ओर चल दिये। इसी बीचमें प्रत्येक कार्यके आरम्भमें बाधा उपस्थित करनेवाला रुद्रकुमार विध्नराज इस प्रकार सोचने लगा --'ये महर्षि विश्वामित्र बड़े पराक्रमी हैं और अनृपम तपस्याका आश्रय लेकर उत्तम व्रतका पालन करते हुए उन भवादि विद्याओंका साधन करते हैं, जो पहले
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: तृतीया कर्म कुरुते प्रजापालनतत्परा । सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता तु सा ज्ञेया धर्मसंस्थानकारिणी
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyā karma kurute prajāpālanatatparā / sattvodriktā tu sā jñeyā dharmasaṃsthānakāriṇī
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: इन्हें सिद्ध नहीं हो सकी हैं। ये महर्षि क्षमा, मौन तथा आत्मसंयमपूर्वक जिन विद्याओंका साधन करते है, वे उनके भयसे पीड़ित होकर यहाँ विलाप कर रही हैं। इनके उद्धारका कार्य मुझे किस प्रकार करना चाहिए?” इस प्रकार विचार करते हुए रुद्रकुमार विघ्नराजने राजाके शरीरमें प्रवेश किया। उनके आवेशसे
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थो जलमध्यस्था शेते पन्नगतल्पगा । रजस्तस्या गुणः सर्गं सा करोति सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: caturtho jalamadhyasthā śete pannagatalpagā / rajastasyā guṇaḥ sargaṃ sā karoti sadaiva hi
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: युक्त होनेपर राजाने क्रोधपूर्वक ये बात कही--“यह कौन पापाचारी मनुष्य है, जो कपड़ेकी गठरीमें अग्निको बाँध रहा है? बल और प्रचण्ड तेजसे उद्दीप्त मुझ राजाके उपस्थित रहते हुए आज कौन ऐसा पापी है, जो मेरे धनुषसे छूटकर सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंको देदीप्यमान करनेवाले बाणोंसे सर्वाड़में छिन्न-भिन्न होकर
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: या तृतीया हरेर्मूर्तिः प्रजापालनतत्परा । सा तु धर्मव्यवस्थानं करोति नियतं भुवि
verses.transliteration: yā tṛtīyā harermūrtiḥ prajāpālanatatparā / sā tu dharmavyavasthānaṃ karoti niyataṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: कभी न टूटनेवाली निद्रामें प्रवेश करना चाहता है?!
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: प्रोद्धूतानसुरान् हन्ति धर्मविच्छित्तिकारिणः । पाति देवान् सतश्चान्यान् धर्मरक्षापरायणान्
verses.transliteration: proddhūtānasurān hanti dharmavicchittikāriṇaḥ / pāti devān sataścānyān dharmarakṣāparāyaṇān
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: राजाकी यह बात सुनकर तपस्वी विश्वामित्र कुपित हो उठे। उनके मनमें क्रोधका उदय होते ही वे सम्पूर्ण विद्याएँ, जो स्त्रियोंके रूपमें रो रही थीं, क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। तदनन्तर राजाने उन तपस्याके भण्डार महर्षि विश्वामित्रकी ओर दृष्टिपात किया तो वे बड़े भयभीत हुए और सहसा पीपलके
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति जैमिने । अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati jaimine / abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjatyasau
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: पत्तेकी भाँति थरथर काँपने लगे। इतनेमें विश्वामित्र बोल उठे--“ओ दुरात्मा! खड़ा तो रह।” तब राजाने विनयपूर्वक मुनिके चरणोंमें प्रणाम किया और कहा
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा पुरा वराहेण तुण्डेनापो निरस्य च । एकया दंष्ट्रयोत्खाता नलिनीव वसुन्धरा
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā purā varāheṇa tuṇḍenāpo nirasya ca / ekayā daṃṣṭrayotkhātā nalinīva vasundharā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: --“भगवन्! यह मेरा धर्म था। प्रभो! इसे आप मेरा अपराध न मानें। मुने! अपने धर्मकी रक्षामें लगे हुए मुझ राजापर आपको क्रोध नहीं करना चाहिए। धर्मज्ञ राजाको तो यह उचित ही है कि वह धर्मशास्त्रके अनुसार दान दे, रक्षा करे और धनुष उठाकर युद्ध करे।'
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा नृसिंहरूपञ्च हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः । विप्रचित्तिमुखाश्चान्ये दानवा विनिपातिताः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā nṛsiṃharūpañca hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ / vipracittimukhāścānye dānavā vinipātitāḥ
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्र बोले--'राजन! यदि तुम्हें अधर्मका डर है, तो शीघ्र बताओ-- किसको दान देना चाहिए? किनकी रक्षा करनी चाहिए और किनके साथ युद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: वामनादींस्तथैवान्यान् न संख्यातुमिहोत्सहे । अवताराश्च तस्येह माथुरः साम्प्रतं त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: vāmanādīṃstathaivānyān na saṃkhyātumihotsahe / avatārāśca tasyeha māthuraḥ sāmprataṃ tvayam
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: हरिश्रन्द्रने कहा--श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मगोंको तथा जिनकी जीविका नष्ट हो गयी हो, ऐसा अन्य मनुष्योंको भी दान देना चाहिए। भयभीत प्राणियोंकी रक्षा करनी चाहिए और शत्रुओंके साथ सदा युद्ध करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: इति सा सात्त्विकी मूर्तिरवतारान् करोति वै । प्रद्युम्नेति च सा ख्याता रक्षाकर्मण्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: iti sā sāttvikī mūrtiravatārān karoti vai / pradyumneti ca sā khyātā rakṣākarmaṇyavasthitā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्र बोले--यदि तुम राजा हो और राज-धर्मको भलीभाँति जानते हो तो मैं प्रतिग्रहकी इच्छा रखनेवाला ब्राह्मण हूँ, मुझे इच्छानुसार दक्षिणा दो।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वे ऽथ मनुष्यत्वे तिर्यग्योनौ च संस्थिता । गृह्णाति तत्स्वभावं च वासुदेवेच्छया सदा
verses.transliteration: devatve 'tha manuṣyatve tiryagyonau ca saṃsthitā / gṛhṇāti tatsvabhāvaṃ ca vāsudevecchayā sadā
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: पक्षीगण कहते हैं--महर्षिकी यह बात सुनकर राजाने अपना नया जन्म हुआ माना और प्रसन्नचित्तसे कहा।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत् ते समाख्यातं कृतकृत्यो ऽपि यत्प्रभुः । मानुषत्वं गतो विष्णुः शृणुष्वास्योत्तरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: ityetat te samākhyātaṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'pi yatprabhuḥ / mānuṣatvaṃ gato viṣṇuḥ śṛṇuṣvāsyottaraṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.hindi: हरिश्रन्द्र बोले--भगवन्! आपको मैं क्या दूँ, आप निःशड़क होकर कहिये। यदि कोई दुर्लभ-से-दुर्लभ वस्तु हो तो उसे भी दी हुई ही समझें।
verses.wordMeaning: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that
verses.commentary: Sense: fnanicide by engaging in a pilgrimage? And how was it that

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे चतुर्व्यूहावतारो नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः पक्षिण ऊचुः त्वष्टृपुत्रे हते पूर्वं ब्रह्मन्निन्द्रस्य तेजसः । ब्रह्महत्याभिभूतस्य परा हानिरजायत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe caturvyūhāvatāro nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ tvaṣṭṛputre hate pūrvaṃ brahmannindrasya tejasaḥ / brahmahatyābhibhūtasya parā hānirajāyata
verses.translation: "Of old, 0 brahman! when the son of Tvash^fi was slain,
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रने कहा--वीरवर! तुम समुद्र, पर्वत, ग्राम और नगरोंसहित यह सारी पृथ्वी मुझे दे दो। रथ, घोड़े, हाथी, कोठार और खजानेसहित सारा राज्य भी मुझे समर्पित कर दो। इसके अतिरिक्त भी जो कुछ तुम्हारे पास है, वह मुझे दे दो। केवल अपनी स्त्री, पुत्र और शरीरको अपने पास रख लो। साथ ही अपने
verses.wordMeaning: "Of old, 0 brahman! when the son of Tvash^fi was slain,
verses.commentary: Sense: "Of old, 0 brahman! when the son of Tvash^fi was slain,

verses.sanskrit: तद्धमं प्रविवेशाथ शाक्रतेजो ऽपचारतः । निस्तेजाश्चाभवच्छक्रो धर्मे तेजसि निर्गते
verses.transliteration: taddhamaṃ praviveśātha śākratejo 'pacārataḥ / nistejāścābhavacchakro dharme tejasi nirgate
verses.translation: Let all these doubtful points in connexion with the Mahd- bharata be explained to me; that I having attained my object, may return to my hermitage in comfort."
verses.hindi: धर्मको भी तुम्हीं रखो; क्योंकि वह सदा कर्ताके ही साथ रहता है, परलोकमें जानेपर भी वह साथ जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Let all these doubtful points in connexion with the Mahd- bharata be explained to me; that I having attained my object, may return to my hermitage in comfort."
verses.commentary: Sense: Let all these doubtful points in connexion with the Mahd- bharata be explained to me; that I having attained my object, may return to my hermitage in comfort."

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुत्रं हतं श्रुत्वा त्वष्टा क्रुद्धः प्रजापतिः । अवलुञ्च्य जटामेकामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ putraṃ hataṃ śrutvā tvaṣṭā kruddhaḥ prajāpatiḥ / avaluñcya jaṭāmekāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: and the changeless; to him who subsists in four forms,- possessed of the three qualities, and devoid of qualities, the most choice,
verses.hindi: मुनिका यह वचन सुनकर राजाने प्रसन्नचितसे “तथास्तु” कहा। हाथ जोड़कर उनकी आज्ञा स्वीकार की। उस समय उनके मुखपर शोक या चिन्ताका कोई चिह्न नहीं था।
verses.wordMeaning: and the changeless; to him who subsists in four forms,- possessed of the three qualities, and devoid of qualities, the most choice,
verses.commentary: Sense: and the changeless; to him who subsists in four forms,- possessed of the three qualities, and devoid of qualities, the most choice,

verses.sanskrit: अद्य पश्यन्तु मे वीर्यं त्रयो लोकाः सदेवताः । स च पश्यतु दुर्बुद्धिर्ब्रह्महा पाकशासनः
verses.transliteration: adya paśyantu me vīryaṃ trayo lokāḥ sadevatāḥ / sa ca paśyatu durbuddhirbrahmahā pākaśāsanaḥ
verses.translation: the most venerable, the most excellent, and the immortal; to him than whom there is nothing more minute, than whom there is nothing more immense, by whom— the unborn one, the begin-
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्र बोले--राजर्षे! यदि तुमने अपना राज्य, पृथ्वी, सेना और धन आदि सर्वस्व मुझे समर्पित कर दिया तो मुझ तपस्वीके इस राज्यमें रहते किसका प्रभुत्व रहा?

verses.transliteration: svakarmābhirato yena matsuto vinapātitaḥ / ityuktvā koparaktākṣo jaṭāmagnau juhāva tām
verses.translation: ning of the worlds- -this universe is permeated, — this universe which, characterized by appearance and disappearance, by visi- bility and invisibility, has, men say, been created and also been
verses.hindi: हरिश्रन्द्रने कहा--“ब्रह्मन्! मैंने जिस समय यह पृथ्वी दी है, उसी समय आप मेरे भी स्वामी हो गये। फिर आपके इस पृथ्वीके राजा होनेकी तो बात ही
verses.wordMeaning: ning of the worlds- -this universe is permeated, — this universe which, characterized by appearance and disappearance, by visi- bility and invisibility, has, men say, been created and also been

verses.sanskrit: ततो वृत्रः समुत्तस्थौ ज्वालामाली महासुरः । महाकायो महादंष्ट्रो भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रभः
verses.transliteration: tato vṛtraḥ samuttasthau jvālāmālī mahāsuraḥ / mahākāyo mahādaṃṣṭro bhinnāñjanacayaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: destroyed in the end: and having paid adoration with profound meditation to Brahmd, the creator, who purifies the three worlds with his mouths as ho utters the Ric' and Sama
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्र बोले--राजन्! यदि तुमने यह सारी पृथ्वी मुझे दान कर दी तो जहाँ-जहाँ मेरा प्रभुत्व हो, वहाँसे तुम्हें निकल जाना चाहिए। करधनी आदि समस्त आशभूषणोंका संग्रह यहीं छोड़कर तुम वल्कलका वस्त्र लपेट लो और अपनी पत्नी तथा पुत्रके साथ चले जाओ।
verses.wordMeaning: destroyed in the end: and having paid adoration with profound meditation to Brahmd, the creator, who purifies the three worlds with his mouths as ho utters the Ric' and Sama
verses.commentary: Sense: destroyed in the end: and having paid adoration with profound meditation to Brahmd, the creator, who purifies the three worlds with his mouths as ho utters the Ric' and Sama

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रशत्रुरमेयात्मा त्वष्टृतेजोपबृंहितः । अहन्यहनि सो ऽवर्धदिषुपातं महाबलः
verses.transliteration: indraśatrurameyātmā tvaṣṭṛtejopabṛṃhitaḥ / ahanyahani so 'vardhadiṣupātaṃ mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: hymns: also having prostrated ourselves before the lord, conquered by one of whose arrows the bands of the Asuras do
verses.hindi: “बहुत अच्छा” कहकर राजा हरिश्वन्द्र अपनी पत्नी शैब्या तथा पुत्र रोहिताश्वको साथ ले वहाँसे जाने लगे। उस समय विश्वामित्रने उनका मार्ग रोककर कहा--'मुझे राजसूय-यज्ञकी दक्षिणा दिये बिना ही तुम कहाँ जा रहे
verses.wordMeaning: hymns: also having prostrated ourselves before the lord, conquered by one of whose arrows the bands of the Asuras do
verses.commentary: Sense: hymns: also having prostrated ourselves before the lord, conquered by one of whose arrows the bands of the Asuras do

verses.sanskrit: वधाय चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा वृत्रं शक्रो महासुरम् । प्रेषयामास सप्तर्षोन् सन्धिमिच्छन् भयातुरः
verses.transliteration: vadhāya cātmano dṛṣṭvā vṛtraṃ śakro mahāsuram / preṣayāmāsa saptarṣon sandhimicchan bhayāturaḥ
verses.translation: not interrupt the sficrifices of the sacrificers: wo will declare
verses.hindi: हरिश्वन्द्र बोले--भगवन्! यह अकण्टक राज्य तो मैंने आपको दे ही दिया, अब तो मेरे पास ये तीन शरीर ही शेष बचे हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: not interrupt the sficrifices of the sacrificers: wo will declare
verses.commentary: Sense: not interrupt the sficrifices of the sacrificers: wo will declare

verses.sanskrit: सख्यञ्चक्रुस्ततस्तस्य वृत्रेण समयांस्तथा । ऋषयः प्रीतमनसः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration: sakhyañcakrustatastasya vṛtreṇa samayāṃstathā / ṛṣayaḥ prītamanasaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.translation: " The waters were called Kara by Munis conversant with tnith; they were originally his place of movement*; hence ho
verses.wordMeaning: " The waters were called Kara by Munis conversant with tnith; they were originally his place of movement*; hence ho
verses.commentary: Sense: " The waters were called Kara by Munis conversant with tnith; they were originally his place of movement*; hence ho

verses.sanskrit: समयस्थितिमुल्लङ्घ्य यदा शक्रेण घातितः । वृत्रो हत्याभिभूतस्य तदा बलमशीर्यत
verses.transliteration: samayasthitimullaṅghya yadā śakreṇa ghātitaḥ / vṛtro hatyābhibhūtasya tadā balamaśīryata
verses.translation: is called Narayana. The adorable god, the lord Narayana, per- vading all things, lives, 0 brahman, in a quadruple form: he
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रने कहा--तो भी तुम्हें मुझे यज्ञकी दक्षिणा तो देनी ही चाहिए। विशेषत: ब्राह्मणोंको कुछ देनेकी प्रतिज्ञा करके यदि न दिया जाय तो वह प्रतिज्ञा-भड़का दोष उस व्यक्तिका नाश कर डालता है। राजन्! राजसूय-यजञ्ञमें ब्राह्मणोंको जितनेसे सन्‍्तोष हो, उस यज्ञकी उतनी ही दक्षिणा देनी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: is called Narayana. The adorable god, the lord Narayana, per- vading all things, lives, 0 brahman, in a quadruple form: he
verses.commentary: Sense: is called Narayana. The adorable god, the lord Narayana, per- vading all things, lives, 0 brahman, in a quadruple form: he

verses.sanskrit: तच्छक्रदेहविभ्रष्टं बलं मारुतमाविशत् । सर्वव्यापिनमव्यक्तं बलस्यैवाधिदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: tacchakradehavibhraṣṭaṃ balaṃ mārutamāviśat / sarvavyāpinamavyaktaṃ balasyaivādhidaivatam
verses.translation: is possessed as well as devoid of attributes. His first form is inscrutable; the wise behold it bright; it is covered with gar-
verses.hindi: तुमने ही पहले प्रतिज्ञा की है कि देनेकी घोषणा कर देनेपर अवश्य देना चाहिए, आततायियोंसे युद्ध करना चाहिए तथा आर्तजनोंकी रक्षा करनी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: is possessed as well as devoid of attributes. His first form is inscrutable; the wise behold it bright; it is covered with gar-

verses.sanskrit: अहल्याञ्च यदा शक्रो गौतमं रूपमास्थितः । धर्षयामास देवेन्द्रस्तदा रूपमहीयत
verses.transliteration: ahalyāñca yadā śakro gautamaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ / dharṣayāmāsa devendrastadā rūpamahīyata
verses.translation: lands of flame j it is the acme of perfection to devotees; it is both far and it is near; it is to be understood as transcending attributes; when called Vasudeva, it is seen devoid of egoism;
verses.hindi: हरिश्वन्द्र बोले--भगवन्! इस समय मेरे पास कुछ भी नहीं है। समयानुसार अवश्य आपको दूँगा।
verses.wordMeaning: lands of flame j it is the acme of perfection to devotees; it is both far and it is near; it is to be understood as transcending attributes; when called Vasudeva, it is seen devoid of egoism;
verses.commentary: Sense: lands of flame j it is the acme of perfection to devotees; it is both far and it is near; it is to be understood as transcending attributes; when called Vasudeva, it is seen devoid of egoism;

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गलावण्यं यदतीव मनोरम् । विहाय दुष्टं देवेन्द्रं नासत्यावगमत् ततः
verses.transliteration: aṅgapratyaṅgalāvaṇyaṃ yadatīva manoram / vihāya duṣṭaṃ devendraṃ nāsatyāvagamat tataḥ
verses.translation: its shape, colour, etc., are not real but imaginary; it is indeed
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रने कहा--राजन! इसके लिये मुझे कितने समयतक प्रतीक्षा करनी होगी, शीघ्र बताओ।
verses.wordMeaning: its shape, colour, etc., are not real but imaginary; it is indeed
verses.commentary: Sense: its shape, colour, etc., are not real but imaginary; it is indeed

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण तेजसा त्यक्तं बलहीनमरूपिणम् । ज्ञात्वा सुरेशं दैतेयास्तज्जये चक्रुरुद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇa tejasā tyaktaṃ balahīnamarūpiṇam / jñātvā sureśaṃ daiteyāstajjaye cakrurudyamam
verses.translation: always pure; it is the sole form of pre-eminence. His second
verses.hindi: हरिश्वन्द्र बोले--ब्रह्मर्षे! मैं एक महीनेमें आपको दक्षिणाके लिये धन दूँगा। इस समय मेरे पास धन नहीं है, अतः मुझे जानेकी आज्ञा दीजिये।
verses.wordMeaning: always pure; it is the sole form of pre-eminence. His second
verses.commentary: Sense: always pure; it is the sole form of pre-eminence. His second

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञामुद्रिक्तवीर्याणां देवेन्द्रं विजिगीषवः । कुलेष्वतिबला दैत्या अजायन्त महामुने
verses.transliteration: rājñāmudriktavīryāṇāṃ devendraṃ vijigīṣavaḥ / kuleṣvatibalā daityā ajāyanta mahāmune

verses.sanskrit: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य धरणी भारपीडिता । जगाम मेरुशिखरं सदो यत्र दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya dharaṇī bhārapīḍitā / jagāma meruśikharaṃ sado yatra divaukasām
verses.translation: earth. It destroys the haughty Asuras, the exterminators of righteousness; it protects the gods, and holy men, who are-
verses.hindi: पक्षी कहते हैं-विश्वामित्रने जब “जाओ” कहकर जानेकी आज्ञा दी, तब राजा हरिश्वन्द्र नगरसे चले। उनके पीछे उनकी प्यारी पत्नी शैब्या भी चली, जो पैदल चलनेके योग्य कदापि नहीं थी। रानी और राजकुमारसहित राजा हरिश्वन्द्रको नगरसे निकलते देख उनके अनुयायी सेवकगण तथा पुरवासी
verses.wordMeaning: earth. It destroys the haughty Asuras, the exterminators of righteousness; it protects the gods, and holy men, who are-

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सा कथयामास भूरिभारावपीडिता । दनुजात्मजदैत्योत्थं खेदकारणमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sā kathayāmāsa bhūribhārāvapīḍitā / danujātmajadaityotthaṃ khedakāraṇamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: preservation. And ever by Vasudeva’s will, it exists in divine form, human form, and brute form, and partakes of their several natui*es.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य विलाप करने लगे--'हा नाथ! हम पीड़ितोंका आप क्‍यों परित्याग कर रहे हैं? राजन! आप धर्ममें तत्पर रहनेवाले तथा पुरवासियोंपर कृपा रखनेवाले हैं। राजर्ष! यदि आप धर्म समझें तो हमें भी अपने साथ ले चलें। महाराज! दो घड़ी तो ठहर जाइये। हमारे नेत्ररूपी भ्रमर आपके मुखारविन्दकी रूपसुधाका
verses.wordMeaning: preservation. And ever by Vasudeva’s will, it exists in divine form, human form, and brute form, and partakes of their several natui*es.
verses.commentary: Sense: preservation. And ever by Vasudeva’s will, it exists in divine form, human form, and brute form, and partakes of their several natui*es.

verses.sanskrit: एते भवद्भिरसुरा निहताः पृथुलौजसः । ते सर्वे मानुषे लोके जाता गेहेषु भूभृताम्
verses.transliteration: ete bhavadbhirasurā nihatāḥ pṛthulaujasaḥ / te sarve mānuṣe loke jātā geheṣu bhūbhṛtām
verses.translation: fashioner of virtue. His fourth form abides in water; it lies on a serpent as its bed; its attribute is passion; and it is always indeed active.
verses.hindi: पान कर लें। फिर हमें कब आपके दर्शनका सौभाग्य प्राप्त होगा। हाय! जिन महाराजके आगे-आगे चलनेपर पीछेसे कितने ही राजा चला करते थे, आज उन्हींके पीछे उनकी यह रानी अपने बालक पुत्रको गोद लेकर चल रही है। यात्राके समय जिनके सेवक भी हाथियोंपर बैठकर आगे जाते थे, वे ही महाराज
verses.wordMeaning: fashioner of virtue. His fourth form abides in water; it lies on a serpent as its bed; its attribute is passion; and it is always indeed active.
verses.commentary: Sense: fashioner of virtue. His fourth form abides in water; it lies on a serpent as its bed; its attribute is passion; and it is always indeed active.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिण्यो हि बहुलास्तद्भारार्ता व्रजाम्यधः । तथा कुरुध्वं त्रिदशा यथा शान्तिर्भवेन्मम
verses.transliteration: akṣauhiṇyo hi bahulāstadbhārārtā vrajāmyadhaḥ / tathā kurudhvaṃ tridaśā yathā śāntirbhavenmama
verses.translation: " The third form of Vishnu, which is assiduously intent on the preservation of creatures, always maintains righteousness on the
verses.hindi: हरिश्वन्द्र आज पैदल चल रहे हैं! हा राजन! मनोहर भौंहों, चिकनी त्वचा तथा ऊँची नासिकासे सुशोभित आपका सुकुमार मुख मार्ममें धूलिसे धूसरित एवं क्लेशयुक्त होकर न जाने कैसी दशाको प्राप्त होगा। नृपश्रेष्ठी उहर जाइये, ठहर जाइये; यहीं अपने धर्मका पालन कीजिये। क्रूरताका परित्याग ही सबसे बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: " The third form of Vishnu, which is assiduously intent on the preservation of creatures, always maintains righteousness on the
verses.commentary: Sense: " The third form of Vishnu, which is assiduously intent on the preservation of creatures, always maintains righteousness on the

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिण ऊचुः तेजोभागैस्ततो देवा अवतेरुर्दिवो महीम् । प्रजानामुपकारार्थं भूभारहरणाय च
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ tejobhāgaistato devā avaterurdivo mahīm / prajānāmupakārārthaṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya ca
verses.translation: devoted to the preservation of righteousness. Whensoever,
verses.hindi: धर्म है। विशेषत: क्षत्रियोंके लिये तो यही सबसे उत्तम है। नाथ! अब हमें स्त्री, पुत्र, धन-धान्य आदिसे क्‍या लेना है। यह सब छोड़कर हमलोग आपके साथ छायाकी भाँति रहेंगे। हा नाथ! हा महाराज!! हा स्वामिन्!!! आप हमें क्‍यों त्याग रहे हैं? जहाँ आप रहेंगे, वहीं हम भी रहेंगे। जहाँ आप हैं, वहीं सुख है।
verses.wordMeaning: devoted to the preservation of righteousness. Whensoever,
verses.commentary: Sense: devoted to the preservation of righteousness. Whensoever,

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रदेहजं तेजस्तन्मुमोच स्वयं वृषः । कुन्त्या जातो महातेजास्ततो राजा युधिष्ठिरः

verses.transliteration: tasyotpannā mahābhāgā patnī kṛṣṇā hutāśanāt

verses.sanskrit: शक्रस्यैकस्य सा पत्नी कृष्णा नान्यस्य कस्यचित् । योगीश्वराः शरीराणि कुर्वन्ति बहुलान्यपि
verses.transliteration: śakrasyaikasya sā patnī kṛṣṇā nānyasya kasyacit / yogīśvarāḥ śarīrāṇi kurvanti bahulānyapi

verses.wordMeaning: " Thus this has been declared to thee, how that the lord

verses.transliteration: pañcānāmekapatnītvamityetat kathitaṃ tava / śrūyatāṃ baladevo 'pi yathā yātaḥ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: " Thus this has been declared to thee, how that the lord
verses.hindi: विश्वेदवोंकी यह बात सुनकर विश्वामित्रको बड़ा रोष हुआ। उन्होंने उन सबको शाप देते हुए कहा--“तुम सब लोग मनुष्य हो जाओ।” फिर उनके अनुनय-विनयसे प्रसन्न होकर उन महामुनिने कहा--“मनुष्य होनेपर भी तुम्हारे कोई सन्तान नहीं होगी, तुम विवाह भी नहीं करोगे। तुम्हारे मनमें किसीके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: " Thus this has been declared to thee, how that the lord

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णेन हि विना नाहं यास्ये दुर्योधनान्तिकम् । पाण्डवान् वा समाश्रित्य कथं दुर्योधनं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇena hi vinā nāhaṃ yāsye duryodhanāntikam / pāṇḍavān vā samāśritya kathaṃ duryodhanaṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: done be better done? Without Kfishna, assuredly, I will not

verses.wordMeaning: done be better done? Without Kfishna, assuredly, I will not

verses.sanskrit: जामातरं तथा शिष्यं घातयिष्ये नरेश्वरम् । तस्मान्न पार्थं यास्यामि नापि दुर्योधनं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: jāmātaraṃ tathā śiṣyaṃ ghātayiṣye nareśvaram / tasmānna pārthaṃ yāsyāmi nāpi duryodhanaṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."
verses.hindi: जैमिनि बोले--आपलोगोंने क्रमशः मेरे प्रश्नोंके उत्तरमें ये सारी बातें बतायीं। अब मुझे हरिश्वन्द्रकी शेष कथा सुननेके लिये बड़ा कौतूहल हो रहा है। अहो, उन महात्माने बहुत बड़ा कष्ट उठाया। श्रेष्ठ पक्षियो! क्या उन्हें इस दुःखके अनुरूप ही कोई सुख भी कभी प्राप्त हुआ?
verses.wordMeaning: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."
verses.commentary: Sense: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थेष्वाप्लावयिष्यामि तावदात्मानमात्मना । कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च यावदन्ताय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: tīrtheṣvāplāvayiṣyāmi tāvadātmānamātmanā / kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yāvadantāya kalpate
verses.translation: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."
verses.hindi: पक्षियोंने कहा--विश्वामित्रकी बात सुनकर राजा दु:खी हो धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़े। उनके पीछे नन्‍्हे-से पुत्रको गोद लिये रानी शैब्या चल रही थीं। दिव्य वाराणसीपुरीके पास पहुँचकर राजाने विचार किया कि यह काशी मनुष्यकी भोग्य भूमि नहीं है, इसपर केवल शूलपाणि भगवान् शड्करका अधिकार है;
verses.wordMeaning: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."
verses.commentary: Sense: I will myself bathe myself at holy bathing places, so long as it oondnces *to the ending of the Kurus and P^rt(Javas."

verses.sanskrit: इत्यामन्त्र्य हृषीकेशं पार्थ-दुर्योधनावपि । जगाम द्वारकां शौरिः स्वसैन्युपरिवारितः
verses.transliteration: ityāmantrya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pārtha-duryodhanāvapi / jagāma dvārakāṃ śauriḥ svasainyuparivāritaḥ
verses.translation: holy bathing places, which are to bo visited in future. Having drank his draught, he then marched to the flourishing park of Raivata,* taking with him the intoxicated Apsaras-like Revati.
verses.hindi: अतः यह मेरे राज्यसे बाहर है। ऐसा निश्चय करके दुःखसे पीड़ित हो उन्होंने अपनी अनुकूल पत्नीके साथ पैदल ही काशीमें प्रवेश किया। पुरीमें प्रवेश करते ही उन्हें महर्षि विश्वामित्र सामने खड़े दिखायी दिये। उन्हें उपस्थित देख राजा हरिश्वन्द्र हाथ जोड़कर विनीत भावसे खड़े हो गये और बोले--'मुने! ये मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: holy bathing places, which are to bo visited in future. Having drank his draught, he then marched to the flourishing park of Raivata,* taking with him the intoxicated Apsaras-like Revati.
verses.commentary: Sense: holy bathing places, which are to bo visited in future. Having drank his draught, he then marched to the flourishing park of Raivata,* taking with him the intoxicated Apsaras-like Revati.

verses.sanskrit: पीतपानो जगामाथ रैवतोद्यानमृद्धिमत् । हस्ते गृहीत्वा समदां रेवतीमप्सरोपमाम्

verses.commentary: Sense: holy bathing places, which are to bo visited in future. Having drank his draught, he then marched to the flourishing park of Raivata,* taking with him the intoxicated Apsaras-like Revati.

verses.wordMeaning: Encircled by a bevy of maidens, the hero went on, intoxicated, stumbling in his walk. And ho saw a forest, fascinating, beyond
verses.commentary: Sense: Encircled by a bevy of maidens, the hero went on, intoxicated, stumbling in his walk. And ho saw a forest, fascinating, beyond

verses.transliteration: sarvartuphalabhārāḍhyān sarvartukusumojjvalān / apaśyat pādapāṃstatra vihagairanunāditān
verses.translation: saw the trees there, loaded with the weight of the fruits of every season, bright with the blossoms of every season, ren-
verses.hindi: राजा हरिश्वन्द्र अत्यन्त व्याकुल एवं दीन होकर नीचा मुख किये जब इस प्रकार चिन्ता कर रहे थे, उस समय उनकी पत्नीने नेत्रोंसे आँसू बहाते हुए गदठ्गदवाणीमें कहा--“महाराज! चिन्ता छोड़िये। अपने सत्यकी रक्षा कीजिये। जो मनुष्य सत्यसे विचलित होता है, वह श्मशानकी भाँति त्याग देने योग्य है।
verses.wordMeaning: saw the trees there, loaded with the weight of the fruits of every season, bright with the blossoms of every season, ren-

verses.transliteration: panasān lakucān mocān nīpāṃścātimanoharān / pārāvatāṃśca kaṅkolān nalinānamlavetasān

verses.hindi: साधन बताया है। इसी प्रकार जिनका मन अपने वशमें नहीं है, ऐसे पुरुषोंको पतनके गर्तमें गिरानेके लिये असत्यको ही प्रधान कारण बताया गया है।- कृति नामके राजा सात अश्वमेध और एक राजसूय-यज्ञका अनुष्ठान करके भी एक ही बार असत्य बोलनेके कारण स्वर्गसे गिर गये थे। महाराज! मुझसे पुत्रका जन्म

verses.sanskrit: भल्लातकानामलकांस्तिन्दुकांश्च महाफलान् । इङ्गुदान् करमर्दांश्च हरीतक-विभीतकान्
verses.transliteration: bhallātakānāmalakāṃstindukāṃśca mahāphalān / iṅgudān karamardāṃśca harītaka-vibhītakān
verses.translation: trees, §§ docks, |1|1 marking-nut trees, en^iBu^^'inyroba-
