verses.sanskrit: जन्मनामयुतं साग्रं मम स्मृतिपथं गतम् । निर्वेदाः परितोषाश्च क्षयवृद्ध्युदये गताः
verses.transliteration: janmanāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ mama smṛtipathaṃ gatam / nirvedāḥ paritoṣāśca kṣayavṛddhyudaye gatāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: गर्ग मुनिकी यह बात सुनकर राजा कार्तवीर्यने दत्तात्रेयजीके आश्रमपर जा उनका भक्तिपूर्वक पूजन किया। वह उनका पैर दबाता, उनके लिये माला, चन्दन, गन्ध, जल और फल आदि सामग्री प्रस्तुत करता; भोजनके साधन जुटाता और जूँठन साफ करता था। इससे सन्तुष्ट होकर मुनिने कार्तवीर्यसे कहा--“अरे भैया! तुम देखते हो, मेरे पास यह स्त्री
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुमित्रकलत्राणां वियोगाः सङ्गमास्तथा । मातरो विवधा दृष्टाः पितरो विवधास्तथा
verses.transliteration: śatrumitrakalatrāṇāṃ viyogāḥ saṅgamāstathā / mātaro vivadhā dṛṣṭāḥ pitaro vivadhāstathā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: बैठी हुई है। मैं इसके उपभोगसे निन्दाका पात्र हो रहा हूँ, अतः मेरी सेवा तुम्हें नहीं करनी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अनुभूतानि सौख्यनि दुः खानि च सहस्रशः । बान्धवा बहवः प्राप्ताः पितरश्च पृथग्विधाः
verses.transliteration: anubhūtāni saukhyani duḥ khāni ca sahasraśaḥ / bāndhavā bahavaḥ prāptāḥ pitaraśca pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। मैं कुछ भी करनेमें असमर्थ हूँ। तुम अपने उपकारके लिये किसी शक्तिशाली पुरुषकी आराधना करो।'
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्रपिच्छिले स्त्रीणां तथा कोष्ठे मयोषितम् । पीडाश्च सुभृशं प्राप्ता रोगाणाञ्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: viṇmūtrapicchile strīṇāṃ tathā koṣṭhe mayoṣitam / pīḍāśca subhṛśaṃ prāptā rogāṇāñca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: उनके इस प्रकार कहनेपर कार्तवीर्य अर्जुनको गर्गजीकी बातका स्मरण हो आया। उसने दत्तात्रेयजीको प्रणाम करके कहा।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भदुः खान्यनेकानि बालत्वे यौवने तथा । वृद्धतायां तथाप्तानि तानि सर्वाणि संस्मरे
verses.transliteration: garbhaduḥ khānyanekāni bālatve yauvane tathā / vṛddhatāyāṃ tathāptāni tāni sarvāṇi saṃsmare
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: अर्जुन बोला--देव! आप अपनी मायाका आश्रय लेकर मुझे क्यों अपनी मायामें डाल रहे हैं? आप सर्वथा निष्पाप हैं। इसी प्रकार ये देवी भी सम्पूर्ण जगत्की जननी हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण-क्षत्रिय-विशां शूद्राणाञ्चापि योनिषु । पुनश्च पुशुकीटानां मृगाणामथ पक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa-kṣatriya-viśāṃ śūdrāṇāñcāpi yoniṣu / punaśca puśukīṭānāṃ mṛgāṇāmatha pakṣiṇām
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: अर्जुनके यों कहनेपर भगवानने सम्पूर्ण भूमण्डलको वशमें करनेवाले महाभाग कार्तवीर्यसे कहा--'राजन्! तुमने मेरे गूढ़ रहस्यका कथन किया है, इसलिये मैं तुमपर बहुत सन्तुष्ट हूँ। तुम कोई वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव राजभृत्यानां राज्ञाञ्चाहवशालिनाम् । समुत्पन्नो ऽस्मि गेहेषु तथैव तव वेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: tathaiva rājabhṛtyānāṃ rājñāñcāhavaśālinām / samutpanno 'smi geheṣu tathaiva tava veśmani
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कार्तवीर्यने कहा--देव! यदि आप मुझपर प्रसन्न हैं तो मुझे ऐसी उत्तम ऐश्वर्यशक्ति प्रदान कीजिये, जिससे मैं प्रजाका पालन करूँ और अधर्मका भागी न बनूँ। मैं दूसरोंके मनकी बात जान लूँ और युद्धमें कोई मेरा सामना न कर सके। युद्ध करते समय मुझे एक
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यतां दासताञ्चैव गतो ऽस्मि बहुशो नृणाम् । स्वामित्वमीश्वरत्वं च दरिद्रत्वं तथा गतः
verses.transliteration: bhṛtyatāṃ dāsatāñcaiva gato 'smi bahuśo nṛṇām / svāmitvamīśvaratvaṃ ca daridratvaṃ tathā gataḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: हजार भुजाएँ प्राप्त हों; किन्तु वे इतनी हलकी हों, जिससे मेरे शरीरपर भार न पड़े। पर्वत, आकाश, जल, पृथ्वी और पातालमें मेरी अबाध गति हो। मेरा वध मेरी अपेक्षा श्रेष्ठ पुरुषके हाथसे हो। यदि कभी मैं कुमार्गमें प्रवृत्त होऊँ तो मुझे सन्‍्मार्ग दिखानेवाला उपदेशक प्राप्त हो। मुझे श्रेष्ठ अतिथि प्राप्त हों और निरन्तर दान करते रहनेपर भी मेरा धन कभी क्षीण न
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: हतं मया हतश्चान्यैर्हतं मे घातितं तथा । दत्तं ममान्यैरन्येभ्यो मया दत्तमनेकशाः
verses.transliteration: hataṃ mayā hataścānyairhataṃ me ghātitaṃ tathā / dattaṃ mamānyairanyebhyo mayā dattamanekaśāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: हो। मेरे स्मरण करनेमात्रसे सम्पूर्ण राष्ट्रमें धनका अभाव दूर हो जाय तथा आपमें मेरी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पितृ-मातृ-सुहृद्-भ्रातृ-कलत्रादिकृतेन च । तुष्टो ऽसकृत् तथा दैन्यमश्रुधौताननो गतः
verses.transliteration: pitṛ-mātṛ-suhṛd-bhrātṛ-kalatrādikṛtena ca / tuṣṭo 'sakṛt tathā dainyamaśrudhautānano gataḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: दत्तात्रेयजी बोले--तुमने जो-जो वरदान माँगे हैं, वे सब तुम्हें प्राप्त होंगे। तुम मेरे प्रसादसे चक्रवर्ती सम्राट् होओगे।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संसारचक्रे ऽस्मिन् भ्रमता तात सङ्कटे । ज्ञानमेतन्मया प्राप्तं मोक्षसम्प्राप्तिकारकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃsāracakre 'smin bhramatā tāta saṅkaṭe / jñānametanmayā prāptaṃ mokṣasamprāptikārakam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: सुमति कहते हैं--तदनन्तर दत्तात्रेयजीको प्रणाम करके अर्जुन अपने घर गया और समस्त प्रजा एवं अमात्यवर्गके लोगोंको एकत्रित करके उसने राज्याभिषेक ग्रहण किया। उसके अभिषेकके लिये गन्धर्व, श्रेष्ठ अप्सराएँ, वसिष्ठ आदि महर्षि, मेरु आदि पर्वत, गड़ा आदि नदियाँ और समुद्र, पाकर आदि वृक्ष, इन्द्र आदि देवता, वासुकि आदि नाग, गरुड़
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाते यत्र सर्वो ऽयमृग्यजुः सामसंज्ञितः । क्रियाकलापो विगुणो न सम्यक् प्रतिभाति मे
verses.transliteration: vijñāte yatra sarvo 'yamṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃjñitaḥ / kriyākalāpo viguṇo na samyak pratibhāti me
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: आदि पक्षी तथा नगर एवं जनपदके निवासी भी आये थे। श्रीदत्तात्रेयजीकी कृपासे अभिषेककी सब सामग्री अपने-आप जुट गयी थी। फिर तो ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओंने होमके लिये अग्निको प्रज्वलित किया तथा साक्षात् नारायणस्वरूप श्रीदत्तात्रेयजी एवं अन्यान्य महर्षियोंने समुद्र और नदियोंके जलसे अर्जुनका राज्याभिषेक किया। राजसिंहासनपर
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुत्पन्नबोधस्य वेदैः किं मे प्रयोजनम् । गुरुविज्ञानतृप्तस्य निरीहस्य सदात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmādutpannabodhasya vedaiḥ kiṃ me prayojanam / guruvijñānatṛptasya nirīhasya sadātmanaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: आसीन होते ही हैहयनरेशने अधर्मके नाश और धर्मकी रक्षाके लिये घोषणा करायी। दत्तात्रेयजीसे उत्तम ऐश्वर्य-शक्ति पाकर वे बड़े शक्तिशाली हो गये थे। राजाकी घोषणा इस प्रकार थी--“आजसे मुझको छोड़कर जो कोई भी शस्त्र ग्रहण करेगा अथवा दूसरोंकी हिंसामें प्रवृत्त होगा, वह लुटेरा समझा जायगा और मेरे हाथसे उसका वध होगा।'
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: षट् प्रकारक्रिया-दुःख-सुख-हर्ष-रसैश्च यत् । गुणैश्च वर्जितं ब्रह्म तत् प्राप्स्यामि परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭ prakārakriyā-duḥkha-sukha-harṣa-rasaiśca yat / guṇaiśca varjitaṃ brahma tat prāpsyāmi paraṃ padam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: काम 5207॥ भय 7 अत 5 के है
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: रस-हर्ष-भयोद्वेग-क्रोधामर्ष-जरातुराम् । विज्ञातां स्वमृगग्राहिसंघपाशशताकुलम्
verses.transliteration: rasa-harṣa-bhayodvega-krodhāmarṣa-jarāturām / vijñātāṃ svamṛgagrāhisaṃghapāśaśatākulam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: ऐसी आज्ञाके जारी होनेपर उस राज्यमें महापराक्रमी नरश्रेष्ठ राजा अर्जुनको छोड़कर दूसरा कोई मनुष्य शस्त्र धारण नहीं करता था। स्वयं राजा ही गाँवों, पशुओं, खेतों एवं द्विजातियोंकी रक्षा करते थे। तपस्वियों तथा व्यापारियोंके समुदायकी रक्षा भी वे स्वयं ही करते थे। लुटेरे, सर्प, अग्नि तथा शस्त्र आदिसे भयभीत मनुष्योंका तथा अन्य प्रकारकी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यास्याम्यहं तात त्यक्त्वेमां दुः खसन्ततिम् । त्रयीधर्ममधर्माढ्यं किं पापफलसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādyāsyāmyahaṃ tāta tyaktvemāṃ duḥ khasantatim / trayīdharmamadharmāḍhyaṃ kiṃ pāpaphalasannibham
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: आपत्तियोंमें मग्न हुए मानवोंका वे स्मरण करनेमात्रसे तत्काल उद्धार कर देते थे। उनके राज्यमें धनका अभाव कभी नहीं होता था। उन्होंने अनेक ऐसे यज्ञ किये, जिनके पूर्ण होनेपर ब्राह्मणोंको प्रचुर दक्षिणाएँ दी जाती थीं। उन्होंने कठोर तपस्या की और संग्रामोंमें भी महान् पराक्रम दिखाया। उनकी समृद्धि और बढ़ा हुआ सम्मान देखकर अड्रिरा मुनिने
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिण ऊचुः तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षविस्मयगद्गदम् । पिता प्राह महाभागः स्वसुतं हृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣavismayagadgadam / pitā prāha mahābhāgaḥ svasutaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कहा--'अन्य राजालोग यज्ञ, दान, तपस्या अथवा संग्राममें पराक्रम दिखानेमें राजा कार्तवीर्यकी तुलना नहीं कर सकते। राजा अर्जुनने जिस दिन दत्तात्रेयजीसे समृद्धि प्राप्त की थी, उस दिनके आनेपर वह उनके लिये यज्ञ करता था और सारी प्रजा भी राजाको परम ऐश्वर्यकी प्राप्ति हुई देख उसी दिन एकाग्रचित्तसे दत्तात्रयजीका यजन करती थी।'
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच किमेतद्वदसे वत्स कुतस्ते ज्ञानसम्भवः । केन ते जडता पूर्वमिदानीञ्च प्रबुद्धता
verses.transliteration: pitovāca kimetadvadase vatsa kutaste jñānasambhavaḥ / kena te jaḍatā pūrvamidānīñca prabuddhatā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार चराचरगुरु भगवान् विष्णुके स्वरूपभूत महात्मा दत्तात्रेयजीकी महिमाका वर्णन किया गया। शड्ख, चक्र, गदा एवं शार्क्धनुष धारण करनेवाले अनन्त एवं अप्रमेय भगवान् विष्णुके अनेक अवतार पुराणोंमें वर्णित हैं। जो मनुष्य उनके परम स्वरूपका चिन्तन करता है, वह सुखी होता है और संसारसे उसका शीघ्र ही उद्धार हो जाता है। वे
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: किन्नु शापविकारो ऽयं मुनिदेवकृतस्तव । यत्ते ज्ञानं तिरोभूतमाविर्भावमुपागतम्
verses.transliteration: kinnu śāpavikāro 'yaṃ munidevakṛtastava / yatte jñānaṃ tirobhūtamāvirbhāvamupāgatam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: आदि-अन्तरहित भगवान् विष्णु अधर्मके नाश और धर्मके प्रचारके लिये ही संसारकी रक्षा और पालन करते हैं। अब मैं इसी प्रकार पितृभक्त राजर्षि महात्मा अलर्कके जन्मका वृत्तान्त बतलाता हूँ; क्योंकि दत्तात्रेयजीने उन्‍्हींको योगका उपदेश दिया था।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच शृणु तात ! यथा वृत्तं ममेदं सुख-दुःखदम् । यश्चाहमासमन्यस्मिन् जन्मन्यस्मत्परन्तु यत्
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca śṛṇu tāta ! yathā vṛttaṃ mamedaṃ sukha-duḥkhadam / yaścāhamāsamanyasmin janmanyasmatparantu yat
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: सोमो ब्रह्माभवद्विष्णुर्दत्तात्रोयो5भ्यजायत । दुर्वासा: शड्करो जज्ञे वरदानाद्विवौकसाम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अहमासं पुरा विप्रो न्यस्तात्मा परमात्मनि । आत्मविद्याविचारेषु परां निष्ठामुपागतः
verses.transliteration: ahamāsaṃ purā vipro nyastātmā paramātmani / ātmavidyāvicāreṣu parāṃ niṣṭhāmupāgataḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: इष्टापूर्तविनाशाय तद्राज्ञश्नौरधर्म्मिण: ।।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: सततं योगयुक्तस्य सतताभ्याससङ्गमात् । सत्संयोगात् स्वस्वभावाद्विचारविधिशोधनात्
verses.transliteration: satataṃ yogayuktasya satatābhyāsasaṅgamāt / satsaṃyogāt svasvabhāvādvicāravidhiśodhanāt
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: अलर्कोपाख्यानका आरम्भ--नागकुमारों के द्वारा ऋतथध्वजके पूर्ववृत्तान्तका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवे परा प्रीतिर्ममासीद् युञ्जतः सदा । आचार्यताञ्च सम्प्राप्तः शिष्यसन्देहहृत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasminnave parā prītirmamāsīd yuñjataḥ sadā / ācāryatāñca samprāptaḥ śiṣyasandehahṛttamaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: सुमति कहते हैं--पिताजी! प्राचीन कालकी बात है, शत्रुजित् नामके एक महापराक्रमी राजा राज्य करते थे, जिनके यज्ञोंमें पर्याप्त सोमरस पान करनेके कारण देवराज इन्द्र बहुत सन्तुष्ट रहते थे। उनका पुत्र भी बुद्धि, पराक्रम और लावण्यमें क्रमश: बृहस्पति, इन्द्र और अश्विनीकुमारोंकी समानता करता था।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता ऐकान्तिकमुपगतः । अज्ञानाकृष्टसद्भावो विपन्नश्च प्रमादतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā aikāntikamupagataḥ / ajñānākṛṣṭasadbhāvo vipannaśca pramādataḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वह राजकुमार प्रतिदिन अपने समान अवस्था, बुद्धि, बल, पराक्रम और चेष्टाओंवाले अन्य राजकुमारोंसे घिरा रहता था। कभी तो उनमें शास्त्रोंका विवेचन और उनके सिद्धान्तोंका निर्णय होता था; कभी काव्यचर्चा, संगीत- श्रवण और नाटक देखने आदिमें समय व्यतीत होता था। राजकुमार जब खेलनमें
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रान्तिकालादारभ्य स्मृतिलोपो न मे ऽभवत् । यावदब्दं गतं चैव जन्मनां स्मृतिमागतम्
verses.transliteration: utkrāntikālādārabhya smṛtilopo na me 'bhavat / yāvadabdaṃ gataṃ caiva janmanāṃ smṛtimāgatam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: लगते, उस समय उन्हींकी अवस्थावाले बहुत-से ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वैश्योंके बालक भी प्रेमवश वहाँ खेलने आ जाते थे। कुछ समय बीतनेके पश्चात् अश्वतर नामक नागके दो पुत्र नागलोकसे पृथ्वीतलपर घूमनेके लिये आये। उन्होंने ब्राह्मणके रूपमें अपनेको छिपा रखा था। वे देखनेमें बड़े सुन्दर और तरुण थे।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव सो ऽहं तात ! जितेन्द्रियः । यतिष्यामि तथा कर्तुं न भविष्ये यथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva so 'haṃ tāta ! jitendriyaḥ / yatiṣyāmi tathā kartuṃ na bhaviṣye yathā punaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वहाँ जो राजकुमार तथा अनन्‍्यान्य द्विज-बालक खेलते थे, उनके साथ ही वे भी भाँति-भाँतिके विनोद करते हुए बड़े प्रेमसे रहते थे। वे राजकुमार, वे ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वैश्योंके पुत्र तथा वे दोनों नागराजके बालक साथ-ही-साथ स्नान, अड्ढ-सेवा, वस्त्र-धारण, चन्दनका अनुलेप और भोजन आदि कार्य करते-कराते
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानदानफलं ह्येतद्यज्जातिस्मरणं मम । न ह्येतत् प्राप्यते तात त्रयीधर्माश्रितैर्नरैः
verses.transliteration: jñānadānaphalaṃ hyetadyajjātismaraṇaṃ mama / na hyetat prāpyate tāta trayīdharmāśritairnaraiḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: थे। राजकुमारके प्रेमवश नागराजके दोनों पुत्र प्रतिदिन बड़ी प्रसन्नताके साथ वहाँ आते थे। उनके साथ भाँति-भाँतिके विनोद, हास्य और वार्तालाप आदि करनेसे राजकुमारको बड़ा सुख मिलता था। वे उन्हें साथ लिये बिना भोजन, स्नान, क्रीड़ा तथा शास्त्रचर्चा आदि कुछ भी नहीं करते थे। इसी प्रकार वे दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पूर्वाश्रमादेव निष्ठाधर्ममुपाश्रितः । एकान्तित्वमुपागम्य यतिष्याम्यात्ममोक्षणे
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ pūrvāśramādeva niṣṭhādharmamupāśritaḥ / ekāntitvamupāgamya yatiṣyāmyātmamokṣaṇe
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: नागकुमार भी उनके बिना रसातलमें लंबी साँसें खींचते हुए रात बिताते और दिन निकलते ही उनके पास पहुँच जाते थे।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तद्ब्रूहि त्वं महाभाग ! यत् ते संशयिकं हृदि । एतावतापि ते प्रीतिमुत्पाद्यानृण्यमाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration: tadbrūhi tvaṃ mahābhāga ! yat te saṃśayikaṃ hṛdi / etāvatāpi te prītimutpādyānṛṇyamāpnuyām
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: इस तरह बहुत समय बीत जानेके बाद एक दिन नागराज अश्वतरने अपने दोनों बालकोंसे पूछा--'पुत्रो! तुम दोनोंका मर्त्यलोकके प्रति इतना अधिक प्रेम किस कारण है? बहुत दिनोंसे दिनके समय तुमलोग पातालमें नहीं दिखायी देते, केवल रातमें ही मैं तुम्हें देख पाता हूँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिण ऊचुः पिता प्राह ततः पुत्रं श्रद्दधत् तस्य तद्वचः । भवता यद्वयं पृष्टाः संसारग्रहणाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ pitā prāha tataḥ putraṃ śraddadhat tasya tadvacaḥ / bhavatā yadvayaṃ pṛṣṭāḥ saṃsāragrahaṇāśrayam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पुत्रोंने कहा--'पिताजी! मर्त्यलोकमें राजा शत्रुजित॒के एक पुत्र हैं, जिनका नाम ऋतध्वज है। वे बड़े ही रूपवान्ू, सरल, शूरवीर, मानी तथा प्रिय वचन बोलनेवाले हैं। बिना पूछे ही वार्तालाप आरम्भ करनेवाले, वक्ता, विद्वान, मित्रभाव रखनेवाले और समस्त गुणोंके भंडार हैं। वे राजकुमार माननीय
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच शृणु तात ! यथा तत्त्वमनुभूतं मयासकृत् । संसारचक्रमजरं स्थितिर्यस्य न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca śṛṇu tāta ! yathā tattvamanubhūtaṃ mayāsakṛt / saṃsāracakramajaraṃ sthitiryasya na vidyate
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पुरुषोंको सदा आदर देते हैं। बुद्धिमान् एवं लज्जाशील हैं। विनय ही उनका आभूषण है। उनके अर्पण किये हुए उत्तम-उत्तम उपचार, प्रेम और भाँति- भाँतिके भोगोंने हमारा मन हर लिया है। उनके बिना नागलोक या भूलोकमें कहीं भी हमें सुख नहीं मिलता। पिताजी! उनके वियोगसे पाताललोककी यह
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं वदामि ते सर्वं तवैवानुज्ञया पितः । उत्क्रान्तिकालादारभ्य यथा नान्यो वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ vadāmi te sarvaṃ tavaivānujñayā pitaḥ / utkrāntikālādārabhya yathā nānyo vadiṣyati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: शीतल रजनी भी हमारे लिये सन्‍्तापका कारण बनती है और उनका साथ होनेसे दिनके सूर्य भी हमें आह्वाद प्रदान करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ऊष्मा प्रकुपितः काये तीव्रवायुसमीरितः । भिनत्ति मर्मस्थानानि दीप्यमानो निरिन्धनः
verses.transliteration: ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ / bhinatti marmasthānāni dīpyamāno nirindhanaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पिताने कहा--'पुत्रो! अपने पुण्यात्मा पिताका वह बालक धन्य है, जिसके गुणोंका वर्णन तुम-जैसे गुणवान् लोग परोक्षमें भी कर रहे हो। संसारमें कुछ लोग ऐसे हैं, जो शास्त्रोंके ज्ञाता तो हैं, किन्तु उनमें शीलका अभाव है। कुछ लोग शीलवानू तो हैं, किन्तु शास्त्रज्ञानसे रहित हैं। जिस पुरुषमें शास्त्रोंका ज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: उदानो नाम पवनस्ततश्चोर्ध्वं प्रवर्तते । भुक्तानामम्बुभक्ष्याणामधोगतिनिरोधकृत्
verses.transliteration: udāno nāma pavanastataścordhvaṃ pravartate / bhuktānāmambubhakṣyāṇāmadhogatinirodhakṛt
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: और उत्तम शील दोनों गुण समानरूपसे हों, मैं उसीको विशेष धन्यवादका पात्र समझता हूँ। जिसके मित्रोचित गुणोंका मित्रलोग और पराक्रमका शत्रुलोग भी सत्पुरुषोंके बीचमें वर्णन करते हों, उसी पुत्रसे पिता वास्तवमें पुत्रवान् होता है। ऋतध्वज तुमलोगोंके उपकारी मित्र हैं। क्या तुमलोगोंने भी उनके चित्तको प्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ततो येनाम्बुदानानि कृतान्यन्नरसास्तथा । दत्ताः स तस्य आह्लादमापदि प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: tato yenāmbudānāni kṛtānyannarasāstathā / dattāḥ sa tasya āhlādamāpadi pratipadyate
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: करनेके लिये कभी उनका कोई मनोरथ सिद्ध किया है? जिसके यहाँसे याचक कभी विमुख नहीं जाते और मित्रका कार्य कभी सिद्ध हुए बिना नहीं रहता, वही पुरुष धन्य है! उसीका जीवन और जन्म धन्य है! मेरे घरमें जो सुवर्ण आदि रत्न, वाहन, आसन तथा और कोई वस्तु उनके लिये रुचिकर हो, वह सब
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नानि येन दत्तानि श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा । सो ऽपि तृप्तिमवाप्नोति विनाप्यन्नेन वै तदा
verses.transliteration: annāni yena dattāni śraddhāpūtena cetasā / so 'pi tṛptimavāpnoti vināpyannena vai tadā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: तुमलोग निःशड्क होकर उन्हें दे सकते हो। जो सुहृदोंका उपकार करते, शत्रुओंको हानि पहुँचाते तथा मेघके समान सर्वत्र दानकी वर्षा करते हैं, विद्वानलोग उनकी सदा ही उन्नति चाहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: येनानृतानि नोक्तानि प्रीतिभेदः कृतो न च । आस्तिकः श्रद्दधानश्च स सुखं मृत्युमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: yenānṛtāni noktāni prītibhedaḥ kṛto na ca / āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumṛcchati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पुत्र बोले--पिताजी! वे तो कृतकृत्य हैं, उनका कोई क्‍या उपकार कर सकता है? उनके घरपर आये हुए सभी याचक सदा ही पूजित होते हैं, उनकी सभी कामनाएँ पूर्ण की जाती हैं। उनके घरमें जो रत्न हैं, वे हमारे पातालमें कहाँ हैं। वैसे वाहन, आसन, यान, भूषण और वस्त्र यहाँ कहाँ उपलब्ध हो
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: देवब्राह्मणपूजायां ये रता नानसूयवः । शुक्ला वदान्या ह्रीमन्तस्ते नराः सुखमृत्यवः
verses.transliteration: devabrāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ ye ratā nānasūyavaḥ / śuklā vadānyā hrīmantaste narāḥ sukhamṛtyavaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: सकते हैं। उनमें जो विज्ञान है, वह और किसीमें नहीं है। पिताजी! वे बड़े-बड़े विद्वानोंके भी सब प्रकारके संदेहोंका भलीभाँति निवारण करते हैं। हाँ, एक कार्य उनका अवश्य है; किन्तु वह ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा शिव आदि सर्वसमर्थ परमेश्वरोंके सिवा हमलोगोंके लिये सर्वथा असाध्य है।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: यो न कामान्न संरम्भान्न द्वेषाद्धर्ममुत्सृजेत् । यथोक्तकारी सोम्यश्च स सुखं मृत्युमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo na kāmānna saṃrambhānna dveṣāddharmamutsṛjet / yathoktakārī somyaśca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumṛcchati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पिताने कहा--'पुत्रो! असाध्य हो या साध्य, किन्तु मैं उस उत्तम कार्यको अवश्य सुनना चाहता हूँ; विद्वान् पुरुषोंके लिये कौन-सा कार्य असाध्य है। जो अपने मन, बुद्धि तथा इन्द्रियोंको संयममें रखकर उद्यममें लगे रहते हैं, उन मनुष्योंके लिये इस पातालमें या स्वर्गमें कोई भी ऐसी वस्तु नहीं है, जो अज्ञात,
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अवारिदायिनो दाहं क्षुधाञ्चानन्नदायिनः । प्राप्नुवन्ति नराः काले तस्मिन् मृत्यावुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: avāridāyino dāhaṃ kṣudhāñcānannadāyinaḥ / prāpnuvanti narāḥ kāle tasmin mṛtyāvupasthite
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: अगम्य अथवा अप्राप्य हो। चींटी धीरे-धीरे चलती है; तथापि यदि वह चलती रहे तो सहस्रों योजन दूर चली जा सकती है। इसके विपरीत गरुड़ तेज चलनेवाले होनेपर भी यदि आगे पैर न बढ़ावें तो एक पग भी नहीं जा सकते। उद्योगी मनुष्योंके लिये कुछ गम्य और अगम्य नहीं होता, उनके लिये सब एक-सा है।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: शीतं जयन्तीन्धनदास्तापं चन्दनदायिनः । प्राणघ्नीं वेदनां कष्टां ये चानुद्वेगकारिणः
verses.transliteration: śītaṃ jayantīndhanadāstāpaṃ candanadāyinaḥ / prāṇaghnīṃ vedanāṃ kaṣṭāṃ ye cānudvegakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कहाँ यह भूमण्डल और कहाँ ध्रुवका स्थान, जिसे पृथ्वीपर होते हुए भी राजा उत्तानपादके पुत्र ध्रुवने प्राप्त कर लिया! इसलिये पुत्रो! महाभाग राजकुमारको
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: मोहाज्ञानप्रदातारः प्राप्नुवन्ति महद्भयम् । वेदनाभिरुदग्राभिः प्रपीड्यन्ते ऽधमा नराः
verses.transliteration: mohājñānapradātāraḥ prāpnuvanti mahadbhayam / vedanābhirudagrābhiḥ prapīḍyante 'dhamā narāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: जिस वस्तुकी आवश्यकता हो, बतलाओ, जिसे देकर तुम दोनों मित्र-ऋणसे उऋण हो सको।-
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: कूटसाक्षी मृषावादी यश्चासदनुशास्ति वै । ते मोहमृत्यवः सर्वे तथा वेदविनिन्दकाः
verses.transliteration: kūṭasākṣī mṛṣāvādī yaścāsadanuśāsti vai / te mohamṛtyavaḥ sarve tathā vedavinindakāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पुत्रोंने कहा--पिताजी! महात्मा ऋतध्वजने अपनी कुमारावस्थाकी एक घटना बतलायी थी, वह इस प्रकार है। राजा शत्रुजितके पास पहले कभी एक श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्यण पधारे थे। उनका नाम था महर्षि गालव। वे बड़े बुद्धिमान् थे और एक श्रेष्ठ अश्व लेकर आये थे। उन्होंने राजासे कहा--“महाराज! एक पापाचारी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणाः पूतिगन्धाः कूटमुद्गरपाणयः । आगच्छन्ति दुरात्मानो यमस्य पुरुषास्तदा
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇāḥ pūtigandhāḥ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ / āgacchanti durātmāno yamasya puruṣāstadā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: नीच हैत्य आकर मेरे आश्रमका विध्वंस किये देता है। वह सिंह, हाथी तथा अन्य वन-जन्तुओंका और छोटे-छोटे शरीरवाले दूसरे जीवोंका भी शरीर धारण करके अकारण आता है और समाधि एवं मौनव्रतके पालनमें लगे हुए मेरे सामने आकर ऐसे-ऐसे उपद्रव करता है, जिनसे मेरा चित्त चञ्चल हो जाता है। यद्यपि
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तेषु दृक्पथं तेषु जायते तस्य वेपथुः । क्रान्दत्यविरतं सो ऽथ भ्रातृ-मातृसुतानथ
verses.transliteration: prāpteṣu dṛkpathaṃ teṣu jāyate tasya vepathuḥ / krāndatyavirataṃ so 'tha bhrātṛ-mātṛsutānatha
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: हमलोग उसे अपनी क्रोधाग्निसे भस्म कर डालनेकी शक्ति रखते हैं तथापि बड़े कष्टसे उपार्जित की हुई तपस्याका अपव्यय करना नहीं चाहते। राजन्! एक दिनकी बात है, मैं उस असुरको देखकर अत्यन्त खिन्न हो लंबी साँसें ले रहा था, इतनेमें ही यह घोड़ा आकाशसे नीचे उतरा। उसी समय यह आकाशवाणी हुई
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: सास्य वागस्फुटा तात एकवर्णा विभाव्यते । दृष्टिश्च भ्राम्यते त्रासाच्छ्वासाच्छुष्यत्यथाननम्
verses.transliteration: sāsya vāgasphuṭā tāta ekavarṇā vibhāvyate / dṛṣṭiśca bhrāmyate trāsācchvāsācchuṣyatyathānanam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: --'मुने! यह अश्व बिना थके समस्त भूमण्डलकी परिक्रमा कर सकता है। इसे सूर्यदेवने आपके लिये प्रदान किया है। आकाश-पाताल और जलमें भी इसकी गति नहीं रुकती। यह समस्त दिशाओंमें बेरोक-टोक जाता है। पर्वतोंपर चढ़नेमें भी इसे कठिनाई नहीं होती। समस्त भूमण्डलमें यह बिना थकावटके विचरण
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वश्वासान्वितः सो ऽथ दृष्टिभङ्गसमन्वितः । ततः स वेदनाविष्टस्तच्छरीरं विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaśvāsānvitaḥ so 'tha dṛṣṭibhaṅgasamanvitaḥ / tataḥ sa vedanāviṣṭastaccharīraṃ vimuñcati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: करेगा, इसलिये संसारमें इसका कुवलय (कु-भूमि, वलय"मण्डल) नाम प्रसिद्ध होगा। द्विजश्रेष्ठ जो नीच दानव तुम्हें रात-दिन क्लेशमें डाले रहता है, उसका भी इसी अश्वपर आरूढ़ होकर राजा शत्रुजितके पुत्र ऋतध्वज वध करेंगे। इस अश्वरत्नको पाकर इसीके नामपर राजकुमारकी प्रसिद्धि होगी। वे कुवलयाश्रव
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: वाय्वग्रसारी तद्रूपं देहमन्यत् प्रपद्यते । तत्कर्मजं यातनार्थं न मातृ-पितृसम्भवम् । तत्प्रमाणवयो ऽवस्था-संस्थानैः प्राग्भवं यथा
verses.transliteration: vāyvagrasārī tadrūpaṃ dehamanyat prapadyate / tatkarmajaṃ yātanārthaṃ na mātṛ-pitṛsambhavam / tatpramāṇavayo 'vasthā-saṃsthānaiḥ prāgbhavaṃ yathā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कहलायेंगे।” “राजन! उस आकाशवाणीके अनुसार मैं तुम्हारे पास आया हूँ। तपस्यामें विघ्न डालनेवाले उस दानवको तुम रोको; क्योंकि राजा भी प्रजाकी तपस्याके अंशका भागी होता है। भूपाल! अब मैंने यह अश्वरत्न तुमको समर्पित कर दिया। तुम अपने पुत्रको मेरे साथ चलनेकी आज्ञा दो, जिससे धर्मका लोप
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दूतो यमस्याशु पाशैर्बध्नाति दारुणैः । दण्डप्रहारसम्भ्रान्तं कर्षते दक्षिणां दिशम्
verses.transliteration: tato dūto yamasyāśu pāśairbadhnāti dāruṇaiḥ / daṇḍaprahārasambhrāntaṃ karṣate dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: गालव मुनिके यों कहनेपर धर्मात्मा राजाने मड़लाचारपूर्वक राजकुमार ऋतध्वजको उस अश्वरत्नपर चढ़ाया और मुनिके साथ भेज दिया। गालव मुनि उन्हें साथ ले अपने आश्रमको लौट गये।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: कुश-कण्टक-वलमीक-शङ्कु-पाषाणकर्कशे । तथा प्रदीप्तज्वलने क्वचिच्छृभ्रशतोत्कटे
verses.transliteration: kuśa-kaṇṭaka-valamīka-śaṅku-pāṣāṇakarkaśe / tathā pradīptajvalane kvacicchṛbhraśatotkaṭe
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: तत् कथ्यतां महाभाग कार्यवान् येन पुत्रकौ । स भूपालसुतः साधुर्येनानृण्यं भवेत वाम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीप्तादित्यतप्ते च दह्यमाने तदंशुभिः । कृष्यते यमदूतैश्चाशिवसन्नादभीषणैः
verses.transliteration: pradīptādityatapte ca dahyamāne tadaṃśubhiḥ / kṛṣyate yamadūtaiścāśivasannādabhīṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पातालकेतुका वध और मदालसाके साथ ऋतथध्वजका विवाह
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: विकृष्यमाणस्तैर्घोरैर्भक्ष्यमाणः शिवाशतैः । प्रयाति दारुणे मार्गे पापकर्मा यमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: vikṛṣyamāṇastairghorairbhakṣyamāṇaḥ śivāśataiḥ / prayāti dāruṇe mārge pāpakarmā yamakṣayam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पिताने पूछा--पुत्रो! महर्षि गालवके साथ जाकर राजकुमार ऋतध्वजने वहाँ जो-जो कार्य किया, उसे बतलाओ। तुमलोगोंकी कथा बड़ी अद्भुत है।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: छत्रोपानत्प्रदातारो ये च वस्त्रप्रदा नराः । ये यान्ति मनुजा मार्गं तं सुखेन तथान्नदाः
verses.transliteration: chatropānatpradātāro ye ca vastrapradā narāḥ / ye yānti manujā mārgaṃ taṃ sukhena tathānnadāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: पुत्रोनें कहा--महर्षि गालवके रमणीय आश्रममें रहकर राजकुमार ऋतथध्वजने ब्रह्मवादी मुनियोंके सब विघ्नोंको शान्त कर दिया। वीर कुवलयाश्रव गालवाश्रममें ही निवास करते हैं, इस बातको वह मदोन्‍्मत्त नीच दानव नहीं जानता था। इसलिये स्वन्ध्योपासनमें लगे हुए गालव मुनिको सतानेके लिये वह
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्लेशाननुभवन्नवशः पापपीडितः । नीयते द्वादशाहेन धर्मराजपुरं नरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kleśānanubhavannavaśaḥ pāpapīḍitaḥ / nīyate dvādaśāhena dharmarājapuraṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: शूकरका रूप धारण करके आया। उसे देखते ही मुनिके शिष्योंने हल्ला मचाया। फिर तो राजकुमार शीघ्र ही घोड़ेपर सवार हो धनुष लेकर उसके पीछे दौड़े। उन्होंने धनुषको खूब जोरसे खींचकर एक चमकते हुए अर्धचन्द्राकार बाणसे उसको चोट पहुँचायी। बाणसे आहत होकर वह अपने प्राण बचानेकी धुनमें
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: कलेवरे दह्यमाने महान्तं दाहमृच्छति । ताड्यमाने तथैवार्ति छिद्यमाने च दारुणाम्
verses.transliteration: kalevare dahyamāne mahāntaṃ dāhamṛcchati / tāḍyamāne tathaivārti chidyamāne ca dāruṇām
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: भागा और वृक्षों तथा पर्वतसे घिरी हुई घनी झाड़ीमें घुस गया। वह घोड़ा भी मनके समान वेगसे चलनेवाला था। उसने बड़े वेगसे उस सूअरका पीछा किया। वाराहरूपधारी दानव तीव्र वेगसे भागता हुआ सहस्रों योजन दूर निकल गया और एक जगह पृथ्वीपर विवरके आकारमें दिखायी देनेवाले गढ़ेके भीतर बड़ी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: क्लिद्यमाने चिरतरं जन्तुर्दुःखमवाप्नुते । स्वेन कर्मविपाकेन देहान्तरगतो ऽपि सन्
verses.transliteration: klidyamāne cirataraṃ janturduḥkhamavāpnute / svena karmavipākena dehāntaragato 'pi san
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: फुर्तीके साथ कूद पड़ा। इसके बाद शीघ्र ही अश्वारोही राजकुमार भी घोर अन्धकारसे भरे हुए उस भारी गढ़ेमें कूद पड़े। उसमें जानेपर राजकुमारको वह सूअर नहीं दिखायी पड़ा, बल्कि उन्हें प्रकाशसे पूर्ण पाताललोकका दर्शन हुआ। सामने ही इन्द्रपुरीके समान एक सुन्दर नगर था, जिसमें सैकड़ों सोनेके महल
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यद्वान्धवास्तोयं प्रयच्छन्ति तिलैः सह । यच्च पिण्डं प्रयच्छन्ति नीयमानस्तदश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tatra yadvāndhavāstoyaṃ prayacchanti tilaiḥ saha / yacca piṇḍaṃ prayacchanti nīyamānastadaśnute
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: शोभा पा रहे थे। उस नगरके चारों ओर सुन्दर चहारदीवारी बनी हुई थी। राजकुमारने उसमें प्रवेश किया, किन्तु वहाँ उन्हें कोई मनुष्य नहीं दिखायी दिया। वे नगरमें घूमने लगे। घूमते-ही-घूमते उन्होंने एक स्त्रीको देखा, जो बड़ी उतावलीके साथ कहीं चली जा रही थी। राजकुमारने उससे पूछा--'तू किसकी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तैलाभ्यङ्गो बान्धवानामङ्गसंवाहनञ्च यत् । तेन चाप्याय्यते जन्तुर्यच्चाश्नन्ति सबान्धवाः
verses.transliteration: tailābhyaṅgo bāndhavānāmaṅgasaṃvāhanañca yat / tena cāpyāyyate janturyaccāśnanti sabāndhavāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कन्या है? किस कामसे जा रही है?” उस सुन्दरीने कुछ उत्तर नहीं दिया। वह चुपचाप एक महलकी सीढ़ियोंपर चढ़ गयी। ऋतध्वजने भी घोड़ेको एक जगह बाँध दिया और उसी स्त्रीके पीछे-पीछे महलमें प्रवेश किया। उस समय उनके नेत्र आश्वर्यसे चकित हो रहे थे। उनके मनमें किसी प्रकारकी शड्का नहीं थी।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ स्वपद्भिर्नात्यन्तं क्लेशमाप्नोति बान्धवैः । दानं ददद्भिश्च तथा जन्तुराप्याय्यते मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhūmau svapadbhirnātyantaṃ kleśamāpnoti bāndhavaiḥ / dānaṃ dadadbhiśca tathā janturāpyāyyate mṛtaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: महलमें पहुँचनेपर उन्होंने देखा, एक विशाल पलंग बिछा हुआ है, जो ऊपरसे नीचेतक सोनेका बना है। उसपर एक सुन्दरी कन्या बैठी थी, जो कामनायुक्त रति-सी जान पड़ती थी। चन्द्रमाके समान मुख, सुन्दर भौंहें, कुँदरूके समान
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: नीयमानः स्वकं गेहं द्वादशाहं स पश्यति । उपभुङ्क्ते तथा दत्तं तोयपिण्डादिकं भुवि
verses.transliteration: nīyamānaḥ svakaṃ gehaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ sa paśyati / upabhuṅkte tathā dattaṃ toyapiṇḍādikaṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: लाल ओठ, छरहरा शरीर और नील कमलके समान उसके नेत्र थे। अनड्रलताकी भाँति उस सर्वाड्रसुन्दरी रमणीको देखकर राजकुमारने समझा, यह कोई रसातलकी देवी है।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाहात् परं घोरमायसं भीषणाकृतिम् । याम्यं पश्यत्यथो जन्तुः कृष्यमाणः पुरं ततः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāhāt paraṃ ghoramāyasaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim / yāmyaṃ paśyatyatho jantuḥ kṛṣyamāṇaḥ puraṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: उस सुन्दरी बालाने भी मस्तकपर काले घूँघराले बालोंसे सुशोभित, उभरी हुई छाती, स्थूल कंधों और विशाल भुजाओंवाले राजकुमारको देखकर साक्षात् कामदेव ही समझा। उनके आते ही वह सहसा उठकर खड़ी हो गयी; किन्तु उसका मन अपने वशमें न रहा। वह तुरंत ही लज्जा, आश्वर्य और दीनताके
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: गतमात्रो ऽतिरक्ताक्षं भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रभम् । मृत्युकालान्तकादीनां मध्ये पश्यति वै यमम्
verses.transliteration: gatamātro 'tiraktākṣaṃ bhinnāñjanacayaprabham / mṛtyukālāntakādīnāṃ madhye paśyati vai yamam
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वशीभूत हो गयी। सोचने लगी--“ये कौन हैं? देवता, यक्ष, गन्धर्व, नाग अथवा विद्याधर तो नहीं आ गये? या ये कोई पुण्यात्मा मनुष्य हैं?" यों विचारकर उसने लंबी साँस ली और पृथ्वीपर बैठकर सहसा मूर्च्छित हो गयी। राजकुमारको भी कामदेवके बाणका आघात-सा लगा। फिर भी धैर्य धारण करके उन्होंने उस
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं भ्रकुटीदारुणाकृतिम् । विरूपैर्भोषणैर्वक्त्रैर्वृतं व्याधिशतैः प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrakuṭīdāruṇākṛtim / virūpairbhoṣaṇairvaktrairvṛtaṃ vyādhiśataiḥ prabhum
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: तरुणीको आश्वासन दिया और कहा--'डरनेकी आवश्यकता नहीं।” वह स्त्री, जिसे उन्होंने पहले महलमें जाते हुए देखा था, ताड़का पंखा लेकर व्यग्रतापूर्वक हवा करने लगी। राजकुमारने आश्वासन देकर जब उससे मूर्च्छाका कारण पूछा, तब वह बाला कुछ लज्जित हो गयी। उसने अपनी सखीको सब बातें बता दीं।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डासक्तं महाबाहुं पाशहस्तं सुभैरवम् । तन्निर्दिष्टां ततो याति गतिं जन्तुः शुभाशुभाम्
verses.transliteration: daṇḍāsaktaṃ mahābāhuṃ pāśahastaṃ subhairavam / tannirdiṣṭāṃ tato yāti gatiṃ jantuḥ śubhāśubhām
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: फिर उस सखीने उसकी मूर्च्छाका सारा कारण, जो राजकुमारको देखनेसे ही
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: रौरवे कूटसाक्षी तु याति यश्चानृतो नरः । तस्य स्वरूपं गदतो रौरवस्य निशामय
verses.transliteration: raurave kūṭasākṣī tu yāti yaścānṛto naraḥ / tasya svarūpaṃ gadato rauravasya niśāmaya
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वह स्त्री बोली--प्रभो! देवलोकमें विश्वावसु नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक गन्धर्वोंके राजा हैं। यह सुन्दरी उन्हींकी कन्या है। इसका नाम मदालसा है। वज्रकेतु दानवका एक भयडूकर पुत्र है, जो शत्रुओंका नाश करनेवाला है। वह संसारमें पातालकेतुके नामसे प्रसिद्ध है, उसका निवासस्थान पातालके ही भीतर है। एक
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्रे द्वे रौरवो हि प्रमाणतः । जानुमात्रप्रमाणश्च ततः श्वभ्रः सुदुस्तरः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasre dve rauravo hi pramāṇataḥ / jānumātrapramāṇaśca tataḥ śvabhraḥ sudustaraḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: दिन यह मदालसा अपने पिताके उद्यानमें घूम रही थी। उसी समय उस दुरात्मा दानवने विकारमयी माया फैलाकर इस असहाय बालिकाको हर लिया। उस दिन मैं इसके साथ नहीं थी। सुना है, आगामी त्रयोदशीको वह असुर इसके साथ विवाह करेगा; किन्तु जैसे शूद्र वेदकी श्रुतिका अधिकारी नहीं है, उसी प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राङ्गारचयोपेतं कृतञ्च धरणीसमम् । जाज्वल्यमानस्तीव्रेण तापिताङ्गारभूमिना
verses.transliteration: tatrāṅgāracayopetaṃ kṛtañca dharaṇīsamam / jājvalyamānastīvreṇa tāpitāṅgārabhūminā
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वह दानव भी इस सर्वाड़सुन्दरी मेरी सखीको पानेके योग्य नहीं है। अभी कलकी बात है, यह बेचारी आत्महत्या करनेको तैयार हो गयी थी। उस समय कामधेनुने आकर आश्वासन दिया--'बेटी! वह नीच दानव तुम्हें नहीं पा सकता। महाभागे! मर्त्यलोकमें जानेपर इस दानवको जो अपने बाणोंसे बींध डालेगा,
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये पापकर्माणं विमुञ्चन्ति यमानुगाः । स दह्यमानस्तीव्रेण वह्निना तत्र धावति
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye pāpakarmāṇaṃ vimuñcanti yamānugāḥ / sa dahyamānastīvreṇa vahninā tatra dhāvati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: वही तुम्हारा पति होगा। बहुत शीघ्र यह सुयोग प्राप्त होनेवाला है।! यह कहकर सुरभि देवी अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। मेरा नाम कुण्डला है। मैं इस मदालसाकी सखी, विन्ध्यवानकी पुत्री और वीर पुष्करमालीकी पत्नी हूँ। शुम्भने मेरे स्वामीको मार डाला, तबसे उत्तम व्रतोंका पालन करती हुई दिव्य गतिसे भिन्न-भिन्न तीर्थोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: पदे पदे च पादो ऽस्य शीर्यते जीर्यते पुनः । अहोरात्रेणोद्धरणं पादन्यासं च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pade pade ca pādo 'sya śīryate jīryate punaḥ / ahorātreṇoddharaṇaṃ pādanyāsaṃ ca gacchati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: विचरती रहती हूँ। अब मैं परलोक सुधारनेमें ही लगी हूँ। दुष्टात्मा पातालकेतु आज वाराहका रूप धारण करके मर्त्यलोकमें गया था। सुननेमें आया है, वहाँ मुनियोंकी रक्षाके लिये किसीने उसको अपने बाणोंका निशाना बनाया है। मैं इस बातका ठीक-ठीक पता लगानेके लिये ही गयी थी, पता लगाकर तुरंत लौट
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सहस्रमुत्तीर्णो योजनानां विमुच्यते । ततो ऽन्यं पापशुद्ध्यर्थं तादृङ्निरयमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sahasramuttīrṇo yojanānāṃ vimucyate / tato 'nyaṃ pāpaśuddhyarthaṃ tādṛṅnirayamṛcchati
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: आयी। सचमुच ही किसीने उस अधम दानवको बाणसे बींध डाला है।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वेषु निस्तीर्णः पापी तिर्यकत्वमश्नुते । कृमि-कीट-पतङ्गेषु श्वापदे मशकादिषु
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarveṣu nistīrṇaḥ pāpī tiryakatvamaśnute / kṛmi-kīṭa-pataṅgeṣu śvāpade maśakādiṣu
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: अब मदालसाके मूर्च्छिंत होनेका कारण सुनिये। मानद! आपको देखते ही आपके प्रति इसका प्रेम हो गया; किन्तु यह पत्नी होगी किसी औरकी, जिसने उस दानवको अपने बाणोंका निशाना बनाया है। यही कारण है, जिससे इसको मूर्चछ्वा आ गयी। अब तो जीवनभर इसे दुःख ही भोगना है; क्योंकि इसके
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा गजद्रुमाद्येषु गोष्वश्वेषु तथैव च । अन्यासु चैव पापासु दुः खदासु च योनिषु
verses.transliteration: gatvā gajadrumādyeṣu goṣvaśveṣu tathaiva ca / anyāsu caiva pāpāsu duḥ khadāsu ca yoniṣu
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: हृदयका प्रेम तो आपमें है और पति कोई और ही होनेवाला है। सुरभिका वचन कभी अन्यथा नहीं हो सकता। मैं तो इसीके प्रेमसे दुःखी होकर यहाँ चली आयी; क्‍योंकि मेरे लिये अपने शरीरमें और सखीमें कोई अन्तर नहीं है। यदि यह अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार किसी वीर पतिको प्राप्त कर लेती तो मैं निश्चिन्त
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषं प्राप्य कुब्जो वा कुत्सितो वामनो ऽपि वा । चण्डालपुक्कसाद्यासु नरो योनिषु जायते
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaṃ prāpya kubjo vā kutsito vāmano 'pi vā / caṇḍālapukkasādyāsu naro yoniṣu jāyate
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: होकर तपस्यामें लग जाती। महामते! अब आप अपना परिचय दीजिये। आप कौन हैं? और कैसे यहाँ पधारे हैं? आप देवता, हैत्य, गन्धर्व, नाग अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अवशिष्टेन पापेन पुण्येन च समन्वितः । ततश्चारोहणीं जातिं शूद्र-वैश्य-नृपादिकाम्
verses.transliteration: avaśiṣṭena pāpena puṇyena ca samanvitaḥ / tataścārohaṇīṃ jātiṃ śūdra-vaiśya-nṛpādikām
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: किन्नरोंमेंसे तो कोई नहीं हैं? क्योंकि यहाँ मनुष्यकी पहुँच नहीं हो सकती और मनुष्यका ऐसा दिव्य शरीर भी नहीं होता। जैसे मैंने सब बातें सच-सच बतायी हैं, वैसे ही आप भी अपना सब हाल ठीक-ठीक कहिये।
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रदेवेन्द्रतां चापि कदाचिदवरोहणीम् । एवन्तु पापकर्माणे नरकेषु पतन्त्यधः
verses.transliteration: vipradevendratāṃ cāpi kadācidavarohaṇīm / evantu pāpakarmāṇe narakeṣu patantyadhaḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: कुवलयाश्वने कहा--धर्मज्ञे! तुमने जो यह पूछा है कि आप कौन हैं और कहाँसे आये हैं, इसका उत्तर सुनो; मैं आरम्भसे ही अपना सब समाचार बतलाता हूँ। शुभे! मैं राजा शत्रुजितका पुत्र हूँ और पिताकी आज्ञासे मुनियोंकी रक्षाके लिये महर्षि गालवके आश्रमपर आया था। वहाँ मैं धर्मपरायण मुनियोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुण्यकृतो यान्ति तन्मे निगतदः शृणु । ते यमेन विनिर्दिष्टां यान्ति पुण्यां गतिं नराः
verses.transliteration: yathā puṇyakṛto yānti tanme nigatadaḥ śṛṇu / te yamena vinirdiṣṭāṃ yānti puṇyāṃ gatiṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: रक्षा करता था; किन्तु मेरे कार्यमें विध्न डालनेके लिये कोई दानव शूकरका रूप धारण करके आया। मैंने उसे अर्धचन्द्राकार बाणसे बींध डाला। मेरे बाणकी चोट खाकर वह बड़े वेगसे भागा। तब मैंने भी घोड़ेपर सवार होकर उसका पीछा किया। फिर सहसा वह वाराह एक गढ़ेमें गिर पड़ा। साथ ही मेरा घोड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगीतगन्धर्वगणाः प्रवृत्ताप्सरसाङ्गणाः । हारनूपुरमादुर्य-शोभितान्युत्तमानि च
verses.transliteration: pragītagandharvagaṇāḥ pravṛttāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ / hāranūpuramādurya-śobhitānyuttamāni ca
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: भी उसमें कूद पड़ा। उस घोड़ेपर चढ़ा हुआ मैं कुछ कालतक अन्धकारमें अकेला ही विचरता रहा। इसके बाद मुझे प्रकाश मिला और तुम्हारे ऊपर मेरी दृष्टि पड़ी। मैंने पूछा भी, किन्तु तुमने कुछ उत्तर नहीं दिया। फिर मैं तुम्हारे पीछे-पीछे इस सुन्दर महलमें आ गया। यह मैंने सच्ची बात बतलायी है। मैं
verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
