verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते च कुले तत्र सद्वृत्तपरिपालकाः । भोगान् सम्प्राप्नुवन्त्युग्रांस्ततो यान्त्यूर्ध्वमन्यथा

verses.wordMeaning: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.commentary: Sense: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.

verses.sanskrit: अवरोहणीं च सम्प्राप्य पूर्ववद्यान्ति मानवाः । एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथा जन्तुर्विपद्यते । अतः शृणुष्व विप्रर्षे यथा गर्भं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: avarohaṇīṃ ca samprāpya pūrvavadyānti mānavāḥ / etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā janturvipadyate / ataḥ śṛṇuṣva viprarṣe yathā garbhaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: decay and the rise of my mind. I have seen partings and meetings among enemies, friends and wives; I have seen mothers of various kinds, and fathers of various kinds also.
verses.hindi: सकता। अधिक कमनीय कान्ति चन्द्रमाको ही प्राप्त होती है; प्रचण्ड प्रभा सूर्यमें ही मिलती है। हैवी विभूति धन्य पुरुषको ही प्राप्त होती है। धृति धीरको और क्षमा उत्तम पुरुषको ही मिलती है। इसमें सन्देह नहीं कि आपने ही उस नीच दानवका वध किया है। भला, गोमाता सुरभि मिथ्या कैसे कहेंगी। मेरी यह

verses.wordMeaning: "Listen, father, how this happened to me, entailing pleasure and pain on me, and who I was in another birth, and what is beyond myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen, father, how this happened to me, entailing pleasure and pain on me, and who I was in another birth, and what is beyond myself.

verses.translation: tingly to mo. Of what use consequently are the Vedas to me, who am mature in wisdom, satiated with the knowledge
verses.hindi: पत्नी दोनोंके सहयोगपर ही निर्भर है। राजकुमार! स्त्रीकी सहायता लिये बिना पुरुष किसी देवता, पितर, भृत्य और अतिथियोंका पूजन नहीं कर सकता। मनुष्य जब पतिव्रता पत्नीकी रक्षा करता है, तब वह पुत्रोत्पादनके द्वारा पितरोंको, अन्न आदिके द्वारा अतिथियोंको और पूजा-अर्चाके द्वारा देवताओंको
verses.wordMeaning: tingly to mo. Of what use consequently are the Vedas to me, who am mature in wisdom, satiated with the knowledge
verses.commentary: Sense: tingly to mo. Of what use consequently are the Vedas to me, who am mature in wisdom, satiated with the knowledge

verses.sanskrit: नाडी चाप्यायनी नाम नाभ्यां तस्य निबध्यते । स्त्रीणां तथान्त्रसुषिरे सा निबद्धोपजायते
verses.transliteration: nāḍī cāpyāyanī nāma nābhyāṃ tasya nibadhyate / strīṇāṃ tathāntrasuṣire sā nibaddhopajāyate
verses.translation: of the gurus, void of desires, virtuous in soul? I will gain,
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न करता है। स्त्री भी पतिके बिना धर्म, अर्थ, काम एवं सन्‍्तान नहीं पा सकती; इसलिये पति-पत्नी दोनोंके सहयोगपर ही त्रिवर्गका सुख निर्भर करता है। आप दोनों नवदम्पतिके लिये ये बातें मैंने निवेदन की हैं। अब मैं अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार जा रही हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: of the gurus, void of desires, virtuous in soul? I will gain,
verses.commentary: Sense: of the gurus, void of desires, virtuous in soul? I will gain,

verses.sanskrit: क्रामन्ति भुक्तपीतानि स्त्रीणां गर्भोदरे यथा । तैराप्यायितदेहो ऽसौ जन्तुर्वृद्धिमुपैति वै

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्नैवं करिष्यामि मुक्तमात्र इहोदरात् । तथा तथा यतिष्यामि गर्भं नाप्स्याम्यहं यथा
verses.transliteration: punarnaivaṃ kariṣyāmi muktamātra ihodarāt / tathā tathā yatiṣyāmi garbhaṃ nāpsyāmyahaṃ yathā
verses.translation: Hearing that his declaration, which was interrupted by joj and surprise, the eminent father with gladsome mind address ed his son.
verses.hindi: राजकुमार ऋतध्वजपर बाणों और शूलोंकी वृष्टि आरम्भ कर दी। राजकुमार भी बड़े पराक्रमी थे। उन्होंने हँसते-हँसते बाणोंका जाल-सा फैला दिया और खेल- खेलमें ही दानवोंके सब अस्त्र-शस्त्र काट गिराये। क्षणभरमें ही पाताललोककी भूमि ऋतध्वजके बाणोंसे छिन्न-भिन्न हुए खड्ग, शक्ति, ऋष्टि और सायकोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hearing that his declaration, which was interrupted by joj and surprise, the eminent father with gladsome mind address ed his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing that his declaration, which was interrupted by joj and surprise, the eminent father with gladsome mind address ed his son.

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्तयते स्मृत्वा जन्मदुः खशतानि वै । यानि पूर्वानुभूतानि दैवभूतानि यानि वै
verses.transliteration: iti cintayate smṛtvā janmaduḥ khaśatāni vai / yāni pūrvānubhūtāni daivabhūtāni yāni vai

verses.hindi: आच्छादित हो गयी। तदनन्तर राजकुमारने त्वाष्ट नामक अस्त्रका सन्धान किया और उसे दानवोंपर छोड़ दिया। उसकी प्रचण्ड ज्वालासे पातालकेतुसहित समस्त दानव दग्ध हो गये। उनकी हड्डियाँ चटख-चटखकर राख हो गयीं। जैसे कपिलमुनिकी क्रोधाग्निमें सगरपुत्र भस्म हो गये थे, उसी प्रकार ऋतध्वजकी
verses.wordMeaning: "What is this thou sayest, my son? Whence arose thy wisdom? How came thy stupidity before, and thy awakening
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is this thou sayest, my son? Whence arose thy wisdom? How came thy stupidity before, and thy awakening

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालक्रमाज्जन्तुः परिवर्तत्यधोमुखः । नवमे दशमे वापि मासि सज्जयते यतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālakramājjantuḥ parivartatyadhomukhaḥ / navame daśame vāpi māsi sajjayate yataḥ
verses.translation: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.hindi: शराम्निमें सम्पूर्ण दानव जल मरे।
verses.wordMeaning: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.commentary: Sense: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रम्यमाणो वातेन प्राजापत्येन पीड्यते । निष्क्राम्यते च विलपन् हृदि दुः खनिपीडितः
verses.transliteration: niṣkramyamāṇo vātena prājāpatyena pīḍyate / niṣkrāmyate ca vilapan hṛdi duḥ khanipīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार बड़े-बड़े दानवोंका वध करके राजकुमार फिर अपने अश्वपर सवार हुए और उस स्त्रीरत्नके साथ अपने पिताके नगरमें आये। पिताके चरणोंमें प्रणाम करके उन्होंने पातालमें जाने, कुण्डलाके दर्शन होने, मदालसाको पाने और दानवोंसे युद्ध करने आदिका सब समाचार सुना दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.commentary: Sense: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रान्तश्चोदरान्मूर्च्छामसह्यां प्रतिपद्यते । प्राप्नोति चेतनां चासौ वायुस्पर्शसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: niṣkrāntaścodarānmūrcchāmasahyāṃ pratipadyate / prāpnoti cetanāṃ cāsau vāyusparśasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.hindi: यह सब सुनकर पिताको बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई। उन्होंने पुत्रको छातीसे लगाकर कहा--“बेटा! तुम सुपात्र और महात्मा हो। तुमने मुझे तार दिया; क्योंकि तुम्हारे द्वारा उत्तम धर्मका पालन करनेवाले मुनियोंकी भयसे रक्षा हुई है। मेरे पूर्वजोंने अपने कुलको यशसे विख्यात किया था। मैंने उस यशको फैलाया था और तुमने
verses.wordMeaning: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.commentary: Sense: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तं वैष्णवी माया समास्कन्दति मोहिनी । तया विमोहितात्मासौ ज्ञानभ्रंशमवाप्नुते
verses.transliteration: tatastaṃ vaiṣṇavī māyā samāskandati mohinī / tayā vimohitātmāsau jñānabhraṃśamavāpnute
verses.translation: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.hindi: अनृपम पराक्रम करके उसे और भी बढ़ा दिया। पिताने जो यश, धन अथवा पराक्रम प्राप्त किया हो, उसे जो कम नहीं करता, वह पुत्र मध्यम श्रेणीका माना गया है; जो अपनी शक्तिसे पिताकी अपेक्षा भी अधिक पराक्रम दिखाये, उसे विद्वान पुरुष श्रेष्ठ कहते हैं; किन्तु जो पिताद्वारा उपार्जित धन, वीर्य तथा यशको
verses.wordMeaning: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.commentary: Sense: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’

verses.sanskrit: भ्रष्टज्ञानो बालभावं ततो जन्तुः प्रपद्यते । ततः कौमारकावस्थां यौवनं वृद्धतामपि
verses.transliteration: bhraṣṭajñāno bālabhāvaṃ tato jantuḥ prapadyate / tataḥ kaumārakāvasthāṃ yauvanaṃ vṛddhatāmapi
verses.translation: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.hindi: अपने समयमें घटा देता है, वह बुद्धिमान पुरुषोंद्वारा अधम बताया गया है। मैंने जिस प्रकार ब्राह्मणोंकी रक्षा की थी, उसी प्रकार तुमने भी की है; परन्तु पाताललोककी यात्रा और वहाँ असुरोंका विनाश--वे सब कार्य तुमने अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’
verses.commentary: Sense: now? Is this a curse- wrought change inflicted on thee by a- Muni or god, since thy wisdom which was obscured has become manifest? ’’

verses.sanskrit: तत्राह्लादकरः सद्यः पवनः सुखशीतलः । करम्भ-बालुकाकुम्भ-मध्यस्थो मे समागतः
verses.transliteration: tatrāhlādakaraḥ sadyaḥ pavanaḥ sukhaśītalaḥ / karambha-bālukākumbha-madhyastho me samāgataḥ
verses.translation: course.’ One who is being born has great suffering in re- maining in the womb; and after birth one has suffering in- childhood and old age. The connexion also between desire ) envy and anger is grievous to bear in youth; and old age is almost all suffering; the heaviest suffering lies in death.
verses.hindi: भी संयुक्तकी भाँति स्थित है। देवि! जिसमें सब कुछ प्रतिष्ठित है, वह परम अक्षर तुम्हीं हो। परम अक्षर परमाणुकी भाँति स्थित है। अक्षररूप परब्रह्म और क्षररूप यह जगत् तुममें ही स्थित है। जैसे काष्ठमें अग्नि तथा पार्थिव सूक्ष्म परमाणु भी रहते हैं, उसी प्रकार ब्रह्म और यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् तुममें स्थित है।
verses.wordMeaning: course.’ One who is being born has great suffering in re- maining in the womb; and after birth one has suffering in- childhood and old age. The connexion also between desire ) envy and anger is grievous to bear in youth; and old age is almost all suffering;…
verses.commentary: Sense: course.’ One who is being born has great suffering in re- maining in the womb; and after birth one has suffering in- childhood and old age. The connexion also between desire ) envy and anger is grievous to bear in youth; and old age is almost all suffering;…

verses.wordMeaning: indeed endured by human beings, until, 0 most worth brahman! their sins are completely consumed.

verses.hindi: वर्णधर्मा न सीदन्ति यस्य राज्ये तथाश्रमा: । वत्स तस्य सुख प्रेत्य परत्रेह च शाश्वतम् ।। एठद्राज्ञ: पर कृत्यं तथैतत् सिद्धिकारकम्  स्वधर्मस्थापनं नृणां चाल्यते न कुबुद्धिभि: ।। पालनेनैव भूतानां कृतकृत्यो महीपति: । सम्यक् पालयिता भागं धर्मस्याप्रोति यत्नतः ।। एवं यो वर्तते राजा चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षणे  स सुखी विहरत्येष शक्रस्यैति सलोकताम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: किं मया कर्म तत् पुण्यं मर्त्यलोके महत् कृतम् । आह्लाददायिनी व्युष्टिर्येनेयं तदुदीरय
verses.transliteration: kiṃ mayā karma tat puṇyaṃ martyaloke mahat kṛtam / āhlādadāyinī vyuṣṭiryeneyaṃ tadudīraya
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: मदालसाके द्वारा वर्णाश्रमधर्म एवं गृहस्थके कर्तव्यका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: यमपुरुष उवाच पितृदेवातिथिप्रैष्य-शिष्टेनान्नेन ते तनुः । पुष्टिमभ्यागता यस्मात् तद्गतं च मनो यतः
verses.transliteration: yamapuruṣa uvāca pitṛdevātithipraiṣya-śiṣṭenānnena te tanuḥ / puṣṭimabhyāgatā yasmāt tadgataṃ ca mano yataḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: अलर्कने कहा--महा भागे! आपने राजनीति-सम्बन्धी धर्मका वर्णन किया। अब मैं वर्णाश्रमधर्म सुनना चाहता हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वद्गात्रसंसर्गो पवनो ह्लाददायकः । पापकर्मकृतो राजन् यातना न प्रबाधते
verses.transliteration: tatastvadgātrasaṃsargo pavano hlādadāyakaḥ / pāpakarmakṛto rājan yātanā na prabādhate
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: मदालसा बोली--दान, अध्ययन और यज्ञ--ये ब्राह्मणके तीन धर्म हैं तथा यज्ञ कराना, विद्या पढ़ाना और पवित्र दान लेना--यह तीन प्रकारकी उसकी आजीविका बतायी गयी है। दान, अध्ययन और यज्ञ--ये तीन क्षत्रियके भी धर्म हैं। पृथ्वीकी रक्षा तथा शस्त्र ग्रहण करके जीवननिर्वाह करना यह उसकी
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधादयो यज्ञास्त्वयेष्टा विधिवद्यतः । ततस्त्वद्दर्शनाद्याम्या यन्त्रशस्त्राग्निवायसाः
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhādayo yajñāstvayeṣṭā vidhivadyataḥ / tatastvaddarśanādyāmyā yantraśastrāgnivāyasāḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: जीविका है। वैश्यके भी दान, अध्ययन और यज्ञ--ये तीनों ही धर्म हैं। व्यापार, पशुपालन और खेती--ये उसकी जीविका हैं। दान, यज्ञ और द्विजातियोंकी सेवा--यह तीन प्रकारका धर्म शूद्रके लिये बताया गया है। शिल्पकर्म, द्विजातियोंकी सेवा और खरीद-बिक्री--ये उसकी जीविका हैं। इस प्रकार ये
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: पीडन-च्छेद-दाहादि-महादुः खस्य हेतवः । मृदुत्वमागता राजन् तेजसापहतास्तव
verses.transliteration: pīḍana-ccheda-dāhādi-mahāduḥ khasya hetavaḥ / mṛdutvamāgatā rājan tejasāpahatāstava
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: वर्णधर्म बतलाये गये हैं। अब आश्रमधर्मोंका वर्णन सुनो। यदि मनुष्य अपने वर्णधर्मसे भ्रष्ट न हो तो वह उसके द्वारा उत्तम सिद्धिको प्राप्त होता है और निषिद्धकर्मोके आचरणसे वह मृत्युके पश्चात् नरकमें पड़ता है।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच न स्वर्गे ब्रह्मलोके वा तत् सुखं प्राप्यते नरैः । यदार्तजन्तुनिर्वाण-दानोत्थमिति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca na svarge brahmaloke vā tat sukhaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ / yadārtajantunirvāṇa-dānotthamiti me matiḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: उपनयन-संस्कार होनेपर ब्रह्मचारी बालक गुरुके घरमें निवास करे। वहाँ उसके लिये जो धर्म बताया गया है, वह सुनो। ब्रह्मचारी वेदोंका स्वाध्याय करे, अन्निहोत्र करे, त्रिकाल स्नान करे, भिक्षाके लिये भ्रमण करे, भिक्षामें मिला हुआ अन्न गुरुको निवेदित करके उनकी आज्ञाके अनुसार ही सदा उसका उपयोग
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: यदि मत्सन्निधावेतान् यातना न प्रबाधते । ततो भद्रमुखात्राहं स्थास्ये स्थाणुरिवाचलः
verses.transliteration: yadi matsannidhāvetān yātanā na prabādhate / tato bhadramukhātrāhaṃ sthāsye sthāṇurivācalaḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: करे, गुरुके कार्यमें सदा उद्यत रहे, भलीभाँति उन्हें प्रसन्न रखे, गुरुके बुलानेपर एकाग्रचित्तसे तत्परतापूर्वक पढ़े, गुरुक मुखसे एक-दो या सम्पूर्ण वेदोंका ज्ञान प्राप्त करके गुरुके चरणोंमें प्रणाम करे और उन्हें गुरुदक्षिणा देकर गृहस्थाश्रममें प्रवेश करे। इस आश्रममें आनेका उद्देश्य होना चाहिए--गृहस्थाश्रम-सम्बन्धी
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: यमपुरुष उवाच एहि राजन् प्रगच्छामो निजपुण्यसमर्जितान् । भुङ्क्ष्व भोगानपास्येह यातनाः पापकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: yamapuruṣa uvāca ehi rājan pragacchāmo nijapuṇyasamarjitān / bhuṅkṣva bhogānapāsyeha yātanāḥ pāpakarmaṇām
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: धर्मोका पालन। अथवा अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार वह वानप्रस्थ या संन्यास- आश्रममें प्रवेश करे अथवा वहीं गुरुके घरमें सदा निवास करते हुए ब्रह्मचर्यनिष्ठताको प्राप्त हो--नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी बन जाय। गुरुके न रहनेपर उनके पुत्रकी और पुत्रके न रहनेपर उनके प्रधान शिष्यकी सेवा करे। अभिमानशून्य
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच तस्मान्न तावद्यास्यामि यावदेते सुदुः खिताः । मत्सन्निधानात् सुखिनो भवन्ति नरकौकसः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca tasmānna tāvadyāsyāmi yāvadete suduḥ khitāḥ / matsannidhānāt sukhino bhavanti narakaukasaḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: होकर ब्रह्मचर्य-आश्रममें रहे।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: धिक् तस्य जीवनं पुंसः शरणार्थिनमातुरम् । यो नार्तमनुगृह्णाति वैरिपक्षमपि ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: dhik tasya jīvanaṃ puṃsaḥ śaraṇārthinamāturam / yo nārtamanugṛhṇāti vairipakṣamapi dhruvam
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: जब गृहस्थाश्रममें आनेकी इच्छा लेकर ब्रह्मचर्य-आश्रमसे निकले, तब अपने अनुरूप नीरोग स्त्रीसे विधिपूर्वक विवाह करे। वह स्त्री अपने समान गोत्र और प्रवरकी न हो। उसके किसी अड़में न्यूनाधिकता अथवा कोई विकार न हो।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञ-दान-तपांसीह परत्र च न भूतये । भवन्ति तस्य यस्यार्त-परित्राणे न मानसम्
verses.transliteration: yajña-dāna-tapāṃsīha paratra ca na bhūtaye / bhavanti tasya yasyārta-paritrāṇe na mānasam
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: गृहस्थाश्रमका ठीक-ठीक सजञ्चालन करनेके लिये ही विवाह करना चाहिए। अपने पराक्रमसे धन पैदा करके देवता, पितर एवं अतिथियोंको भक्तिपूर्वक भलीभाँति तृप्त करे तथा अपने आश्रितोंका भरण-पोषण करता रहे। भृत्य, पुत्र, कुलकी स्त्रियाँ, दीन, अन्ध और पतित मनुष्योंको तथा पशु-पक्षियोंको भी
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: नरस्य यस्य कठिनं मनो बालातुरादिषु । वृद्धेषु च न तं मन्ये मानुषं राक्षसो हि सः
verses.transliteration: narasya yasya kaṭhinaṃ mano bālāturādiṣu / vṛddheṣu ca na taṃ manye mānuṣaṃ rākṣaso hi saḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: यथाशक्ति अन्न देकर उनका पालन करे। गृहस्थका यह धर्म है कि वह ऋतुकालनमें स्त्री-सलहवास करे। अपनी शक्तिके अनुसार पाँचों यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान न छोड़े। अपने विभवके अनुसार पितर, देवता, अतिथि एवं कुट॒म्बीजनोंके भोजन करनेसे बचे हुए अन्नको ही स्वयं भृत्यजनोंके साथ बैठकर आदरपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां सन्निकर्षात् तु यद्यग्निपरितापजम् । तथोग्रगन्धजं वापि दुः खं नरकसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ sannikarṣāt tu yadyagniparitāpajam / tathogragandhajaṃ vāpi duḥ khaṃ narakasambhavam
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: ग्रहण करे। यह मैंने संक्षेपसे गृहस्थाश्रमके धर्मका वर्णन किया है।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: क्षुत्पिपासाभवं दुः खं यच्च मूर्च्छाप्रदं महत् । एतेषां त्राणदानन्तु मन्ये स्वर्गसुखात् परम्
verses.transliteration: kṣutpipāsābhavaṃ duḥ khaṃ yacca mūrcchāpradaṃ mahat / eteṣāṃ trāṇadānantu manye svargasukhāt param
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: अब वानप्रस्थके धर्मका वर्णन करती हूँ, ध्यान देकर सुनो। बुद्धिमान पुरुषको उचित है कि वह अपनी सन्तानको देखकर तथा देह झुकी जा रही है, इस बातका विचार करके आत्मशुद्धिके लिये वानप्रस्थ आश्रममें जाय। वहाँ वनके फल-मूलोंका उपभोग करे और तपस्यासे शरीरको सुखाता रहे। पृथ्वीपर
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्स्यन्त्यार्ता यदि सुखं बहवो दुः खिते मयि । किन्नु प्राप्तं मया न स्यात् तस्मात् त्वं व्रज माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: prāpsyantyārtā yadi sukhaṃ bahavo duḥ khite mayi / kinnu prāptaṃ mayā na syāt tasmāt tvaṃ vraja māciram
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: सोये, ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करे, देवताओं, पितरों और अतिथियोंकी सेवामें संलग्न रहे। अग्निहोत्र, त्रिकाल-स्नान तथा जटा-वल्कल धारण करे; सदा योगाभ्यासमें लगा रहे और वनवासियोंपर स्नेह रखे। इस प्रकार यह पापोंकी शुद्धि तथा आत्माका उपकार करनेके लिये वानप्रस्थ-आश्रमका वर्णन किया है।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: यमपुरुष उवाच एष धर्मश्च शक्रश्च त्वां नेतुं समुपागतौ । अवश्यमस्माद् गन्तव्यं तस्मात् पार्थिव ! गम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yamapuruṣa uvāca eṣa dharmaśca śakraśca tvāṃ netuṃ samupāgatau / avaśyamasmād gantavyaṃ tasmāt pārthiva ! gamyatām
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: अब चतुर्थ आश्रमका स्वरूप बतलाती हूँ, सुनो। धर्मज्ञ महात्माओंने इस आश्रमके लिये जो धर्म बतलाया है, वह इस प्रकार है। सब प्रकारकी आसक्तियोंका त्याग, ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन, क्रोधशून्यता, जितेन्द्रियता, एक स्थानपर अधिक दिनोंतक न रहना, किसी कर्मका आरम्भ न करना, भिक्षामें
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: धर्म उवाच नयामि त्वामहं स्वर्गं त्वया सम्यगुपासितः । विमानमेतदारुह्य मा विलम्बस्व गम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: dharma uvāca nayāmi tvāmahaṃ svargaṃ tvayā samyagupāsitaḥ / vimānametadāruhya mā vilambasva gamyatām
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: मिले हुए अन्नका एक बार भोजन करना, आत्मज्ञान होनेकी इच्छाको जगाये रखना तथा सर्वत्र आत्माका दर्शन करना। यह मैंने चतुर्थ आश्रमका धर्म
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच नरके मानवा धर्म पीड्यन्ते ऽत्र सहस्रशः । त्राहीति चार्ताः क्रन्दन्ति मामतो न व्रजाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: rājovāca narake mānavā dharma pīḍyante 'tra sahasraśaḥ / trāhīti cārtāḥ krandanti māmato na vrajāmyaham
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: अब अनन्‍्यान्य वर्णों तथा आश्रमोंके सामान्य धर्मका वर्णन सुनो। सत्य, शौच, अहिंसा, दोषदृष्टिका अभाव, क्षमा, क्रूरताका अभाव, दीनताका न होना तथा सनन्‍्तोष धारण करना--ये वर्ण और आश्रमोंके धर्म संक्षेपसे बताये गये हैं। जो पुरुष अपने वर्ण और आश्रम-सम्बन्धी धर्मको छोड़कर उसके विपरीत आचरण
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच कर्मणा नरकप्राप्तिरेतेषां पापकर्मिणाम् । स्वर्गस्त्वयापि गन्तव्यो नृप ! पुण्येन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca karmaṇā narakaprāptireteṣāṃ pāpakarmiṇām / svargastvayāpi gantavyo nṛpa ! puṇyena karmaṇā
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: करता है, वह राजाके लिये दण्डनीय है। जो मानव अपने धर्मका त्याग करके पापकर्ममें लग जाते हैं, उनकी उपेक्षा करनेवाले राजाके इष्ट४ और आपूर्त- धर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच यदि जानासि धर्म ! त्वं त्वं वा शक्र ! शचीपते । मम यावत् प्रमाणन्तु शुभं तद्वक्तुमर्हथः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca yadi jānāsi dharma ! tvaṃ tvaṃ vā śakra ! śacīpate / mama yāvat pramāṇantu śubhaṃ tadvaktumarhathaḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: बेटा! गृहस्थ-धर्मका आश्रय लेकर मनुष्य इस सम्पूर्ण जगत्का पोषण करता है और उससे मनोवाञ्छित लोकोंको जीत लेता है। पितर, मुनि, देवता,
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: धर्म उवाच अब्बिन्दवो यथाम्भोधौ यथा वा दिवि तारकाः । यथा वा वर्षता धारा गड्गायां सिकता यथा
verses.transliteration: dharma uvāca abbindavo yathāmbhodhau yathā vā divi tārakāḥ / yathā vā varṣatā dhārā gaḍgāyāṃ sikatā yathā
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: भूत, मनुष्य, कृमि, कीट, पतड़, पशु-पक्षी तथा असुर--ये सभी गृहस्थसे ही जीविका चलाते हैं। उसीके दिये हुए अन्न-पानसे तृप्ति लाभ करते हैं तथा “क्या यह हमें भी कुछ देगा?” इस आशासे सदा उसका मुँह ताकते रहते हैं। वत्स! वेदत्रयीरूप धेनु सबकी आधारभूता है, उसीमें सम्पूर्ण विश्व प्रतिष्ठित है तथा
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: असंख्येया महाराज यथा बिन्द्वादयो ह्यपाम् । तथा तवापि पुण्यस्य संख्या नैवोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyeyā mahārāja yathā bindvādayo hyapām / tathā tavāpi puṇyasya saṃkhyā naivopapadyate
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: वही विश्वकी उत्पत्तिका कारण मानी गयी है। ऋग्वेद उसकी पीठ, यजुर्वेद उसका मध्यभाग तथा सामवेद उसका मुख और गर्दन है। इष्ट और आपूर्त धर्म ही उसके दो सींग हैं। अच्छी-अच्छी सूक्तियाँ ही उस धेनुके रोम हैं, शान्तिकर्म गोबर और पुष्टिकर्म उसका मूत्र है। अकार आदि वर्ण उसके अड़ोंके आधारभूत
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: अनुकम्पामिमामद्य नारकेष्विह कुर्वतः । तदेव शतसाहस्त्रं संख्यामुपगतं तव
verses.transliteration: anukampāmimāmadya nārakeṣviha kurvataḥ / tadeva śatasāhastraṃ saṃkhyāmupagataṃ tava
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: चरण हैं। सम्पूर्ण जगत्का जीवन उसीसे चलता है। वह वेदत्रयीरूप धेनु अक्षय है, उसका कभी क्षय नहीं होता। स्वाहा (देवयज्ञ), स्वथा (पितृयज्ञ), वषट्कार (ऋषि आदिकी प्रसन्नताके लिये किये जानेवाले यज्ञ) तथा हन्तकार (अतिथियज्ञ)--ये उसके चार स्तन हैं। स्वाहारूप स्तनको देवता, स्वथधाको
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: तद् गच्छ त्वं नृपश्रेष्ठ तद्भाक्तुममरालयम् । एते ऽपि पापं नरके क्षपयन्तु स्वकर्मजम्
verses.transliteration: tad gaccha tvaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tadbhāktumamarālayam / ete 'pi pāpaṃ narake kṣapayantu svakarmajam
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: पितर, वषट्कारको मुनि तथा हन्तकाररूप स्तनको मनुष्य सदा पीते हैं। इस प्रकार यह त्रयीमयी धेनु सबको तृप्त करती है। जो मनुष्य उन देवता आदिकी वृत्तिका उच्छेद करता है, वह अत्यन्त पापाचारी है। उसे अन्धतामिस््र एवं तामिस्र नरकमें गिरना पड़ता है। जो इस धेनुको इसके देवता आदि बछड़ोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच कथं स्पृहां करिष्यन्ति मत्सम्पर्केषु मानवाः । यदि सत्सन्निधावेषामुकत्कर्षो नोपजायते
verses.transliteration: rājovāca kathaṃ spṛhāṃ kariṣyanti matsamparkeṣu mānavāḥ / yadi satsannidhāveṣāmukatkarṣo nopajāyate
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: मिलाता है और उन्हें उचित समयपर पीनेका अवसर देता है, वह स्वर्गमें जाता है। अतः बेटा! जैसे अपने शरीरका पालन-पोषण किया जाता है, उसी प्रकार मनुष्यको प्रतिदिन देवता, ऋषि, पितर, मनुष्य तथा अन्य भूतोंका भी पोषण करना चाहिए। इसलिये प्रातःकाल स्नान करके पवित्र हो एकाग्रचित्तसे
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यत् सुकृतं किञ्चिन्ममास्ति त्रिदशाधिप । तेन मुच्यन्तु नरकात् पापिनो यातनां गताः
verses.transliteration: tasmādyat sukṛtaṃ kiñcinmamāsti tridaśādhipa / tena mucyantu narakāt pāpino yātanāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: जलद्वारा देवता, ऋषि, पितर और प्रजापतिका तर्पण करना चाहिए। मनुष्य फूल, गन्ध और धूप आदि सामग्रियोंसे देवताओंकी पूजा करके आहुतिके द्वारा अग्निको तृप्त करे। तत्पश्चात् बलि दे।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच एवमूर्ध्वतरं स्थानं त्वयावाप्तं महीपते । एतांश्च नरकात् पश्य विमुक्तान् पापकारिणः
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca evamūrdhvataraṃ sthānaṃ tvayāvāptaṃ mahīpate / etāṃśca narakāt paśya vimuktān pāpakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा और विश्वेदेवोंके उद्देश्यसे घरके मध्यभागमें बलि (पूजोपहार) अर्पण करे। पूर्व और उत्तरके कोणमें मन्वन्तरके लिये बलि प्रस्तुत करे। पूर्व दिशामें इन्द्रको, दक्षिण दिशामें यमको, पश्चिममें वरुणको तथा उत्तरमें सोमको बलि दे। घरके दरवाजेपर धाता और विधाताके लिये बलि अर्पण करे। घरके बाहर चारों
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच ततो ऽपतत् पुष्पवृष्टिस्तस्योपरि महीपतेः । विमानञ्चाधिरोप्यैनं स्वर्लोकमनयद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca tato 'patat puṣpavṛṣṭistasyopari mahīpateḥ / vimānañcādhiropyainaṃ svarlokamanayaddhariḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: ओर अर्यमा देवताके निमित्त बलि प्रस्तुत करे। निशाचरों और भूतोंको आकाशमें बलि दे। गृहस्थ पुरुष एकाग्रचित्त हो दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर मुँह करके तत्परतापूर्वक पितरोंके उद्देश्यसे पिण्ड दे। तदनन्तर विद्वान् पुरुष जल लेकर उन्हीं-उन्हीं स्थानोंपर उन्हीं-उन्हीं देवताओंके उद्देश्स्से आचमनके लिये जल
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: अहञ्चान्ये च ये तत्र यातनाभ्यः परिच्युताः । स्वकर्मफलनिर्दिष्टं ततो जात्यन्तरं गताः
verses.transliteration: ahañcānye ca ye tatra yātanābhyaḥ paricyutāḥ / svakarmaphalanirdiṣṭaṃ tato jātyantaraṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: छोड़े। इस प्रकार गृहस्थ पुरुष घरमें पवित्रतापूर्वक गृह-देवताओंके उद्देश्यसे बलि देकर अन्य भूतोंकी तृप्तिके लिये आदरपूर्वक अन्नका त्याग करे। कुत्तों,
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: एवमेते समाख्याता नरका द्विजसत्तम । येन येन च पापेन यां यां योनिमुपैति वै
verses.transliteration: evamete samākhyātā narakā dvijasattama / yena yena ca pāpena yāṃ yāṃ yonimupaiti vai
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: चाण्डालों तथा पक्षियोंके लिये पृथ्वीपर अन्न रख दे। यह वैश्वदेव नामक कर्म है। इसे प्रात:काल और सायंकाल आवश्यक बताया गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: तत् तत् सर्वं समाख्यातं यथा दृष्टं मया पुरा । पुरानुभवजं ज्ञानमवाप्यावितथं तव । अतः परं महाभाग किमन्यत् कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: tat tat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā purā / purānubhavajaṃ jñānamavāpyāvitathaṃ tava / ataḥ paraṃ mahābhāga kimanyat kathayāmi te
verses.translation: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.hindi: इसके बाद बुद्धिमान् पुछष आचमन करके कुछ कालतक अतिथिकी प्रतीक्षा करते हुए घरके दरवाजेकी ओर दृष्टि रखे। यदि कोई अतिथि वहाँ आ जाय तो यथाशक्ति अन्न, जल, गन्ध, पुष्प आदिके द्वारा उसका सत्कार करे। अपने ग्रामवासी पुरुषको या मित्रको अतिथि न बनाये। जिसके कुल और नाम
verses.wordMeaning: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these
verses.commentary: Sense: And what deed have they done? Explain this abominable thing. Likewise they are tearing out the tongue from these

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे पितापुत्रसंवादो नाम पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः षोडशो ऽध्यायः पितावाच कथितं मे त्वया वत्स संसारस्य व्यवस्थितम् । स्वरूपमतिहेयस्य घटीयन्त्रवदव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvādo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ pitāvāca kathitaṃ me tvayā vatsa saṃsārasya vyavasthitam / svarūpamatiheyasya ghaṭīyantravadavyayam
verses.translation: Having heard the Rishi speak thus, king Arjtma, Knta- virya’s son, proceeded to Dattatreya’s hermitage and wor- 2' shipped him with faith; by kneading his feet and other services, and by offering honey and other delicacies, and by bring- ing garlands, sandal, and other perfumes, water, fruit (tc.; S' also with preparations of rice, and by removing the Rishi’s fragments of food. Pleased therewith the Muni addressed the
verses.hindi: आदिका ज्ञान न हो, जो उसी समय वहाँ उपस्थित हुआ हो, भोजनकी इच्छा रखता हो, थका-माँदा आया हो, अन्न माँगता हो, ऐसे अकिज्चन ब्राह्मणको अतिथि कहते हैं। विद्वान् पुरुषोंको उचित है कि वे अपनी शक्तिके अनुसार उस अतिथिका पूजन करें। उसका गोत्र और शाखा न पूछें। उसने कहाँतक अध्ययन
verses.wordMeaning: Having heard the Rishi speak thus, king Arjtma, Knta- virya’s son, proceeded to Dattatreya’s hermitage and wor- 2' shipped him with faith; by kneading his feet and other services, and by offering honey and other delicacies, and by bring- ing garlands, sandal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having heard the Rishi speak thus, king Arjtma, Knta- virya’s son, proceeded to Dattatreya’s hermitage and wor- 2' shipped him with faith; by kneading his feet and other services, and by offering honey and other delicacies, and by bring- ing garlands, sandal,…

verses.sanskrit: तदेवमेतदखिलं मयावगतमीदृशम् । किं मया वद कर्तव्यमेवस्मिन् व्यवस्थिते
verses.transliteration: tadevametadakhilaṃ mayāvagatamīdṛśam / kiṃ mayā vada kartavyamevasmin vyavasthite
verses.translation: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.
verses.hindi: किया है, इसकी जिज्ञासा भी न करें। उसकी आकृति सुन्दर हो या असुन्दर, उसे साक्षात् प्रजापति समझें। वह नित्य स्थित नहीं रहता, इसीलिये उसे अतिथि कहते हैं। उसकी तृप्ति होनेपर गृहस्थ पुरुष मनुष्य-यज्ञके ऋणसे मुक्त हो जाता है। जो उस अतिथिको अन्न दिये बिना ही स्वयं भोजन करता है, वह मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच यदि मद्वचनं तात श्रद्दधास्यविशङ्कितः । तत् परित्यज्य गार्हस्थ्यं वानप्रस्थपरो भव
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca yadi madvacanaṃ tāta śraddadhāsyaviśaṅkitaḥ / tat parityajya gārhasthyaṃ vānaprasthaparo bhava
verses.translation: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,
verses.hindi: पापभोजी है; वह केवल पाप भोजन करता है और दूसरे जन्ममें उसे विष्ठा खानी पड़ती है। अतिथि जिसके घरसे निराश होकर लौटता है, उसको अपना पाप दे स्वयं उसका पुण्य लेकर चल देता है। अतः मनुष्यको उचित है कि वह जल और साग देकर अथवा स्वयं जो कुछ खाता है, उसीसे अपनी शक्तिके
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,

verses.sanskrit: तमनुष्ठाय विधिवद् विहायाग्निपरिग्रहम् । आत्मन्यात्मानमाधया निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: tamanuṣṭhāya vidhivad vihāyāgniparigraham / ātmanyātmānamādhayā nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ
verses.translation: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.
verses.hindi: अनुसार आदरपूर्वक अतिथिका पूजन करे।
verses.wordMeaning: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: king in the very same way, as he had formerly addressed the gods.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तराशी वश्यात्मा भव भिक्षुरतन्द्रितः । तत्र योगापरो भूत्वा बाह्यस्पर्शविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ekāntarāśī vaśyātmā bhava bhikṣuratandritaḥ / tatra yogāparo bhūtvā bāhyasparśavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थ पुरुष प्रतिदिन पितरोंके उद्देश्यसे अन्न और जलके द्वारा श्राद्ध करे और अनेक या एक ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराये। अन्नमेंसे अग्राशन निकालकर ब्राह्मणको दे। ब्रह्मचारी और संन्यासी जब भिक्षा माँगनेके लिये आयें, तब उन्हें भिक्षा अवश्य दे। एक ग्रास अन्नको भिक्षा, चार ग्रास अन्नको अग्राशन और
verses.wordMeaning: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राप्स्यति तं योगं दुः शसंयोगभेषजम् । मुक्तिहेतुमनौपम्यमनाख्येयमसङ्गिनम् । यत्संयोगान्न ते योगो भूयो भूतैर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāpsyati taṃ yogaṃ duḥ śasaṃyogabheṣajam / muktihetumanaupamyamanākhyeyamasaṅginam / yatsaṃyogānna te yogo bhūyo bhūtairbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,
verses.hindi: अग्राशनसे चौगुने अन्नको श्रेष्ठ द्विज हन्तकार कहते हैं। भोजनमेंसे अपने वैभवके अनुसार हन्तकार, अग्राशन अथवा भिक्षा दिये बिना कदापि उसे ग्रहण न करे। अतिथियोंका पूजन करनेके बाद प्रियजनों, कुटुम्बियों, भाई-बन्धुओं, याचकों, आकुल व्यक्तियों, बालकों, वृद्धों तथा रोगियोंको भोजन कराये। इनके
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Muni addressed him; and Arjuna Kdrtavirya, calling that speech of Garga’s, replied then, bowing before him,

verses.sanskrit: पितावाच वत्स योगं ममाचक्ष्व मुक्तिहेतुमतः परम् । येन भूतैः पुनर्भूतो नेदृगः खमवाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration: pitāvāca vatsa yogaṃ mamācakṣva muktihetumataḥ param / yena bhūtaiḥ punarbhūto nedṛgaḥ khamavāpnuyām
verses.translation: " Why dost thou beguile mo, my lord, resorting to thy illusory devices. Sinless thou art, and this brahman lady is
verses.hindi: अतिरिक्त यदि कोई दूसरा अकिज्चन मनुष्य भी भूखसे व्याकुल होकर अन्नकी याचना करता हो तो गृहस्थ पुरुष वैभव होनेपर उसे अवश्य भोजन कराये। जो सजातीय बन्धु अपने किसी धनी सजातीयके पास जाकर भी भोजनका कष्ट पाता है, वह उस कष्टकी अवस्थामें जो पाप कर बैठता है, उसे वह धनी मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: " Why dost thou beguile mo, my lord, resorting to thy illusory devices. Sinless thou art, and this brahman lady is
verses.commentary: Sense: " Why dost thou beguile mo, my lord, resorting to thy illusory devices. Sinless thou art, and this brahman lady is

verses.sanskrit: यत्रासक्तिपरस्यात्मा मम संसारबन्धनैः । नैति योगमयोगो ऽपि तं योगमधुना वद
verses.transliteration: yatrāsaktiparasyātmā mama saṃsārabandhanaiḥ / naiti yogamayogo 'pi taṃ yogamadhunā vada
verses.translation: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.
verses.hindi: भी भोगता है। सायंकालमें भी इसी नियमका पालन करे। सूर्यास्त होनेपर जो
verses.wordMeaning: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus invoked, the benign brahman answered him, the illus* trious Kartavirya, the subduer of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: संसारादित्यतापार्ति-विप्लुष्यद्देहमानसम् । ब्रह्मज्ञानाम्बुशीतेन सिञ्च मां वाक्यवारिणा
verses.transliteration: saṃsārādityatāpārti-vipluṣyaddehamānasam / brahmajñānāmbuśītena siñca māṃ vākyavāriṇā
verses.translation: " Choose thou a boon; since thou hast declared my secret, I have felt thereby intense gratification in thee to-day,
verses.hindi: अतिथि वहाँ आ जाय, उसकी यथाशक्ति शय्या, आसन और भोजनके द्वारा पूजा करे। बेटा! जो इस प्रकार अपने कंधोंपर रखा हुआ गृहस्थाश्रमका भार ढोता है, उसके लिये स्वयं ब्रह्माजी, देवता, पितर, महर्षि, अतिथि, बन्धु-बान्धव, पशु-पक्षी तथा छोटे-छोटे कीड़े भी, जो उसके अन्नसे तृप्त हुए रहते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: " Choose thou a boon; since thou hast declared my secret, I have felt thereby intense gratification in thee to-day,
verses.commentary: Sense: " Choose thou a boon; since thou hast declared my secret, I have felt thereby intense gratification in thee to-day,

verses.sanskrit: अविद्याकृष्णसर्पेण दष्टं तद्विषपीडितम् । स्ववाक्यामृतपानेन मां जीवय पुनर्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: avidyākṛṣṇasarpeṇa daṣṭaṃ tadviṣapīḍitam / svavākyāmṛtapānena māṃ jīvaya punarmṛtam
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: कल्याणकी वर्षा करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र-दार-गृह-क्षेत्र-ममत्वनिगजडार्दितम् । मां मोचयेष्टसद्भाव-विज्ञानोद्घाटनैस्त्वरन्
verses.transliteration: putra-dāra-gṛha-kṣetra-mamatvanigajaḍārditam / māṃ mocayeṣṭasadbhāva-vijñānodghāṭanaistvaran
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: ३. देवपूजा, अग्निहोत्र तथा यज्ञ-यागादि कर्म “इष्ट” कहलाते हैं। २. कुआँ और बावली खुदवाना, बगीचे लगवाना तथा धर्मशाला बनवाना आदि कार्य 'आपूर्त” धर्मके अन्तर्गत हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच शृणु तात ! यथा योगो दत्तात्रेयेण धीमता । अलर्काय पुरा प्रोक्तः सम्यक् पृष्टेन विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca śṛṇu tāta ! yathā yogo dattātreyeṇa dhīmatā / alarkāya purā proktaḥ samyak pṛṣṭena vistarāt
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: २-ग्रासप्रमाणा भिक्षा स्यादग्रं ग्रासचतुष्टयम् । अग्रं चतुर्गुणं प्राहु्न्तकारं द्विजोत्तमा: ।।
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच दत्तात्रेयः सुतः कस्य कथं वा योगमुक्तवान् । कश्चालर्को महाभागो यो यौगं परिपृष्टवान्
verses.transliteration: pitovāca dattātreyaḥ sutaḥ kasya kathaṃ vā yogamuktavān / kaścālarko mahābhāgo yo yaugaṃ paripṛṣṭavān
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध-कर्मका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच कौशिको ब्राह्मणः कश्चित् प्रतिष्ठाने ऽभवत् पुरे । सो ऽन्यजन्मकृतैः पापैः कुष्ठरोगातुरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: putra uvāca kauśiko brāhmaṇaḥ kaścit pratiṣṭhāne 'bhavat pure / so 'nyajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpaiḥ kuṣṭharogāturo 'bhavat
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: मदालसा बोली--बेटा! गृहस्थके कर्म तीन प्रकारके हैं। नित्य, नैमित्तिक तथा नित्यनैमित्तिक। इनका वर्णन सुनो। पञठ्चयज्ञसम्बन्धी कर्म, जिसका अभी वर्णन किया है, नित्य कहलाता है। पुत्र-जन्म आदिके उपलक्षमें किये हुए कर्मको नैमित्तिक कहते हैं। पर्वके अवसरपर जो श्राद्ध आदि किये जाते हैं, उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: तं तथा व्याधितं भार्या पतिं देवमिवार्च्चयत् । पादाभ्यङ्गाङ्गसंवाह-स्त्रानाच्छादनभोजनैः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tathā vyādhitaṃ bhāryā patiṃ devamivārccayat / pādābhyaṅgāṅgasaṃvāha-strānācchādanabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: विद्वान् पुरुषोंको नित्यनैमित्तिक कर्म समझना चाहिए। उनमेंसे नैमित्तिक कर्मका वर्णन करती हूँ। आभ्युदयिक श्राद्ध नैमित्तिक कर्म है, जिसे पुत्र-जन्मके अवसरपर जातकर्म संस्कारके साथ करना चाहिए। विवाह आदिमें भी, जिस क्रमसे वह बताया गया है, भलीभाँति उसका अनुष्ठान करना उचित है।
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.commentary: Sense: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod

verses.sanskrit: श्लेष्म-मूत्र-पुरीषासृक्-प्रवाहक्षालनेन च । रहश्चैवोपचारेण प्रियसम्भाषणेन च
verses.transliteration: śleṣma-mūtra-purīṣāsṛk-pravāhakṣālanena ca / rahaścaivopacāreṇa priyasambhāṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
verses.hindi: नानदीमुख नामके जो पितर हैं, उनन्‍्हींका इसमें पूजन करना चाहिए और उन्हें दधिमिश्रित जौके पिण्ड देने चाहिए। उस समय यजमानको एकाग्रचित्त होकर उत्तर या पूर्वकी ओर मुँह करके बैठना चाहिए। कुछ लोगोंका मत है कि इसमें बलिवैश्वदेव कर्म नहीं होता। आभ्युदयिक श्राद्धमें युग्म ब्राह्मणोंको निमन्त्रित
verses.wordMeaning: king. And the men who shall worship me with perfumes, garlands and such like, with offerings also of meat and strod
