verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi tasya pālayato mahīm / dharmārthakāmasaktasya jagmurekamaharyathā
verses.translation: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.
verses.hindi: सकता, वह भी तुम्हीं हो। देवि! तुम्हीं संध्या, सावित्री तथा परम जननी हो। देवि! तुम्हीं इस विश्व ब्रह्माण्डको धारण करती हो। तुमसे ही इस जगत्की सृष्टि होती है। तुम्हींसे इसका पालन होता है और सदा तुम्हीं कल्पके अन्तमें सबको अपना ग्रास बना लेती हो। जगन्मयी देवि! इस जगत्की उत्पत्तिके समय तुम सृष्टिरूपा हो, पालन-कालमें स्थितिरूपा हो तथा
verses.wordMeaning: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.
verses.commentary: Sense: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यं नास्य सञ्जज्ञे भुञ्जतो विषयान् प्रियान् । न चाप्यलमभूत्तस्य धर्मार्थोपार्जनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: vairāgyaṃ nāsya sañjajñe bhuñjato viṣayān priyān / na cāpyalamabhūttasya dharmārthopārjanaṃ prati
verses.translation: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff
verses.hindi: कल्पान्तके समय संहार-रूप धारण करनेवाली हो। तुम्हीं महाविद्या, महामाया, महामेधा, महास्मृति, महामोह-रूपा, महादेवी और महासुरी हो। तुम्हीं तीनों गुणोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाली सबकी प्रकृति हो। भयंकर कालरात्रि, महारात्रि और मोहरात्रि भी तुम्हीं हो। तुम्हीं श्री, तुम्हीं
verses.wordMeaning: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff
verses.commentary: Sense: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff

verses.sanskrit: तं तथा भोगसंसर्ग-प्रमत्तमजितेन्द्रियम् । सुबाहुर्नाम शुश्राव भ्राता तस्य वनेचरः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tathā bhogasaṃsarga-pramattamajitendriyam / subāhurnāma śuśrāva bhrātā tasya vanecaraḥ
verses.translation: and while he meditated, another came into existence; now this^ the third, was the group of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards it was characterized chiefly by good- ness. Those beings abound in pleasure and affection; they
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाली हो। बाण, भुशुण्डी और परिघ--ये भी तुम्हारे अस्त्र हैं। तुम सौम्य और सौम्यतर हो--इतना ही नहीं, जितने भी सौम्य एवं सुन्दर पदार्थ हैं, उन सबकी अपेक्षा तुम अत्यधिक सुन्दरी हो। पर और अपर--सबसे परे रहनेवाली परमेश्वरी तुम्हीं हो। सर्वस्वरूपे देवि! कहीं भी सत्-असत्रूप जो कुछ वस्तुएँ हैं और उन सबकी जो शक्ति है, वह तुम्हीं
verses.wordMeaning: and while he meditated, another came into existence; now this^ the third, was the group of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards it was characterized chiefly by good- ness. Those beings abound in pleasure and affection; they
verses.commentary: Sense: and while he meditated, another came into existence; now this^ the third, was the group of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards it was characterized chiefly by good- ness. Those beings abound in pleasure and affection; they

verses.sanskrit: तं बुबोधयिषुः सो ऽथ चिरं ध्यात्वा महीपतिः । तद्वैरिसंश्रयं तस्य श्रेयो ऽमन्यत भूपतेः
verses.transliteration: taṃ bubodhayiṣuḥ so 'tha ciraṃ dhyātvā mahīpatiḥ / tadvairisaṃśrayaṃ tasya śreyo 'manyata bhūpateḥ
verses.translation: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-
verses.hindi: हो। ऐसी अवस्थामें तुम्हारी स्तुति क्या हो सकती है। जो इस जगतकी सृष्टि, पालन और संहार करते हैं, उन भगवान्को भी जब तुमने निद्राके अधीन कर दिया है तो तुम्हारी स्तुति करनेमें यहाँ कौन समर्थ हो सकता है। मुझको, भगवान् शंकरको तथा भगवान् विष्णुको भी तुमने ही शरीर धारण कराया है; अतः तुम्हारी स्तुति करनेकी शक्ति किसमें है। देवि!
verses.wordMeaning: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-
verses.commentary: Sense: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-

verses.sanskrit: ततः स काशिभूपालमुदीर्णबलवाहनम् । स्वराज्यं प्राप्तुमागच्छद् बहुशः शरणं कृती
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kāśibhūpālamudīrṇabalavāhanam / svarājyaṃ prāptumāgacchad bahuśaḥ śaraṇaṃ kṛtī
verses.translation: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.
verses.hindi: तुम तो अपने इन उदार प्रभावोंसे ही प्रशंसित हो। ये जो दोनों दुर्धर्ष असुर मधु और कैटभ हैं, इनको मोहमें डाल दो और जगदीश्वर भगवान् विष्णुको शीघ्र ही जगा दो। साथ ही इनके भीतर इन दोनों महान् असुरोंको मार डालनेकी बुद्धि उत्पन्न कर दो  ७३-८७ ।। ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ ८८ ॥/
verses.wordMeaning: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि चक्रे बलोद्योगमलर्कं प्रति पार्थिवः । दूतञ्च प्रेषयामास राज्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration: so 'pi cakre balodyogamalarkaṃ prati pārthivaḥ / dūtañca preṣayāmāsa rājyamasmai pradīyatām
verses.translation: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called
verses.hindi: एवं स्तुता तदा देवी तामसी तत्र वेधसा ।। ८९ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called
verses.commentary: Sense: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि नैच्छत्तदा दातुमाज्ञापूर्वं स्वधर्मवित् । प्रत्युवाच च तं दूतमलर्कः काशिभूभृतः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi naicchattadā dātumājñāpūrvaṃ svadharmavit / pratyuvāca ca taṃ dūtamalarkaḥ kāśibhūbhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "tiryak-srotas"'*' and "tally ag-yonya.’’ Next was the sixth creation^ that of the " urdhva-srotas’’;t it is known as the creation of the gods. Then the creation of the " arvdk-srotas "
verses.hindi: नेत्रास्यनासिकाबाहुह्नदये भ्यस्तथोरस: ।। ९० ।।
verses.wordMeaning: "tiryak-srotas"'*' and "tally ag-yonya.’’ Next was the sixth creation^ that of the " urdhva-srotas’’;t it is known as the creation of the gods. Then the creation of the " arvdk-srotas "

verses.sanskrit: मामेवाभ्येत्य हार्देन याचतां राज्यमग्रजः । नाक्रान्त्या संप्रदास्यामि भयेनाल्पामपि क्षितिम्
verses.transliteration: māmevābhyetya hārdena yācatāṃ rājyamagrajaḥ / nākrāntyā saṃpradāsyāmi bhayenālpāmapi kṣitim
verses.translation: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.
verses.hindi: निर्गम्य दर्शने तस्थौ ब्रह्मणो5व्यक्तजन्मन: ।
verses.wordMeaning: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.
verses.commentary: Sense: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.

verses.sanskrit: सुबाहुरपि नो याञ्चां चकार मतिमांस्तदा । न धर्मः क्षत्रियस्येति याञ्चा वीर्यधनो हि सः
verses.transliteration: subāhurapi no yāñcāṃ cakāra matimāṃstadā / na dharmaḥ kṣatriyasyeti yāñcā vīryadhano hi saḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: एकार्णवेडहिशयनात्तत: स ददृशे च तौ ।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समस्तसैन्येन काशीशः परिवारितः । आक्रान्तुमभ्यगाद्राष्ट्रमलर्कस्य महीपतेः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samastasainyena kāśīśaḥ parivāritaḥ / ākrāntumabhyagādrāṣṭramalarkasya mahīpateḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: क्रोधरक्तेक्षणावत्तुं ब्रह्माणं जनितोद्यमौ
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरैश्च संश्लेषमभ्येत्य तदनन्तरम् । तेषामन्यतमैर्भृत्यैः समाक्रम्यानयद्वशम्
verses.transliteration: anantaraiśca saṃśleṣamabhyetya tadanantaram / teṣāmanyatamairbhṛtyaiḥ samākramyānayadvaśam
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: समुत्थाय ततस्ताभ्यां युयुधे भगवान् हरि: ॥। ९३ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: अपीडयंश्च सामान्तांस्तस्य राष्ट्रोपरोधनैः । तथा दुर्गानुपालांश्च चक्रे चाटविकान् वशे
verses.transliteration: apīḍayaṃśca sāmāntāṃstasya rāṣṭroparodhanaiḥ / tathā durgānupālāṃśca cakre cāṭavikān vaśe
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: उक्तवन्तौ वरोस्मत्तो व्रियतामिति केशवम् ।। ९५ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: कांश्चिच्चोपप्रदानेन कांश्चिद् भेदेन पार्थिवान् । साम्नैवान्यान् वशं निन्ये निभृतास्तस्य ये ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: kāṃściccopapradānena kāṃścid bhedena pārthivān / sāmnaivānyān vaśaṃ ninye nibhṛtāstasya ye 'bhavan
verses.translation: Sion. Hence they have abundance of suffering, and are con- tinuously engaged in action; and they possess light externally and internally. They are mankind and are capable of causation.!8 Auugrahall was the fifth creation; it is disposed in four ways, by contrariety,! and by perfection,** bytranquillity,tt
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--  ८८ ।। राजन! जब ब्रह्माजीने वहाँ मधु और कैटभको मारनेके उद्देश्यसे भगवान् विष्णुको जगानेके लिये तमोगुणकी अधिष्ठात्री देवी योगनिद्राकी इस प्रकार स्तुति की, तब वे भगवानके नेत्र, मुख, नासिका, बाहु, हृदय और वक्ष:स्थलसे निकलकर अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माजीकी दृष्टिके समक्ष खड़ी हो गयीं। योगनिद्रासे मुक्त होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Sion. Hence they have abundance of suffering, and are con- tinuously engaged in action; and they possess light externally and internally. They are mankind and are capable of causation.!8 Auugrahall was the fifth creation; it is disposed in four ways,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sion. Hence they have abundance of suffering, and are con- tinuously engaged in action; and they possess light externally and internally. They are mankind and are capable of causation.!8 Auugrahall was the fifth creation; it is disposed in four ways,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सो ऽल्पबलो राजा परचक्रावपीजितः । कोषक्षयमवापोच्चैः पुरञ्चारुध्यतारिणा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ so 'lpabalo rājā paracakrāvapījitaḥ / koṣakṣayamavāpoccaiḥ purañcārudhyatāriṇā
verses.translation: He considered that creation incapable of causation, § and thought of creating another yet. While he was meditating on its creation, the animal world, in which the stream of life||
verses.hindi: जगतके स्वामी भगवान् जनार्दन उस एकार्णवके जलमें शेषनागकी शय्यासे जाग उठे। फिर उन्होंने उन दोनों असुरोंको देखा। वे दुरात्मा मधु और कैटभ अत्यन्त बलवान तथा पराक्रमी थे और क्रोधसे लाल आँखें किये ब्रह्माजीको खा जानेके लिये उद्योग कर रहे थे। तब भगवान् श्रीहरिने उठकर उन दोनोंके साथ पाँच हजार वर्षोतक केवल बाहुयुद्ध किया। वे
verses.wordMeaning: He considered that creation incapable of causation, § and thought of creating another yet. While he was meditating on its creation, the animal world, in which the stream of life||
verses.commentary: Sense: He considered that creation incapable of causation, § and thought of creating another yet. While he was meditating on its creation, the animal world, in which the stream of life||

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सम्पीड्यमानस्तु क्षीणकोषो दिने दिने । विषादमागात्परमं व्याकुलत्वञ्च चेतसः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sampīḍyamānastu kṣīṇakoṣo dine dine / viṣādamāgātparamaṃ vyākulatvañca cetasaḥ
verses.translation: and by satisfaction:: likewise. The objects of this creation moreover have knowledge of the past and of the present.
verses.hindi: दोनों भी अत्यन्त बलके कारण उन्मत्त हो रहे थे। इधर महामायाने भी उन्हें मोहमें डाल रखा था; इसलिये वे भगवान् विष्णुसे कहने लगे--“हम तुम्हारी वीरतासे संतुष्ट हैं। तुम हमलोगोंसे कोई वर माँगो”  ८९-९५ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: and by satisfaction:: likewise. The objects of this creation moreover have knowledge of the past and of the present.
verses.commentary: Sense: and by satisfaction:: likewise. The objects of this creation moreover have knowledge of the past and of the present.

verses.sanskrit: आर्ति स परमां प्राप्य तत् सस्माराङ्गुलीयकम् । यदुद्दिश्य पुरा प्राह माता तस्य मदालसा
verses.transliteration: ārti sa paramāṃ prāpya tat sasmārāṅgulīyakam / yaduddiśya purā prāha mātā tasya madālasā
verses.translation: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥/ ९६ ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.
verses.commentary: Sense: ranee apd are unintelligent; and they stray in wrong courses and in their ignorance are subservient to knowledge; they are self-swayed, and devoted to self; they comprise twenty.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्त्रातः शुचिर्भूत्वा वाचयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् । निष्कृष्य शासनं तस्माद्ददृशे प्रस्फुटाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ strātaḥ śucirbhūtvā vācayitvā dvijottamān / niṣkṛṣya śāsanaṃ tasmāddadṛśe prasphuṭākṣaram
verses.translation: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवान् बोले-- ।। ९६  यदि तुम दोनों मुझपर प्रसन्न हो तो अब मेरे हाथसे मारे जाओ। बस, इतना-सा ही मैंने वर माँगा है। यहाँ दूसरे किसी वरसे क्‍या लेना है ।। ९७-९८ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff
verses.commentary: Sense: eight classes. They all possess light* internally, but they are mutually circumscribed. ff

verses.transliteration: tatraiva likhitaṃ mātrā vācayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / prakāśapulakāṅgo 'sau praharṣotphullalocanaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: and while he meditated, another came into existence; now this^ the third, was the group of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards it was characterized chiefly by good- ness. Those beings abound in pleasure and affection; they
verses.commentary: Sense: and while he meditated, another came into existence; now this^ the third, was the group of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards it was characterized chiefly by good- ness. Those beings abound in pleasure and affection; they

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गः सर्वात्मना त्याज्यः स चेत्त्यक्तुं न शक्यते । स सदिभः सह कर्तव्यः सतां सङ्गो हि भेषजम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgaḥ sarvātmanā tyājyaḥ sa cettyaktuṃ na śakyate / sa sadibhaḥ saha kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṅgo hi bheṣajam
verses.translation: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-
verses.hindi: विलोक्य ताभ्यां गदितो भगवान् कमलेक्षण:३
verses.wordMeaning: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-
verses.commentary: Sense: are uncircumscribed outwardly and inwardly; and possess light* externally and internally; they originated from an up- ward stream of life. Now that third creation of the Being who was satisfied in soul thereat is known as the crea-

verses.sanskrit: कामः सर्वात्मना हेयो हातुञ्चेच्छक्यते न सः । मुमुक्षां प्रति तत्कार्यं सैव तस्यापि भेषजम्
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ sarvātmanā heyo hātuñcecchakyate na saḥ / mumukṣāṃ prati tatkāryaṃ saiva tasyāpi bheṣajam
verses.translation: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--  ९९ ।। इस प्रकार धोखेमें आ जानेपर जब उन्होंने सम्पूर्ण जगत्में जल-ही-जल देखा तब कमलनयन भगवानसे कहा--“जहाँ पृथ्वी जलमें डूबी हुई न हो--जहाँ सूखा स्थान हो, वहीं हमारा वध करो”  १००-१०१ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: tion of the gods. When that creation came into beiug, Brahma was pleased.

verses.sanskrit: वाचयित्वा तु बहुशो नृणां श्रेयः कथं त्विति । मुमुक्षयेति निश्चित्य सा च तत्सङ्गतो यतः
verses.transliteration: vācayitvā tu bahuśo nṛṇāṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ tviti / mumukṣayeti niścitya sā ca tatsaṅgato yataḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स साधुसम्पर्कं चिन्तयन् पृथिवीपतिः । दत्तात्रेयं महाभागमगच्छत् परमार्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sādhusamparkaṃ cintayan pṛthivīpatiḥ / dattātreyaṃ mahābhāgamagacchat paramārtimān
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: एवमेषा समुत्पन्ना ब्रह्मणा संस्तुता स्वयम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: तं समेत्य महात्मानमकल्पषमसङ्गिनम् । प्रणिपत्याभिसम्पूज्य यथान्यायमभाषत
verses.transliteration: taṃ sametya mahātmānamakalpaṣamasaṅginam / praṇipatyābhisampūjya yathānyāyamabhāṣata
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: प्रभावमस्या देव्यास्तु भूय: शूणु वदामि ते ॥। ऐं 35  १०४ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् ! कुरु प्रसादं मे शरणं शरणार्थिनाम् । दुः खापहारं कुरु मे दुः खार्तस्यातिकामिनः
verses.transliteration: brahman ! kuru prasādaṃ me śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthinām / duḥ khāpahāraṃ kuru me duḥ khārtasyātikāminaḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं-- ।। १०२ ॥। तब “तथास्तु' कहकर शड्ख, चक्र और गदा धारण करनेवाले भगवानने उन दोनोंके मस्तक अपनी जाँघपर रखकर चक्रसे काट डाले। इस प्रकार ये देवी महामाया ब्रह्माजीकी स्तुति करनेपर स्वयं प्रकट हुई थीं। अब पुनः तुमसे उनके प्रभावका वर्णन करता हूँ, सुनो  १०३-१०४ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: दुः खापहारमद्यैव करोमि तव पार्थिव ! । सत्यं ब्रूहि किमर्थं ते दुः खं तत् पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: duḥ khāpahāramadyaiva karomi tava pārthiva ! / satyaṃ brūhi kimarthaṃ te duḥ khaṃ tat pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: जड उवाच इत्युक्तश्चिन्तयामास स राजा तेन धीमता । त्रिविधस्यापि दुः खस्य स्थानमात्मानमेव च
verses.transliteration: jaḍa uvāca ityuktaścintayāmāsa sa rājā tena dhīmatā / trividhasyāpi duḥ khasya sthānamātmānameva ca
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणमें सावर्णिक मन्वन्तरकी कथाके अन्तर्गत
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: स विमृष्य चिरं राजा पुनः पुनरुदारधीः । आत्मानमात्मना धीरः प्रहस्येदमथाब्रावीत्
verses.transliteration: sa vimṛṣya ciraṃ rājā punaḥ punarudāradhīḥ / ātmānamātmanā dhīraḥ prahasyedamathābrāvīt
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: १. 3० चण्डीदेवीको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: नाहमुर्वो न सलिलं न ज्योतिरनिलो न च । नाकाशं किन्तु शारीरं समेत्य सुखमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: nāhamurvo na salilaṃ na jyotiranilo na ca / nākāśaṃ kintu śārīraṃ sametya sukhamiṣyate
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: २. 'कोलाविध्वंसी” यह किसी विशेष कुलके क्षत्रियोंकी संज्ञा है। दक्षिणमें “कोला” नगरी प्रसिद्ध है, वह प्राचीन कालमें राजधानी थी। जिन क्षत्रियोंने उसपर आक्रमण करके उसका विध्वंस किया, वे “कोलाविध्वंसी” कहलाये।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: न्यूनातिरिक्ततां याति पञ्चके ऽस्मिन् सुखासुखम् । यदि स्यान्म किन्न स्यादन्यस्थे ऽपि हि तन्मयि
verses.transliteration: nyūnātiriktatāṃ yāti pañcake 'smin sukhāsukham / yadi syānma kinna syādanyasthe 'pi hi tanmayi
verses.translation: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called
verses.wordMeaning: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called
verses.commentary: Sense: ceded. The " raukhya" creation was the fourth, the makliya things are known as immoveable. The fifth was that called

verses.sanskrit: नित्यप्रभूतसद्भावे न्यूनाधिक्यान्नतोन्नते । तथा च ममतात्यक्ते विशेषो नोपलभ्यते
verses.transliteration: nityaprabhūtasadbhāve nyūnādhikyānnatonnate / tathā ca mamatātyakte viśeṣo nopalabhyate
verses.translation: "tiryak-srotas"'*' and "tally ag-yonya.’’ Next was the sixth creation^ that of the " urdhva-srotas’’;t it is known as the creation of the gods. Then the creation of the " arvdk-srotas "
verses.hindi: . पा०-कर्म चास्याश्च। २. पा०--यत्स्वभावा। ३. पा०--किसी-किसी प्रतिमें इसके बाद ही “ब्रह्मोवाच” है तथा “निद्रां भगवतीम” इस श्लोकार्थके स्थानमें--'स्तौमि निद्रां भगवती विष्णोरतुलतेजस: ।। ” ऐसा पाठ है।
verses.wordMeaning: "tiryak-srotas"'*' and "tally ag-yonya.’’ Next was the sixth creation^ that of the " urdhva-srotas’’;t it is known as the creation of the gods. Then the creation of the " arvdk-srotas "
verses.commentary: Sense: "tiryak-srotas"'*' and "tally ag-yonya.’’ Next was the sixth creation^ that of the " urdhva-srotas’’;t it is known as the creation of the gods. Then the creation of the " arvdk-srotas "

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्रावस्थिते सूक्ष्मे तृतीयांशे च पश्यतः । तथैव भूतसद्भावं शरीरं किं सुखासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tanmātrāvasthite sūkṣme tṛtīyāṃśe ca paśyataḥ / tathaiva bhūtasadbhāvaṃ śarīraṃ kiṃ sukhāsukham
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: ३. पा०-मया। २३. मार्कण्डेयपुराणकी कई प्रतियोंमें यहाँ “प्रीतौ स्वस्तव युद्धेन श्लाध्यस्त्वं मृत्युरावयो: ।” इतना अधिक पाठ है।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: मनस्यवस्थितं दुःखं सुखं वा मानसञ्च यत् । यतस्ततो न मे दुः खं सुखं वा नह्यहं मनः
verses.transliteration: manasyavasthitaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā mānasañca yat / yatastato na me duḥ khaṃ sukhaṃ vā nahyahaṃ manaḥ
verses.translation: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.
verses.hindi: + मध्यमचरित्रस्थ विष्णुर्ऋषिर्महालक्ष्मीदेवता, उष्णिक् छन्‍्द:, शाकम्भरी शक्ति:; दुर्गा बीजम्, वायुस्तत्त्वम, यजुर्वेद: स्वरूपम्, श्रीमहालक्ष्मीप्रीत्यर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.
verses.commentary: Sense: evolved from Prakriti.§ The ninth creation was Prakrita and also Vaikrita; it is known as " Kaumara."|| Thus these nine creations of the Praja-pati have been declared.

verses.sanskrit: नाहङ्कारो न च मनो बुद्धिर्नाहं यतस्ततः । अन्तः करणजं दुः खं पारख्यं मम तत्कथम्
verses.transliteration: nāhaṅkāro na ca mano buddhirnāhaṃ yatastataḥ / antaḥ karaṇajaṃ duḥ khaṃ pārakhyaṃ mama tatkatham
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: ३० मध्यम चरित्रके विष्णु ऋषि, महालक्ष्मी देवता, अष्णिक् छनन्‍्द, शाकम्भरी शक्ति, दुर्गा बीज, वायु तत्त्व और यजुर्वेद स्वरूप है। श्रीमहालक्ष्मीकी प्रसन्नताके लिये मध्यम चरित्रके पाठमें इसका विनियोग है।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं शरीरं न मनो यतो ऽहं पृथक् शरीरान्मनसस्तथाहम् । तत् सन्तु चेतस्यथवापि देहे सुखानि दुः खानि च किं ममात्र
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ śarīraṃ na mano yato 'haṃ pṛthak śarīrānmanasastathāham / tat santu cetasyathavāpi dehe sukhāni duḥ khāni ca kiṃ mamātra
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: ३० अक्षस्रकपरशुं गदेषुकुलिशं पद्म धनुष्कुण्डिकां
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यस्य वाञ्छां सुरुते ऽग्रजो ऽस्य देहस्य चेत् पञ्चमयः स राशिः । गुणप्रवृत्त्या मम किन्नु तत्र तत्स्थः स चाहञ्च शरीरतो ऽन्यः
verses.transliteration: rājyasya vāñchāṃ surute 'grajo 'sya dehasya cet pañcamayaḥ sa rāśiḥ / guṇapravṛttyā mama kinnu tatra tatsthaḥ sa cāhañca śarīrato 'nyaḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: सेवे सैरिभमर्दिनीमिह महालक्ष्मी सरोजस्थिताम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य हस्तादिकमप्यशेषं मांसं न चास्थीनि खिराविभागः । कस्तस्य नागाश्वरथादिकोषैः स्वल्पो ऽपि सम्बन्ध इहास्ति पुंसः
verses.transliteration: na yasya hastādikamapyaśeṣaṃ māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni khirāvibhāgaḥ / kastasya nāgāśvarathādikoṣaiḥ svalpo 'pi sambandha ihāsti puṃsaḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: मैं कमलके आसनपर बैठी हुई महिषासुरमर्दिनी भगवती महालक्ष्मीका भजन करता हूँ, जो अपने हाथोंमें अक्षमाला, फरसा, गदा, बाण, वज्र, पद्म, धनुष, कुण्डिका, दण्ड, शक्ति, खड़्ग, ढाल, शंख, घण्टा, मधुपात्र, शूल, पाश और चक्र धारण करती हैं तथा जिनके श्रीविग्रहकी कान्ति मूँगेके समान लाल है।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्न मे ऽरिर्न च मे ऽस्ति दुः खं न मे सुखं नापि पुरं न कोषम् । न चाश्वनागादि बलं न तस्य नान्यस्य वा कस्यचिद्वा ममास्ति
verses.transliteration: tasmānna me 'rirna ca me 'sti duḥ khaṃ na me sukhaṃ nāpi puraṃ na koṣam / na cāśvanāgādi balaṃ na tasya nānyasya vā kasyacidvā mamāsti
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: यथा घटीकुम्भकमण्डलुस्थम् आकाशमेकं बहुधा हि दृष्टम् । तथा सुबाहुः स च काशिपो ऽहं मल्ये च देहेषु शरीरभेदैः
verses.transliteration: yathā ghaṭīkumbhakamaṇḍalustham ākāśamekaṃ bahudhā hi dṛṣṭam / tathā subāhuḥ sa ca kāśipo 'haṃ malye ca deheṣu śarīrabhedaiḥ
verses.translation: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.hindi: देवासुरमभूुद्धं पूर्णमब्दशतं पुरा ।
verses.wordMeaning: CANTO XLVTII.
verses.commentary: Sense: CANTO XLVTII.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे पितापुत्रसंवादे आत्मविवेको नाम सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः अष्टत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः जड उवाच दत्तात्रेयं ततो विप्रं प्रणिपत्य स पार्थिवः । प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं प्रश्रयावनतो वचः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvāde ātmaviveko nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ aṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca dattātreyaṃ tato vipraṃ praṇipatya sa pārthivaḥ / pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ praśrayāvanato vacaḥ
verses.translation: adorable Sir, right well hast thou related the creation
verses.hindi: महिषे5सुराणामधिपे देवानां च पुरंदरे ।। २ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: adorable Sir, right well hast thou related the creation
verses.commentary: Sense: adorable Sir, right well hast thou related the creation

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् प्रपश्यतो ब्रह्मन् ! मम दुः खं न किञ्चन । असम्यग्दर्शिना मग्नाः सर्वदैवासुखार्णवे
verses.transliteration: samyak prapaśyato brahman ! mama duḥ khaṃ na kiñcana / asamyagdarśinā magnāḥ sarvadaivāsukhārṇave
verses.translation: adorable Sir, right well hast thou related the creation
verses.hindi: तत्रासुरैर्महावीर्यदेवसैन्यं पराजितम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: adorable Sir, right well hast thou related the creation

verses.wordMeaning: who indulges in sexual intercourse during the twilight, 0 brdhman.
verses.commentary: Sense: who indulges in sexual intercourse during the twilight, 0 brdhman.

verses.sanskrit: अपः पूर्वं सकृत् प्राश्य तूष्णीं भूत्वा समाहितः । प्राणायेति ततस्तस्य प्रथमा ह्याहुतिः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: apaḥ pūrvaṃ sakṛt prāśya tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā samāhitaḥ / prāṇāyeti tatastasya prathamā hyāhutiḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: the first daughter was Kuc'a-hard,* the next Vyanjana-hdri.
verses.hindi: लिया ।। ८ ॥। और उसे उस महाहैत्यने भगवती भद्रकालीके ऊपर चलाया। वह शूल आकाशसे गिरते हुए सूर्यमण्डलकी भाँति अपने तेजसे प्रज्वलित हो उठा ।। ९  उस शूलको अपनी ओर आते देख देवीने भी शूलका प्रहार किया। उससे राक्षसके शूलके सैकड़ों टुकड़े हो गये, साथ ही महाहैत्य चिक्षुरकी भी
verses.wordMeaning: the first daughter was Kuc'a-hard,* the next Vyanjana-hdri.
verses.commentary: Sense: the first daughter was Kuc'a-hard,* the next Vyanjana-hdri.

verses.sanskrit: वाग्दण्डः कर्मदण्डश्च मनोदण्डश्च ते त्रयः । यस्यैते नियता दण्डाः स त्रिदण्डी महायतिः
verses.transliteration: vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ / yasyaite niyatā daṇḍāḥ sa tridaṇḍī mahāyatiḥ
verses.translation: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.
verses.hindi: क्रोधमें भरकर एक-दूसरेपर बड़े भयंकर प्रहार करते हुए लड़ने लगे ।। १५ ।। तदनन्तर सिंह बड़े वेगसे आकाशकी ओर उछला और उधरसे गिरते समय उसने पंजोंकी मारसे चामरका सिर धड़से अलग कर दिया ।। १६  इसी प्रकार उदग्र भी शिला और वृक्ष आदिकी मार खाकर रणभूमिमें देवीके हाथसे मारा गया
verses.wordMeaning: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.
verses.commentary: Sense: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमात्ममयं यस्य सदसज्जगदीदृशम् । गुणागुणमयन्तस्य कः प्रियः को नृपाप्रियः

verses.translation: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.

verses.wordMeaning: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.
verses.commentary: Sense: in the world; and the second plucks away§§ one’s good qualities and the friendship that exists among people.

verses.sanskrit: अकारश्च तथोकारो मकारश्चाक्षरत्रयम् । एता एव त्रयो मात्राः सात्त्वराजसतामसाः
verses.transliteration: akāraśca tathokāro makāraścākṣaratrayam / etā eva trayo mātrāḥ sāttvarājasatāmasāḥ
verses.translation: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.
verses.hindi: तत एवाशु पुरुष देवी चिच्छेद सायकै: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणा योगिगम्यान्या चार्धमात्रोर्ध्वसंस्थिता । गान्धारीति च विज्ञेया गान्धारस्वरसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: nirguṇā yogigamyānyā cārdhamātrordhvasaṃsthitā / gāndhārīti ca vijñeyā gāndhārasvarasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: Sainbliuti was the wife of Maric'i ||; she brought forth Paurna-mavsa; he high-souled man had two sons Vi-rajas and 2(1 Parvata; but I will defer mentioning their sons till I detail
verses.hindi: करेण च महासिंह तं चकर्ष जगर्ज च ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sainbliuti was the wife of Maric'i ||; she brought forth Paurna-mavsa; he high-souled man had two sons Vi-rajas and 2(1 Parvata; but I will defer mentioning their sons till I detail
verses.commentary: Sense: Sainbliuti was the wife of Maric'i ||; she brought forth Paurna-mavsa; he high-souled man had two sons Vi-rajas and 2(1 Parvata; but I will defer mentioning their sons till I detail

verses.sanskrit: पिपीलिकागतिस्पर्शा प्रयुक्ता मूर्ध्नि लक्ष्यते । यथा प्रयुक्त ओङ्गारः प्रतिनिर्याति मूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: pipīlikāgatisparśā prayuktā mūrdhni lakṣyate / yathā prayukta oṅgāraḥ pratiniryāti mūrdhani
verses.translation: born of her, S'inibali, and Kuhu, R4ka and Bhanumati.
verses.hindi: कर्षतस्तु करं देवी खड़गेन निरकृन्तत: ।। ३२ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: born of her, S'inibali, and Kuhu, R4ka and Bhanumati.
verses.commentary: Sense: born of her, S'inibali, and Kuhu, R4ka and Bhanumati.

verses.sanskrit: तथोङ्कारमयो योगी त्वक्षरे त्वक्षरो भवेत् । प्राणो धनुः शरो ह्यात्मा ब्रह्म वेध्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tathoṅkāramayo yogī tvakṣare tvakṣaro bhavet / prāṇo dhanuḥ śaro hyātmā brahma vedhyamanuttamam
verses.translation: The latter was my illustrious father. I am his son by Manas vini; Veda-siras is my son, ho was born of Dhdipravati.
verses.hindi: तथैव क्षोभयामास त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।। ३३ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: The latter was my illustrious father. I am his son by Manas vini; Veda-siras is my son, ho was born of Dhdipravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: The latter was my illustrious father. I am his son by Manas vini; Veda-siras is my son, ho was born of Dhdipravati.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमत्तेन वेद्धव्यं शरवत्तन्मयो भवेत् । ओमित्येतत् त्रयो वेदास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रयो ऽग्नयः
verses.transliteration: apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravattanmayo bhavet / omityetat trayo vedāstrayo lokāstrayo 'gnayaḥ
verses.translation: forth three sons, who were Kardama, and Arva-vira and Sahishnn.
verses.hindi: ततः क्रुद्धा जगन्माता चण्डिका पानमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: forth three sons, who were Kardama, and Arva-vira and Sahishnn.
verses.commentary: Sense: forth three sons, who were Kardama, and Arva-vira and Sahishnn.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर्-ब्रह्मा-हरश्चैव ऋक्सामानि यजूंषि च । मात्राः सार्धाश्च तिस्त्रश्च विज्ञेयाः परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇur-brahmā-haraścaiva ṛksāmāni yajūṃṣi ca / mātrāḥ sārdhāśca tistraśca vijñeyāḥ paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: the Balikhilyas, the sixty thousands, which they are, of riahis who live in perpetual chastity.J;
verses.hindi: विषाणाभ्यां च चिक्षेप चण्डिकां प्रति भूधरान् ।। ३५ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: the Balikhilyas, the sixty thousands, which they are, of riahis who live in perpetual chastity.J;
verses.commentary: Sense: the Balikhilyas, the sixty thousands, which they are, of riahis who live in perpetual chastity.J;

verses.sanskrit: तत्र युक्तस्तु यो योगी स तल्लयमवाप्नुयात् । अकारस्त्वथ भूर्लोक उकारश्चोच्यते भुवः
verses.transliteration: tatra yuktastu yo yogī sa tallayamavāpnuyāt / akārastvatha bhūrloka ukāraścocyate bhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Now seven sons were bom of Urjd by Vasishtha,§ Rajas, Gatra and Urdhva-bahu, and Sa-bala, and An-agha, Su-tapas, S'ukta; all these are well-known as seven Rishis.
verses.hindi: साच तानू् प्रहितांस्तेन चूर्णयन्ती शरोत्करै: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Now seven sons were bom of Urjd by Vasishtha,§ Rajas, Gatra and Urdhva-bahu, and Sa-bala, and An-agha, Su-tapas, S'ukta; all these are well-known as seven Rishis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now seven sons were bom of Urjd by Vasishtha,§ Rajas, Gatra and Urdhva-bahu, and Sa-bala, and An-agha, Su-tapas, S'ukta; all these are well-known as seven Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यञ्जनो मकारश्च स्वर्लोकः परिकल्प्यते । व्यक्ता तु प्रथमा मात्रा द्वितीयाव्यक्तसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: savyañjano makāraśca svarlokaḥ parikalpyate / vyaktā tu prathamā mātrā dvitīyāvyaktasaṃjñitā
verses.translation: Agni, who is arrogant, was the eldest son of Brahma; by him Svahall begat three sons of exalted vigour, 0 brdhman, Pavaka, and Pavamdna, and S'uc'i who pervades^ water;
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार अपनी सेनाका संहार होता देख महिषासुरने भैंसेका रूप धारण करके देवीके गणोंको त्रास देना आरम्भ किया ।। २१ ॥। किन्हींको थूथुनसे मारकर, किन्हींके ऊपर खुरोंका प्रहार करके किन्हींको-किन्हींको पूँछसे चोट पहुँचाकर, कुछको सींगोंसे विदीर्ण करके, कुछ गणोंको वेगसे, किन्हींको
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, who is arrogant, was the eldest son of Brahma; by him Svahall begat three sons of exalted vigour, 0 brdhman, Pavaka, and Pavamdna, and S'uc'i who pervades^ water;
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, who is arrogant, was the eldest son of Brahma; by him Svahall begat three sons of exalted vigour, 0 brdhman, Pavaka, and Pavamdna, and S'uc'i who pervades^ water;

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा तृतीया चिच्छक्तिरर्धमात्रा परं पदम् । अनेनैव क्रमेणैता विज्ञेया योगभूमयः
verses.transliteration: mātrā tṛtīyā cicchaktirardhamātrā paraṃ padam / anenaiva krameṇaitā vijñeyā yogabhūmayaḥ
verses.translation: but in descent from them were forty and five others. These and the father and his three sons are often spoken of as the invincible and illustrious forty and nine.
verses.hindi: सिंहनादसे, कुछको चक्कर देकर और कितनोंको निःश्वास वायुके झोंकेसे धराशायी कर दिया ।। २२-२३ ।। इस प्रकार गणोंकी सेनाको गिराकर वह असुर महादेवीके सिंहको मारनेके लिये झपटा। इससे जगदम्बाको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ ।। २४ ।। उधर महापराक्रमी महिषासुर भी क्रोधमें भरकर धरतीको खुरोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: but in descent from them were forty and five others. These and the father and his three sons are often spoken of as the invincible and illustrious forty and nine.
verses.commentary: Sense: but in descent from them were forty and five others. These and the father and his three sons are often spoken of as the invincible and illustrious forty and nine.

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्युच्चारणात् सर्वं गृहीतं सदसद् भवेत् । ह्रस्वा तु प्रथमा मात्रा द्वितीया दैर्घ्यसंयुता
verses.transliteration: omityuccāraṇāt sarvaṃ gṛhītaṃ sadasad bhavet / hrasvā tu prathamā mātrā dvitīyā dairghyasaṃyutā
verses.translation: Brahmd created the Pityis** * * §§ whom I have mentioned to thee, who are the Agni-shvattas,tt the Barhi-8hads,t{ those who did not maintain the sacred fire on earth and those who
verses.hindi: खोदने लगा तथा अपने सींगोंसे ऊँचे-ऊँचे पर्वतोंको उठाकर फेंकने और गर्जने लगा ॥। २५ ।॥। उसके वेगसे चक्कर देनेके कारण पृथ्वी क्षूब्ध होकर फटने लगी। उसकी एूँछसे टकराकर समुद्र सब ओरसे धरतीको डुबोने लगा  २६ ।। हिलते हुए सींगोंके आघातसे विदीर्ण होकर बादलोंके टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो गये।
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmd created the Pityis** * * §§ whom I have mentioned to thee, who are the Agni-shvattas,tt the Barhi-8hads,t{ those who did not maintain the sacred fire on earth and those who
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmd created the Pityis** * * §§ whom I have mentioned to thee, who are the Agni-shvattas,tt the Barhi-8hads,t{ those who did not maintain the sacred fire on earth and those who

verses.sanskrit: तृतीया च प्लुतार्धाख्या वचसः सा न गोचरा । इत्येतदक्षरं ब्रह्म परमोङ्कारसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyā ca plutārdhākhyā vacasaḥ sā na gocarā / ityetadakṣaraṃ brahma paramoṅkārasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.
verses.hindi: उसके श्वासकी प्रचण्ड वायुके वेगसे उड़े हुए सैकड़ों पर्वत आकाशसे गिरने लगे ॥। २७ ।। इस प्रकार क्रोधमें भरे हुए उस महाहैत्यको अपनी ओर आते देख चण्डिकाने उसका वध करनेके लिये महान् क्रोध किया ।। २८ ॥। उन्होंने पाश
verses.wordMeaning: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ocean.) And the lord Bhava married her again as his only wife.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु वेद नरः सम्यक् तथा ध्यायति वा पुनः । संसारचक्रमुत्सृज्य त्यक्तत्रिविधबन्धनः
verses.transliteration: yastu veda naraḥ samyak tathā dhyāyati vā punaḥ / saṃsāracakramutsṛjya tyaktatrividhabandhanaḥ
verses.translation: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.hindi: फेंककर उस महान् असुरको बाँध लिया। उस महासंग्राममें बँध जानेपर उसने भैंसेका रूप त्याग दिया ॥। २९ ।। और तत्काल सिंहके रूपमें वह प्रकट हो गया। उस अवस्थामें जगदम्बा ज्यों ही उसका मस्तक काटनेको उद्यत हुईं, त्यों ही वह खड्गधारी पुरुषके रूपमें दिखायी देने लगा  ३० ।। तब देवीने तुरंत
verses.wordMeaning: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.commentary: Sense: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्रोति ब्रह्मणि लयं परमे परमात्मनि । अक्षीणकर्मबन्धश्च ज्ञात्वा मृत्युमरिष्टतः
verses.transliteration: prāproti brahmaṇi layaṃ parame paramātmani / akṣīṇakarmabandhaśca jñātvā mṛtyumariṣṭataḥ
verses.translation: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.hindi: ही बाणोंकी वर्षा करके ढाल और तलवारके साथ उस पुरुषको भी बींध डाला। इतनेमें ही वह महान् गजराजके रूपमें परिणत हो गया ।। ३१ ।। तथा अपनी सूँड़से देवीके विशाल सिहंको खींचने और गर्जने लगा। खींचते समय देवीने तलवारसे उसकी सूँड़ काट डाली  ३२ ।। तब उस महाहैत्यने पुनः भैंसेका
verses.wordMeaning: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.commentary: Sense: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रान्तिकाले संस्मृत्य पुनर्योगित्वमृच्छति । तस्मादसिद्धयोगेन सिद्धयोगेन वा पुनः । ज्ञेयन्यरिष्टानि सदा येनोत्क्रान्तौ न सीदति
verses.transliteration: utkrāntikāle saṃsmṛtya punaryogitvamṛcchati / tasmādasiddhayogena siddhayogena vā punaḥ / jñeyanyariṣṭāni sadā yenotkrāntau na sīdati
verses.translation: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.hindi: शरीर धारण कर लिया और पहलेकी ही भाँति चराचर प्राणियोंसहित तीनों लोकोंको व्याकुल करने लगा ।। ३३ ।। तब क्रोधमें भरी हुई जगन्माता चण्डिका बारंबार उत्तम मधुका पान करने और लाल आँखें करके हँसने लगीं ।। ३४ ।। उधर वह बल और पराक्रमके मदसे उन्मत्त हुआ राक्षस अपने सींगोंसे चण्डीके
verses.wordMeaning: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.
verses.commentary: Sense: did maintain the firc.§§ By them Svadha|l|| gave birth to two daughters, Mena and Dharini; they both were teachers of the Veda, and they both were female yogis.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कणाडेयपुराणे योगधर्मे ओङ्कारध्यायो नाम द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः दत्तात्रेय उवाच अरिष्टानि महाराज ! शृणु वक्ष्यामि तानि ते । येषामालोकनान्मृत्युं निजं जानाति योगवित्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇāḍeyapurāṇe yogadharme oṅkāradhyāyo nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dattātreya uvāca ariṣṭāni mahārāja ! śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tāni te / yeṣāmālokanānmṛtyuṃ nijaṃ jānāti yogavit
verses.translation: How many are the continents, and how many the oceans, and how many are the mountains, 0 brihman? And how many are the countries, and what are their rivers, 0 Muni P
verses.hindi: ऊपर पर्वतोंको फेंकने लगा और डकारने लगा ।। ३५ ।। उस समय देवी अपने बाणोंके समूहोंसे उसके फेंके हुए पर्वतोंको चूर्ण करती हुई बोलीं। बोलते समय उनका मुख मधुके मदसे लाल हो रहा था और वाणी लड़खड़ा रही थी ।। ३६ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: How many are the continents, and how many the oceans, and how many are the mountains, 0 brihman? And how many are the countries, and what are their rivers, 0 Muni P
verses.commentary: Sense: How many are the continents, and how many the oceans, and how many are the mountains, 0 brihman? And how many are the countries, and what are their rivers, 0 Muni P

verses.sanskrit: देवमार्गं ध्रुवं शुक्रं सोमच्छायामरुन्धतीम् । यो न पश्येन्न जीवेत् स नरः संवत्सरात् परम्
verses.transliteration: devamārgaṃ dhruvaṃ śukraṃ somacchāyāmarundhatīm / yo na paśyenna jīvet sa naraḥ saṃvatsarāt param
verses.translation: And tho size of the great objects of nature* and the LokA- loka mountain-range; the circumference, and the size and
verses.wordMeaning: And tho size of the great objects of nature* and the LokA- loka mountain-range; the circumference, and the size and
verses.commentary: Sense: And tho size of the great objects of nature* and the LokA- loka mountain-range; the circumference, and the size and

verses.sanskrit: अरश्मिबिम्बं सूर्यस्य वह्निं चैवांशुमालिनम् । दृष्ट्वै कादशमासात् तु नरो नोर्धन्तु जीवति
verses.transliteration: araśmibimbaṃ sūryasya vahniṃ caivāṃśumālinam / dṛṣṭvai kādaśamāsāt tu naro nordhantu jīvati
verses.translation: tho course of the moon and the sun also — tell me all this at length, 0 great Muni.
verses.hindi: गर्ज गर्ज क्षणं मूढ मधु यावत्पिबाम्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: tho course of the moon and the sun also — tell me all this at length, 0 great Muni.
