verses.wordMeaning: tara, McdhArin, and Mah4-drama the seventh. He portioned out /or them countries in Sika-dvipa, which were named after them.
verses.commentary: Sense: tara, McdhArin, and Mah4-drama the seventh. He portioned out /or them countries in Sika-dvipa, which were named after them.

verses.sanskrit: दीपगन्धं न यो वेत्ति त्रस्यत्यह्नि तथा निशि । नात्मानं परनेत्रस्थं वीक्षते न स जीवति
verses.transliteration: dīpagandhaṃ na yo vetti trasyatyahni tathā niśi / nātmānaṃ paranetrasthaṃ vīkṣate na sa jīvati
verses.translation: me; KuMa, and Manu-ga, Ushna, and PrAkara, Artha-kiraka, and Muni, and Hundnbhi who was famed as the seventh.
verses.hindi: मस्तकपर आबद्ध चन्द्रमाकी रेखा शोभा पाती हे। वे अपने हाथोंमें शड्ख, चक्र, कृपाण और त्रिशूल धारण करती हैं। उनके तीन नेत्र हैं। वे सिंहके कंधेपर चढ़ी हुई हैं और अपने तेजसे तीनों लोकोंको परिपूर्ण कर रही हैं। ऋषिरुवार्चा' ॥/ १ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: me; KuMa, and Manu-ga, Ushna, and PrAkara, Artha-kiraka, and Muni, and Hundnbhi who was famed as the seventh.
verses.commentary: Sense: me; KuMa, and Manu-ga, Ushna, and PrAkara, Artha-kiraka, and Muni, and Hundnbhi who was famed as the seventh.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रायुधं चार्धरात्रे दिवा ग्रहगणन्तथा । दृष्ट्वा मन्येत संक्षीणमात्मजीवितमात्मवित्
verses.transliteration: śakrāyudhaṃ cārdharātre divā grahagaṇantathā / dṛṣṭvā manyeta saṃkṣīṇamātmajīvitamātmavit
verses.translation: And they had countries in Kraunc'a-dvipa, which were named after them.
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि सुरारिबले च देव्या ।
verses.wordMeaning: And they had countries in Kraunc'a-dvipa, which were named after them.
verses.commentary: Sense: And they had countries in Kraunc'a-dvipa, which were named after them.

verses.sanskrit: नासिका वक्रतामेति कर्णयोर्नमनोन्नती । नेत्रञ्च वामं स्त्रवति यस्य तस्यायुरुद्गतम्
verses.transliteration: nāsikā vakratāmeti karṇayornamanonnatī / netrañca vāmaṃ stravati yasya tasyāyurudgatam
verses.translation: by the names of the sons of Jyotish-niat; hear their names from me— Ud-bhida, and Vaiiiava, Su-ratha, and Lambana,
verses.hindi: वाम्भि: प्रहर्षपुलकोद्गमचारुदेहा: ।। २ ।॥। देव्या यया ततमिदं जगदात्मशक्‍्त्या निश्शेषदेवगणशक्तिसमूहमूर्त्या । तामम्बिकामखिलदेवमहर्षिपूज्यां
verses.wordMeaning: by the names of the sons of Jyotish-niat; hear their names from me— Ud-bhida, and Vaiiiava, Su-ratha, and Lambana,
verses.commentary: Sense: by the names of the sons of Jyotish-niat; hear their names from me— Ud-bhida, and Vaiiiava, Su-ratha, and Lambana,

verses.sanskrit: आरक्ततामेति मुखं जिह्वा वा श्यामतां यदा । तदा प्राज्ञो विजानीयान्मृत्युमासन्नमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: āraktatāmeti mukhaṃ jihvā vā śyāmatāṃ yadā / tadā prājño vijānīyānmṛtyumāsannamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.
verses.hindi: यस्या: प्रभावमतुलं भगवाननन्तो ब्रह्मा हरश्न न हि वक्तुमलं बलं च । सा चण्डिकाखिलजगत्परिपालनाय नाशाय चाशुभभयस्य मतिं करोतु ।। ४ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.
verses.commentary: Sense: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्र-रासभयानेन यः स्वप्ने दक्षिणां दिशम् । प्रयाति तञ्च जानीयात् सद्योमृत्युं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: uṣṭra-rāsabhayānena yaḥ svapne dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / prayāti tañca jānīyāt sadyomṛtyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: S'veta, and Harita, Jimuta, and Rohita, Vaidynta, and MAna-
verses.hindi: पापात्मनां कृतधियां हृदयेषु बुद्धि: ।
verses.wordMeaning: S'veta, and Harita, Jimuta, and Rohita, Vaidynta, and MAna-
verses.commentary: Sense: S'veta, and Harita, Jimuta, and Rohita, Vaidynta, and MAna-

verses.sanskrit: पिधाय कर्णौ निर्घोषं न शृणोत्यात्मसम्भवम् । नश्यते चक्षुषोर्ज्योतिर्यस्य सो ऽपि न जीवति
verses.transliteration: pidhāya karṇau nirghoṣaṃ na śṛṇotyātmasambhavam / naśyate cakṣuṣorjyotiryasya so 'pi na jīvati
verses.translation: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.
verses.hindi: तां त्वां नता: सम परिपालय देवि विश्वम्: ।। ५ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.
verses.commentary: Sense: sa, and Kctu-mat the seventh. And they had seven countries in S'almali, which bore the same names.

verses.sanskrit: पततो यस्य वै गर्ते स्वप्ने द्वारं पिधीयते । न चोत्तिष्ठति यः श्वभ्रात्तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: patato yasya vai garte svapne dvāraṃ pidhīyate / na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāttadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: fall- on the top of the mountain. From their juice spring,
verses.hindi: कि चातिवीर्यमसुरक्षयकारि भूरि ।
verses.wordMeaning: fall- on the top of the mountain. From their juice spring,
verses.commentary: Sense: fall- on the top of the mountain. From their juice spring,

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा च दृष्टिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा रक्ता पुनः संपरिवर्तमाना । मुखस्य चोष्मा शुषिरञ्च नाभेः शंसन्ति पुंसामपरं शरीरम्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvā ca dṛṣṭirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā raktā punaḥ saṃparivartamānā / mukhasya coṣmā śuṣirañca nābheḥ śaṃsanti puṃsāmaparaṃ śarīram
verses.translation: Jdmbti-nada. That river passes around Mem and thei enters Jambd-mhla, 0 brahman; and those people drink of it
verses.hindi: सर्वेषु देव्यसुरदेवगणादिकेषु ।। ६ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Jdmbti-nada. That river passes around Mem and thei enters Jambd-mhla, 0 brahman; and those people drink of it
verses.commentary: Sense: Jdmbti-nada. That river passes around Mem and thei enters Jambd-mhla, 0 brahman; and those people drink of it

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्ने ऽग्निं प्रविशेद्यस्तु न च निष्क्रमते पुनः । जलप्रवेशादपि वा तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: svapne 'gniṃ praviśedyastu na ca niṣkramate punaḥ / jalapraveśādapi vā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: In Bhadra4va Vishnu is figured with a horse’s head • h Bhdrata* he has the shape of a tortoise; and he is h'jfee j boar in Ketu-mala; and he has a fish’s form in tho north
verses.hindi: न ज्ञायसे हरिहरादिभिरप्यपारा ।
verses.wordMeaning: In Bhadra4va Vishnu is figured with a horse’s head • h Bhdrata* he has the shape of a tortoise; and he is h'jfee j boar in Ketu-mala; and he has a fish’s form in tho north
verses.commentary: Sense: In Bhadra4va Vishnu is figured with a horse’s head • h Bhdrata* he has the shape of a tortoise; and he is h'jfee j boar in Ketu-mala; and he has a fish’s form in tho north

verses.sanskrit: यश्चाभिहन्यते दुष्टैर्भूतै रात्रावथो दिवा । स मृत्युं सप्तरात्र्यन्ते नरः प्राप्रोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: yaścābhihanyate duṣṭairbhūtai rātrāvatho divā / sa mṛtyuṃ saptarātryante naraḥ prāprotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: In all those four countries^ worldly affairs are governed by the arrangement of the constellations, 0 brahman; tJn
verses.hindi: तृप्तिं प्रयाति सकलेषु मखेषु देवि ।
verses.wordMeaning: In all those four countries^ worldly affairs are governed by the arrangement of the constellations, 0 brahman; tJn
verses.commentary: Sense: In all those four countries^ worldly affairs are governed by the arrangement of the constellations, 0 brahman; tJn

verses.sanskrit: स्ववस्त्रममलं शुक्लं रक्तं पश्यत्यथासितम् । यः पुमान् मृत्युमासन्नं तस्यापि हि विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: svavastramamalaṃ śuklaṃ raktaṃ paśyatyathāsitam / yaḥ pumān mṛtyumāsannaṃ tasyāpi hi vinirdiśet
verses.translation: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called
verses.hindi: रुचार्यसे त्वमत एव जनै: स्वधा च ॥। ८ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called
verses.commentary: Sense: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called

verses.sanskrit: स्वभाववैपरीत्यन्तु प्रकृतेश्च विपर्ययः । कथयन्ति मनुष्याणां सदासन्नौ यमान्तकौ
verses.transliteration: svabhāvavaiparītyantu prakṛteśca viparyayaḥ / kathayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ sadāsannau yamāntakau
verses.translation: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.
verses.hindi: मभ्यस्यसे सुनियतेन्द्रियतत्त्वसारै: । मोक्षार्थिभिम्मुनिभिरस्तसमस्तदोषै-
verses.wordMeaning: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: येषां विनीतः सततं ये ऽस्य पूज्यतमा मताः । तानेव चावजानाति तानेव च विनिन्दति
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ vinītaḥ satataṃ ye 'sya pūjyatamā matāḥ / tāneva cāvajānāti tāneva ca vinindati
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: विद्यासि सा भगवती परमा हि देवि ।। ९ ।। शब्दात्मिका सुविमलर्ग्यजुषां निधान-
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: देवान्नार्चयते वृद्धान् गुरून् विप्रांश्च निन्दति । मातापित्रोर्न सत्कारं जामातॄणां करोति च
verses.transliteration: devānnārcayate vṛddhān gurūn viprāṃśca nindati / mātāpitrorna satkāraṃ jāmātṝṇāṃ karoti ca
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: देवी त्रयी भगवती भवभावनाय
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां ज्ञानविदुषामन्येषाञ्च महात्मनाम् । प्राप्ते तु काले पुरुषस्तद्विज्ञेयं विचक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ jñānaviduṣāmanyeṣāñca mahātmanām / prāpte tu kāle puruṣastadvijñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: मेधासि देवि विदिताखिलशास्त्रसारा
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां सततं यत्नादरिष्टान्यवनीपते । संवत्सरान्ते तज्ज्ञेयं फलदानि दिवानिशम्
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ satataṃ yatnādariṣṭānyavanīpate / saṃvatsarānte tajjñeyaṃ phaladāni divāniśam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: दुर्गासि दुर्गभवसागरनौरसज्ा ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्या विशदा चैषां फलपङ्क्तिः सुभीषणा । विज्ञाय कार्यो मनसि स च कालो नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: vilokyā viśadā caiṣāṃ phalapaṅktiḥ subhīṣaṇā / vijñāya kāryo manasi sa ca kālo nareśvara
verses.translation: Rishabha begot Bharata, a hero, the best among his hundred sons. Rishabha having anointed his son in his stead betook himself to the strictest life of a wandering religious meudi-
verses.hindi: बिम्बानुकारि कनकोत्तमकान्तिकान्तम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Rishabha begot Bharata, a hero, the best among his hundred sons. Rishabha having anointed his son in his stead betook himself to the strictest life of a wandering religious meudi-
verses.commentary: Sense: Rishabha begot Bharata, a hero, the best among his hundred sons. Rishabha having anointed his son in his stead betook himself to the strictest life of a wandering religious meudi-

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्व कालञ्च तं सम्यगभयस्थानमाश्रितः । युञ्जीत योगी कालो ऽसौ यथा नास्याफलो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: jñātva kālañca taṃ samyagabhayasthānamāśritaḥ / yuñjīta yogī kālo 'sau yathā nāsyāphalo bhavet
verses.translation: cant, and devoted himself to austerities, an illustrious hermit, dwelling in Pulaha’s hermitage. His father gave Bharata
verses.hindi: वकक्‍त्रं विलोक्य सहसा महिषासुरेण  १२ ।। दृष्टवा तु देवि कुपितं भ्रुकुटीकराल-
verses.wordMeaning: cant, and devoted himself to austerities, an illustrious hermit, dwelling in Pulaha’s hermitage. His father gave Bharata
verses.commentary: Sense: cant, and devoted himself to austerities, an illustrious hermit, dwelling in Pulaha’s hermitage. His father gave Bharata

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वारिष्टं तथा योगी त्यक्त्वा मरणजं भयम् । तत्स्वभावं तदालोक्य काले यावत्युपागतम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāriṣṭaṃ tathā yogī tyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam / tatsvabhāvaṃ tadālokya kāle yāvatyupāgatam
verses.translation: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called
verses.hindi: प्राणान्मुमोच महिषस्तदतीव चित्र
verses.wordMeaning: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called
verses.commentary: Sense: hence the country is called Bharata after the name of that high-souled king, Bharata also had a righteous son called

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भागे तथैवाह्नो योगं युञ्जीत योगवित् । पूर्वाह्ने चापराह्ने च मध्याह्ने चापि तद्दिने
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāge tathaivāhno yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavit / pūrvāhne cāparāhne ca madhyāhne cāpi taddine
verses.translation: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.
verses.hindi: देवि प्रसीद परमा भवती भवाय
verses.wordMeaning: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Su-mati; and Bharata transferred the kingdom to him and departed to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वा रजनीभागे तदरिष्टं निरीक्षितम् । तत्रैव तावद्युञ्जीत यावत् प्राप्तं हि तद्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra vā rajanībhāge tadariṣṭaṃ nirīkṣitam / tatraiva tāvadyuñjīta yāvat prāptaṃ hi taddinam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: सद्यो विनाशयसि कोपवती कुलानि ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्यक्त्वा भयं सर्वं जित्वा तं कालमात्मवान् । तत्रैवावसथे स्थित्वा यत्र वा स्थैर्यमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tatastyaktvā bhayaṃ sarvaṃ jitvā taṃ kālamātmavān / tatraivāvasathe sthitvā yatra vā sthairyamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: न्नीतं बल॑ सुविपुलं महिषासुरस्य ।। १४ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जीत योगं निर्जित्य त्रीन् गुणान् परमात्मनि । तन्मयश्चात्मना भूत्वा चिद्वृत्तिमपि सन्त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: yuñjīta yogaṃ nirjitya trīn guṇān paramātmani / tanmayaścātmanā bhūtvā cidvṛttimapi santyajet
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: तेषां यशांसि न च सीदति धर्मवर्ग:
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: ततः परमनिर्वाणमतीन्द्रियमगोचरम् । यद्बुद्धेर्यन्न चाख्यातुं शक्यते तत् समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paramanirvāṇamatīndriyamagocaram / yadbuddheryanna cākhyātuṃ śakyate tat samaśnute
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: धर्म्याणि देवि सकलानि सहैव कर्मा-
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं समाख्यातं तवालर्क ! यथार्थवत् । प्राप्स्यसे येन तद्ब्रह्म संक्षेपात्तन्निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ tavālarka ! yathārthavat / prāpsyase yena tadbrahma saṃkṣepāttannibodha me
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: ण्यत्यादृत: प्रतिदिनं सुकृती करोति ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: शशाङ्करश्मिसंयोगाच्छन्द्रकान्तमणिः पयः । समुत्सृजति नायुक्तः सोपमा योगिनः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: śaśāṅkaraśmisaṃyogācchandrakāntamaṇiḥ payaḥ / samutsṛjati nāyuktaḥ sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: ल्‍लोकत्रयेडपि फलदा ननु देवि तेन ।। १६ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: यच्चार्करश्मिसंयोगादर्ककान्तो हुताशनम् । आविष्करोति नैकः सन्नुपमा सापि योगिनः
verses.transliteration: yaccārkaraśmisaṃyogādarkakānto hutāśanam / āviṣkaroti naikaḥ sannupamā sāpi yoginaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: दारिद्रयदुःखभयहारिणि का त्वदन्या
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: पिपीलिकाखु-नकुल-गृहगोधा-कपिञ्जलाः । वसन्ति स्वामिवद् गेहे ध्वस्ते यान्ति ततो ऽन्यतः
verses.transliteration: pipīlikākhu-nakula-gṛhagodhā-kapiñjalāḥ / vasanti svāmivad gehe dhvaste yānti tato 'nyataḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: सर्वोपकारकरणाय सदाद्रीचित्ता  १७ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दुः खन्तु स्वामिनो ध्वंसे तस्य तेषां न किञ्चन । वेश्मनो यत्र राजेन्द्र ! सोपमा योगसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: duḥ khantu svāmino dhvaṃse tasya teṣāṃ na kiñcana / veśmano yatra rājendra ! sopamā yogasiddhaye
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: कुर्वन्तु नाम नरकाय चिराय पापम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: मृद्वाहिकाल्पदेहापि मुखाग्रेणाप्यणीयसा । करोति मृद्भारचयमुपदेशः स योगिनः
verses.transliteration: mṛdvāhikālpadehāpi mukhāgreṇāpyaṇīyasā / karoti mṛdbhāracayamupadeśaḥ sa yoginaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: मत्वेति नूनमहितान् विनिहंसि देवि ।। १८ ।। दृष्टवैव कि न भवती प्रकरोति भस्म
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: पशुपक्षिमनुष्याद्यैः पत्रपुष्पफलान्वितम् । वृक्षं विलुप्यमानन्तु दृष्ट्वा सिध्यन्ति योगिनः
verses.transliteration: paśupakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ patrapuṣpaphalānvitam / vṛkṣaṃ vilupyamānantu dṛṣṭvā sidhyanti yoginaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: लोकान् प्रयान्तु रिपवो5पि हि शस्त्रपूता
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: रुरुशावविषाणाग्रमालक्ष्य तिलकाकृतिम् । सह तेन विवर्धन्तं योगी सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ruruśāvaviṣāṇāgramālakṣya tilakākṛtim / saha tena vivardhantaṃ yogī siddhimavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: खड्गप्रभानिकरविस्फरणैस्तथो ग्रै:
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: द्रवपूर्णमुपादाय पात्रमारोहतो भुवः । तुङ्गमार्गं विलोक्योच्चैर्विज्ञातं किं न योगिना
verses.transliteration: dravapūrṇamupādāya pātramārohato bhuvaḥ / tuṅgamārgaṃ vilokyoccairvijñātaṃ kiṃ na yoginā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: शूलाग्रकान्तिनिवहेन दृशो5सुराणाम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वे जीवनायालं निखाते पुरुषस्य या । चेष्टा तां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा योगिनः कृतकृत्यता
verses.transliteration: sarvasve jīvanāyālaṃ nikhāte puruṣasya yā / ceṣṭā tāṃ tattvato jñātvā yoginaḥ kṛtakṛtyatā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: योग्याननं तव विलोकयतां तदेतत् ॥। २० ।। दुर्वत्तवृत्तशमनं तव देवि शीलं
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: तद्गृहं यत्र वसतिः तद्भोज्यं येन जीवति । येन सम्पद्यते चार्थस्तत्सुखं ममतात्र का
verses.transliteration: tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasatiḥ tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati / yena sampadyate cārthastatsukhaṃ mamatātra kā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: वीर्य च हन्तृ हृतदेवपराक्रमाणां
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्थितो ऽपि तैः कार्यं करोति करणैर्यथा । तथा बुध्यादिभिर्योगी पारक्यैः साधयेत्परम्
verses.transliteration: abhyarthito 'pi taiḥ kāryaṃ karoti karaṇairyathā / tathā budhyādibhiryogī pārakyaiḥ sādhayetparam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: केनोपमा भवतु तेडस्य पराक्रमस्य
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: जड उवाच ततः प्रणम्यात्रिपुत्रमलर्कः स महीपतिः । प्रश्रयावनतो वाक्यमुवाचातिमुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: jaḍa uvāca tataḥ praṇamyātriputramalarkaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ / praśrayāvanato vākyamuvācātimudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: रूप॑ च शत्रुभयकार्यतिहारि कुत्र ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: अलर्क उवाच दिष्ट्यादेवैरिदं ब्रह्मन् ! पराभिभवसम्भवम् । उपपादितमत्युग्रं प्राणसन्देहदं भयम्
verses.transliteration: alarka uvāca diṣṭyādevairidaṃ brahman ! parābhibhavasambhavam / upapāditamatyugraṃ prāṇasandehadaṃ bhayam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: त्वय्येव देवि वरदे भुवनत्रयेडपि ।। २२ ।। त्रैलोक्यमेतदखिलं रिपुनाशनेन
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या काशिपतेर्भूरि-बलसम्पत्पराक्रमः । यदुच्छेदादिहायातः स युष्मत्सङ्गदो मम
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā kāśipaterbhūri-balasampatparākramaḥ / yaducchedādihāyātaḥ sa yuṣmatsaṅgado mama
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: शूलेन पाहि नो देवि पाहि खड्गेन चाम्बिके
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या मन्दबलश्चाहं दिष्ट्या भृत्याश्च मे हताः । दिष्ट्या कोषः क्षयं योतो दिष्ट्याहं भीतिमागतः
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā mandabalaścāhaṃ diṣṭyā bhṛtyāśca me hatāḥ / diṣṭyā koṣaḥ kṣayaṃ yoto diṣṭyāhaṃ bhītimāgataḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: प्राच्यां रक्ष प्रतीच्यां च चण्डिके रक्ष दक्षिणे ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या त्वत्पादयुगलं मम स्मृतिपथं गतम् । दिष्ट्या त्वदुक्तयः सर्वा मम चेतसि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā tvatpādayugalaṃ mama smṛtipathaṃ gatam / diṣṭyā tvaduktayaḥ sarvā mama cetasi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: सौम्यानि यानि रूपाणि त्रैलोक्ये विचरन्ति ते ।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या ज्ञानं ममोत्पन्नं भवतश्च समागमात् । भवता चैव कारुण्यं दिष्ट्या ब्रह्मन् ! कृतं मम
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā jñānaṃ mamotpannaṃ bhavataśca samāgamāt / bhavatā caiva kāruṇyaṃ diṣṭyā brahman ! kṛtaṃ mama
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: खड्गशूलगदादीनि यानि चास्त्राणि ते5म्बिके । करपल्लवसज्जीनि तैरस्मान् रक्ष सर्वतः ।। २७ ।। ऋषि कहते हैं-- ।। १ ।। अत्यन्त पराक्रमी दुरात्मा महिषासुर तथा उसकी हैत्य- सैनाके देवीके हाथसे मारे जानेपर इन्द्र आदि देवता प्रणामके लिये गर्दन तथा कंधे झुकाकर
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: अनर्थो ऽप्यर्थतां याति पुरुषस्य शुभोदये । यथेदमुपकाराय व्यसनं सङ्गमात्तव
verses.transliteration: anartho 'pyarthatāṃ yāti puruṣasya śubhodaye / yathedamupakārāya vyasanaṃ saṅgamāttava
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: उन भगवती दुर्गाका उत्तम वचनोंद्वारा स्तवन करने लगे। उस समय उनके सुन्दर अड्ञोंमें अत्यन्त हर्षके कारण रोमाज्च हो आया था ।। २ ।। देवता बोले-- “सम्पूर्ण देवताओंकी शक्तिका समुदाय ही जिनका स्वरूप है तथा जिन देवीने अपनी शक्तिसे सम्पूर्ण जगत्को व्याप्त कर रखा है, समस्त देवताओं और महर्षियोंकी पूजनीया उन जगदम्बाको हम
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: सुबाहुरुपकारी मे स च काशिपतिः प्रभो । ययोः कृते ऽहं संप्राप्तो योगीश ! भवतो ऽन्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: subāhurupakārī me sa ca kāśipatiḥ prabho / yayoḥ kṛte 'haṃ saṃprāpto yogīśa ! bhavato 'ntikam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: भक्तिपूर्वक नमस्कार करते हैं। वे हमलोगोंका कल्याण करें ।। ३ ।। जिनके अनृपम प्रभाव और बलका वर्णन करनेमें भगवान् शेषनाग, ब्रह्माजी तथा महादेवजी भी समर्थ नहीं हैं, वे भगवती चण्डिका सम्पूर्ण जगत्का पालन एवं अशुभ भयका नाश करनेका विचार करें ।। ४ ।। जो पुण्यात्माओंके घरोंमें स्वयं ही लक्ष्मीरूपसे, पापियोंके यहाँ दरिद्रतारूपसे,
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहन्तव प्रसादाग्नि-निर्दग्धाज्ञानकिल्विषः । तथा यतिष्ये येनेदृङ् न भूयां दुः खभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: so 'hantava prasādāgni-nirdagdhājñānakilviṣaḥ / tathā yatiṣye yenedṛṅ na bhūyāṃ duḥ khabhājanam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: शुद्ध अन्तःकरणवाले पुरुषोंके हृदयमें बुद्धिरूपसे, सत्पुरुषोंमें श्रद्धारूपसे तथा कुलीन मनुष्यमें लज्जारूपसे निवास करती हैं, उन आप भगवती दुर्गाको हम नमस्कार करते हैं। देवि! सम्पूर्ण विश्वका पालन कीजिये ।। ५ ॥। देवि! आपके इन अचिन्त्य रूपका, असुरोंका नाश करनेवाले भारी पराक्रमका तथा समस्त देवताओं और हैत्योंके समक्ष युद्धमें प्रकट
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: परित्यजिष्ये गार्हस्थ्यमार्तिपादपकाननम् । त्वत्तो ऽनुज्ञां समासाद्य ज्ञानदातुर्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: parityajiṣye gārhasthyamārtipādapakānanam / tvatto 'nujñāṃ samāsādya jñānadāturmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: किये हुए आपके अद्भुत चरित्रोंका हम किस प्रकार वर्णन करें  ६ ॥। आप सम्पूर्ण जगत्की उत्पत्तिमें कारण हैं। आपमें सत्त्वगुण, रजोगुण और तमोगुण--ये तीनों गुण मौजूद हैं; तो भी दोषोंके साथ आपका संसर्ग नहीं जान पड़ता। भगवान् विष्णु और महादेवजी आदि देवता भी आपका पार नहीं पाते। आप ही सबका आश्रय हैं। यह समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: दत्तात्रेय उवाच गच्छ राजेन्द्र ! भद्रं ते यथा ते कथितं मया । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारस्तथा चर विमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: dattātreya uvāca gaccha rājendra ! bhadraṃ te yathā te kathitaṃ mayā / nirmamo nirahaṅkārastathā cara vimuktaye
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: जगत् आपका अंशभूत है; क्योंकि आप सबकी आदिभूत अव्याकृता परा प्रकृति हैं  ७ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: जड उवाच एवमुक्तः प्रणम्यैनमाजगाम त्वरान्वितः । यत्र काशिपतिर्भ्राता सुबाहुश्चास्य सो ऽग्रजः
verses.transliteration: jaḍa uvāca evamuktaḥ praṇamyainamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ / yatra kāśipatirbhrātā subāhuścāsya so 'grajaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: देवि! सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंमें जिसके उच्चारणसे सब देवता तृप्ति लाभ करते हैं, वह स्वाहा आप ही हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त आप पितरोंकी भी तृप्तिका कारण हैं, अतएव सब लोग आपको स्वधा भी कहते हैं  ८ ॥। देवि! जो मोक्षकी प्राप्तिका साधन है, अचिन्त्य महाव्रतस्वरूपा है, समस्त दोषोंसे रहित, जितेन्द्रिय, तत्त्वको ही सार वस्तु माननेवाले तथा मोक्षकी अभिलाषा
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: समुत्पत्य महाबहुं सो ऽलर्कः काशिभूपतिम् । सुबाहोरग्रतो वीरमुवाच प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: samutpatya mahābahuṃ so 'larkaḥ kāśibhūpatim / subāhoragrato vīramuvāca prahasanniva
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: रखनेवाले मुनिजन जिसका अभ्यास करते हैं, वह भगवती परा विद्या आप ही हैं ।। ९ ।। आप शब्दस्वरूपा हैं, अत्यन्त निर्मल ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा उद्बीथके मनोहर पदोंके पाठसे युक्त सामवेदका भी आधार आप ही हैं। आप देवी, त्रयी (तीनों वेद) और भगवती (छहों ऐश्वर्योंसे युक्त) हैं। इस विश्वकी उत्पत्ति एवं पालनके लिये आप ही वार्ता (खेती एवं
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: राज्यकामुक काशीश ! भुज्यतां राज्यमूर्जितम् । तथा च रोचते तद्वत् सुबाहोः संप्रयच्छ वा
verses.transliteration: rājyakāmuka kāśīśa ! bhujyatāṃ rājyamūrjitam / tathā ca rocate tadvat subāhoḥ saṃprayaccha vā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: आजीविका)-के रूपमें प्रकट हुई हैं। आप सम्पूर्ण जगत्की घोर पीड़ाका नाश करनेवाली हैं ।। १० ।। देवि! जिससे समस्त शास्त्रोंके सारका ज्ञान होता है, वह मेधाशक्ति आप ही हैं। दुर्गण भवसागरसे पार उतारनेवाली नौकारूप दुर्गदिवी भी आप ही हैं। आपकी कहीं भी आसक्ति नहीं है। कैटभके शत्रु भगवान् विष्णुके वक्ष:स्थलमें एकमात्र निवास करनेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: काशिराज उवाच किमलर्क ! परित्यक्तं राज्यं ते संयुगं विना । क्षत्रियस्य न धर्मो ऽयं भवांश्च क्षत्रधर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: kāśirāja uvāca kimalarka ! parityaktaṃ rājyaṃ te saṃyugaṃ vinā / kṣatriyasya na dharmo 'yaṃ bhavāṃśca kṣatradharmavit
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: भगवती लक्ष्मी तथा भगवान् चन्द्रशेखरद्वारा सम्मानित गौरीदेवी भी आप ही हैं ।। ११ ।। आपका मुख मन्द मुसकानसे सुशोभित, निर्मल, पूर्ण चन्द्रमाके बिम्बका अनुकरण करनेवाला और उत्तम सुवर्णकी मनोहर कान्तिसे कमनीय है; तो भी उसे देखकर महिषासुरको क्रोध हुआ और सहसा उसने उसपर प्रहार कर दिया, यह बड़े आश्वर्यकी बात
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: निर्जितामात्यवर्गस्तु त्यक्त्वा मरणजं भयम् । सन्दधीत शरं राजा लक्ष्यमुद्दिश्य वैरिणम्
verses.transliteration: nirjitāmātyavargastu tyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam / sandadhīta śaraṃ rājā lakṣyamuddiśya vairiṇam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: है ।। १२ ।। देवि! वही मुख जब क्रोधसे युक्त होनेपर उदयकालके चन्द्रमाकी भाँति लाल और तनी हुई भौंहोंके कारण विकराल हो उठा, तब उसे देखकर जो महिषासुरके प्राण तुरंत नहीं निकल गये, यह उससे भी बढ़कर आश्वर्यकी बात है; क्‍योंकि क्रोधमें भरे हुए यमराजको देखकर भला, कौन जीवित रह सकता है ।। १३ ॥ देवि! आप प्रसन्न हों।
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: तं जित्वा नृपतिर्भोगान् यथाभिलषितान् वरान् । भुञ्जीत परमं सिद्ध्यै यजेत च महामखैः
verses.transliteration: taṃ jitvā nṛpatirbhogān yathābhilaṣitān varān / bhuñjīta paramaṃ siddhyai yajeta ca mahāmakhaiḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: परमात्मस्वरूपा आपके प्रसन्न होनेपर जगत्का अभ्युदय होता है और क्रोधमें भर जानेपर आप तत्काल ही कितने कुलोंका सर्वनाश कर डालती हैं, यह बात अभी अनुभवमें आयी है; क्योंकि महिषासुरकी यह विशाल सेना क्षणभरमें आपके कोपसे नष्ट हो गयी है ।। १४ ॥। सदा अभ्युदय प्रदान करनेवाली आप जिनपर प्रसन्न रहती हैं; वे ही देशमें
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: अलर्क उवाच एवमीदृशकं वीर ! ममाप्यासीन्मनः पुरा । साम्प्रतं विपरीतार्थं शृणु चाप्यत्र कारणम्
verses.transliteration: alarka uvāca evamīdṛśakaṃ vīra ! mamāpyāsīnmanaḥ purā / sāmprataṃ viparītārthaṃ śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: सम्मानित हैं, उन्हींको धन और यशकी प्राप्ति होती है, उन्हींका धर्म कभी शिथिल नहीं होता तथा वे ही अपने हृष्ट-पुष्ट स्त्री, पुत्र और भृत्योंके साथ धन्य माने जाते हैं  १५ ।। देवि! आपकी ही कृपासे पुण्यात्मा पुरुष प्रतिदिन अत्यन्त श्रद्धापूर्वक सदा सब प्रकारके धर्मानुकूल कर्म करता है और उसके प्रभावसे स्वर्गलोकमें जाता है; इसलिये आप तीनों
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: यथायं भौतिकः सङ्घस्तथान्तः करणं नृणाम् । गुणास्तु सकलास्तद्वदशेषेष्वेव जन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: yathāyaṃ bhautikaḥ saṅghastathāntaḥ karaṇaṃ nṛṇām / guṇāstu sakalāstadvadaśeṣeṣveva jantuṣu
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: लोकोंमें निश्चय ही मनोवाजञ्छित फल देनेवाली हैं ।। १६ ।। माँ दुर्गे! आप स्मरण करनेपर सब प्राणियोंका भय हर लेती हैं और स्वस्थ पुरुषोंद्वारा चिन्तन करनेपर उन्हें परम कल्याणमयी बुद्धि प्रदान करती हैं। दुःख, दरिद्रता और भय हरनेवाली देवि! आपके सिवा दूसरी कौन है, जिसका चित्त सबका उपकार करनेके लिये सदा ही दयार्द रहता
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छक्तिरेक एवायं यदा नान्यो ऽस्ति कश्चन । तदा का नृपते ज्ञानान्मित्रारिप्रभुभृत्यता
verses.transliteration: cicchaktireka evāyaṃ yadā nānyo 'sti kaścana / tadā kā nṛpate jñānānmitrāriprabhubhṛtyatā
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: हो ॥। १७ ।। देवि! इन राक्षसोंके मारनेसे संसारको सुख मिले तथा ये राक्षस चिरकालतक
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: तन्मया दुः खमासाद्य त्वद्भयोद्भवमुत्तमम् । दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन ज्ञानं प्राप्तं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tanmayā duḥ khamāsādya tvadbhayodbhavamuttamam / dattātreyaprasādena jñānaṃ prāptaṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: नरकमें रहनेके लिये भले ही पाप करते रहे हों, इस समय संग्राममें मृत्युको प्राप्त होकर स्वर्गलोकमें जायँ--निश्चय ही यही सोचकर आप शत्रुओंका वध करती हैं  १८ ।। आप शत्रुओंपर शस्त्रोंका प्रहार क्यों करती हैं? समस्त असुरोंको दृष्टिपात-मात्रसे ही भस्म क्‍यों नहीं कर देतीं? इसमें एक रहस्य है। “ये शत्रु भी हमारे शस्त्रोंसे पवित्र होकर उत्तम लोकोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: निर्जितेन्द्रियवर्गस्तु त्यक्त्वा सङ्गमशेषतः । मनो ब्रह्मणि सन्धाय तज्जये परमो जयः
verses.transliteration: nirjitendriyavargastu tyaktvā saṅgamaśeṣataḥ / mano brahmaṇi sandhāya tajjaye paramo jayaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: जायँ'--इस प्रकार उनके प्रति भी आपका विचार अत्यन्त उत्तम रहता है  १९ ।। खड्गके तेज:पुज्जकी भयड्भकर दीप्तिसे तथा आपके त्रिशूलके अग्रभागकी घनीभूत प्रभासे चौंधियाकर जो असुरोंकी आँखें फूट नहीं गयीं, उसमें कारण यही था कि वे मनोहर रश्मियोंसे युक्त चन्द्रमाके समान आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाले आपके इस सुन्दर मुखका दर्शन
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: संसाध्यमन्यत्तत्सिद्ध्यै यतः किञ्चिन्न विद्यते । इन्द्रियाणि च संयम्य ततः सिद्धिं नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: saṃsādhyamanyattatsiddhyai yataḥ kiñcinna vidyate / indriyāṇi ca saṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: करते थे ।। २० ॥। देवि! आपका शील दुराचारियोंके बुरे बर्तावको दूर करनेवाला है। साथ ही यह रूप ऐसा है, जो कभी चिन्तनमें भी नहीं आ सकता और जिसकी कभी दूसरोंसे तुलना भी नहीं हो सकती; तथा आपका बल और पराक्रम तो उन हैत्योंका भी नाश करनेवाला है, जो कभी देवताओंके पराक्रमको भी नष्ट कर चुके थे। इस प्रकार आपने
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं न ते ऽरिर्न ममासि शत्रुः सुबाहुरेषो न ममापकारी । दृष्टं मया सर्वमिदं यथात्मा अन्विष्यतां भूप ! रिपुस्त्वयान्यः
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ na te 'rirna mamāsi śatruḥ subāhureṣo na mamāpakārī / dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sarvamidaṃ yathātmā anviṣyatāṃ bhūpa ! ripustvayānyaḥ
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: शत्रुओंपर भी अपनी दया ही प्रकट की है ॥ २१ ।॥। वरदायिनी देवि! आपके इस पराक्रमकी किसके साथ तुलना हो सकती है। तथा शत्रुओंको भय देनेवाला एवं अत्यन्त मनोहर ऐसा रूप भी आपके सिवा और कहाँ है! हृदयमें कृपा और युद्धमें निछ्ठुरता--ये दोनों बातें तीनों लोकोंके भीतर केवल आपमें ही देखी गयी हैं  २२ ।। मातः! आपने
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स तेनाभिहितो नरेन्द्रो हृष्टः समुत्थाय ततः सुबाहुः । दिष्ट्येति तं भ्रातरमाभिनन्द्य काशीश्वरं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa tenābhihito narendro hṛṣṭaḥ samutthāya tataḥ subāhuḥ / diṣṭyeti taṃ bhrātaramābhinandya kāśīśvaraṃ vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe
verses.translation: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.hindi: शत्रुओंका नाश करके इस समस्त त्रिलोकीकी रक्षा की है। उन शत्रुओंको भी युद्धभूमिमें मारकर स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचाया है तथा उन्मत हैत्योंसे प्राप्त होनेवाले हमलोगोंके भयको भी दूर कर दिया है, आपको हमारा नमस्कार है ।। २३ ।। देवि! आप शूलसे हमारी रक्षा करें। अम्बिके! खड्गसे भी हमारी रक्षा करें तथा घण्टाकी ध्वनि और धनुषकी टंकारसे भी आप
verses.wordMeaning: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?
verses.commentary: Sense: have narrated it to thee, 0 brahman. What else shall I fully tell thee of in the first Manv-antara?

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे अरिष्टकथनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सुबाहुरुवाच यदर्थं नृपशार्दूल ! त्वामहं शरणं गतः । तन्मया सकलं प्राप्तं यास्यामि त्वं सुखी भव
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe ariṣṭakathanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ subāhuruvāca yadarthaṃ nṛpaśārdūla ! tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / tanmayā sakalaṃ prāptaṃ yāsyāmi tvaṃ sukhī bhava
verses.translation: Hoar from me of the four forests and lakes which exist on
verses.hindi: हमलोगोंकी रक्षा करें ।। २४ ।। चण्डिके! पूर्व, पश्चिम और दक्षिण दिशामें आप हमारी रक्षा करें तथा ईश्वरि! अपने त्रिशूलको घुमाकर आप उत्तर दिशामें भी हमारी रक्षा करें  २५ ।। तीनों लोकोंमें आपके जो परम सुन्दर एवं अत्यन्त भयड्कर रूप विचरते रहते हैं, उनके द्वारा भी आप हमारी तथा इस भूलोककी रक्षा करें ।। २६ ।। अम्बिके! आपके कर-
verses.wordMeaning: Hoar from me of the four forests and lakes which exist on
verses.commentary: Sense: Hoar from me of the four forests and lakes which exist on

verses.sanskrit: काखिराज उवाच किं निमित्तं भवान् प्राप्तो निष्पन्नोर्ऽथश्च कस्तव । सुबाहो ! तन्ममाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: kākhirāja uvāca kiṃ nimittaṃ bhavān prāpto niṣpannor'thaśca kastava / subāho ! tanmamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: Mandara and the three other moun tains, t 0 brahman. On mountain the forest Nandana, on the western mountain th forest Vaibhraja, and on the northern mountain the forest
verses.hindi: पाललवोंमें शोभा पानेवाले खड़ग, शूल और गदा आदि जो-जो अस्त्र हों, उन सबके द्वारा आप सब ओरसे हमलोगोंकी रक्षा करें  २७ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Mandara and the three other moun tains, t 0 brahman. On mountain the forest Nandana, on the western mountain th forest Vaibhraja, and on the northern mountain the forest
verses.commentary: Sense: Mandara and the three other moun tains, t 0 brahman. On mountain the forest Nandana, on the western mountain th forest Vaibhraja, and on the northern mountain the forest

verses.sanskrit: समाक्रान्तमलर्केण पितृपैतामहं महत् । राज्यं देहीति निर्जित्य त्वयाहमभिचोदितः
verses.transliteration: samākrāntamalarkeṇa pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat / rājyaṃ dehīti nirjitya tvayāhamabhicoditaḥ
verses.translation: Sdvitra. On the east is the lake Aruijioda,! and on the south Manasa, on the west of Meru is S^itoda, and Mahd-bhadra on
verses.wordMeaning: Sdvitra. On the east is the lake Aruijioda,! and on the south Manasa, on the west of Meru is S^itoda, and Mahd-bhadra on
verses.commentary: Sense: Sdvitra. On the east is the lake Aruijioda,! and on the south Manasa, on the west of Meru is S^itoda, and Mahd-bhadra on

verses.sanskrit: ततो मया समाक्रम्य राज्यमस्यानुजस्य ते । एतत्ते बलमानीतं तद्भुङ्क्ष्वस्वकुलोचितम्
verses.transliteration: tato mayā samākramya rājyamasyānujasya te / etatte balamānītaṃ tadbhuṅkṣvasvakulocitam
verses.translation: On the east of Mandara are tho mountains S^itartta,§ an O^akra-munja, and Kulira, Su-kanka-vat, and Mani-^iiai
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--  २८ ।। इस प्रकार जब देवताओंने जगन्माता दुर्गाकी स्तुति की और नन्दनवनके दिव्य पुष्पों एवं गन्ध-चन्दन आदिके द्वारा उनका पूजन किया, फिर सबने मिलकर जब भक्तिपूर्वक दिव्य धूपोंकी सुगन्ध निवेदन की, देवीने प्रसन्नचदन होकर प्रणाम करते हुए सब देवताओंसे कहा-- ।। २९-३० ।।
verses.wordMeaning: On the east of Mandara are tho mountains S^itartta,§ an O^akra-munja, and Kulira, Su-kanka-vat, and Mani-^iiai
verses.commentary: Sense: On the east of Mandara are tho mountains S^itartta,§ an O^akra-munja, and Kulira, Su-kanka-vat, and Mani-^iiai

verses.sanskrit: सुबाहुरुवाच काशिराज ! निबोध त्वं यदर्थमयमुद्यमः । कृतो मया भवांश्चैव कारितो ऽत्यन्तमुद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: subāhuruvāca kāśirāja ! nibodha tvaṃ yadarthamayamudyamaḥ / kṛto mayā bhavāṃścaiva kārito 'tyantamudyamam
verses.translation: Vrisha-vat, Maha-nila, Bhavac'ala, Sa-bindu, Mandara, Venn, Tdmasa, and Nishadha, and Deva-^aila.
verses.wordMeaning: Vrisha-vat, Maha-nila, Bhavac'ala, Sa-bindu, Mandara, Venn, Tdmasa, and Nishadha, and Deva-^aila.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrisha-vat, Maha-nila, Bhavac'ala, Sa-bindu, Mandara, Venn, Tdmasa, and Nishadha, and Deva-^aila.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राता ममायं ग्राम्येषु सक्तो भोगेषु तत्त्ववित् । विमूढौ बोधवन्तौ च भ्रातरावग्रजौ मम
verses.transliteration: bhrātā mamāyaṃ grāmyeṣu sakto bhogeṣu tattvavit / vimūḍhau bodhavantau ca bhrātarāvagrajau mama
verses.translation: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.
verses.hindi: देवी बोलीं--  ३१ ॥ देवताओ! तुम सब लोग मुझसे जिस वस्तुकी अभिलाषा रखते हो उसे माँगो ।। ३२ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.
verses.commentary: Sense: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्मम च यन्मात्रा बाल्ये स्तन्यं यथा मुखे । तथावबोधो विन्यस्तः कर्णयोरवनीपते
verses.transliteration: tayormama ca yanmātrā bālye stanyaṃ yathā mukhe / tathāvabodho vinyastaḥ karṇayoravanīpate
verses.translation: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-
verses.hindi: यदयं निहतः शत्रुरस्माकं महिषासुर: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-
verses.commentary: Sense: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्मम च विज्ञेयाः पदार्था ये मता नृभिः । प्राकाश्यं मनसो नीतास्ते मात्रा नास्य पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: tayormama ca vijñeyāḥ padārthā ye matā nṛbhiḥ / prākāśyaṃ manaso nītāste mātrā nāsya pārthiva
verses.translation: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-
verses.hindi: संस्मृता संस्मृता त्वं नो हिंसेथा: परमापद: ।
verses.wordMeaning: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-
verses.commentary: Sense: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-

verses.sanskrit: यथैकमर्थे यातानामेकस्मिन्नवसीदति । दुः खं भवति साधूनां ततास्माकं महीपते
verses.transliteration: yathaikamarthe yātānāmekasminnavasīdati / duḥ khaṃ bhavati sādhūnāṃ tatāsmākaṃ mahīpate
verses.translation: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on
verses.hindi: वृद्धयेअस्मत्प्रसन्ना त्वं भवेथा: सर्वदाम्बिके ।। ३७ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on
verses.commentary: Sense: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on

verses.sanskrit: गार्हस्थ्यमोहमापन्ने सीदत्यस्मिन्नरेश्वर । सम्बन्धिन्यस्य देहस्य बिभ्रति भ्रातृकल्पनाम्
verses.transliteration: gārhasthyamohamāpanne sīdatyasminnareśvara / sambandhinyasya dehasya bibhrati bhrātṛkalpanām
verses.translation: brahman. These are terrestrial Svargas, 0 brdhman; they- surpass Svarga with their excellences. In them no fresh
verses.hindi: नहीं है ।। ३४ ।। क्योंकि हमारा यह शत्रु महिषासुर मारा गया। महेश्वरी! इतनेपर भी यदि आप हमें और वर देना चाहती हैं  ३५  तो हम जब-जब आपका स्मरण करें, तब-तब आप दर्शन देकर हमलोगोंके महान् संकट दूर कर दिया करें तथा प्रसन्नमुखी अम्बिके! जो मुनष्य इन स्तोत्रोंद्वारा आपकी स्तुति करे, उसे वित्त, समृद्धि और वैभव देनेके साथ ही
verses.wordMeaning: brahman. These are terrestrial Svargas, 0 brdhman; they- surpass Svarga with their excellences. In them no fresh
verses.commentary: Sense: brahman. These are terrestrial Svargas, 0 brdhman; they- surpass Svarga with their excellences. In them no fresh

verses.sanskrit: ततो मया विनिश्चित्य दुः खाद्वैराग्यभावना । भविष्यतीत्यस्य भवानित्युद्योगाय संश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tato mayā viniścitya duḥ khādvairāgyabhāvanā / bhaviṣyatītyasya bhavānityudyogāya saṃśritaḥ
verses.translation: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.
verses.hindi: उसकी धन और स्त्री आदि सम्पत्तिको भी बढ़ानेके लिये आप सदा हमपर प्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.
verses.commentary: Sense: vat; these mountains aro well-known as lying on the west of Meru beyond the subjacent hills§ which are on the west side.

verses.sanskrit: तदस्य दुः खाद्वैराग्यं संबोधादवनीपते । समुद्भूतं कृतं कार्यं भद्रं ते ऽस्तु व्रजाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tadasya duḥ khādvairāgyaṃ saṃbodhādavanīpate / samudbhūtaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhadraṃ te 'stu vrajāmyaham
verses.translation: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-
verses.hindi: ऋषिरुवाच ।/ ३८ ॥। इति प्रसादिता देवैर्जगतोरथें तथा55त्मन: । तथेत्युक्त्वा भद्रकाली बभूवान्तर्हिता नूप ।। ३९ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-
verses.commentary: Sense: Hear yet the other rr.ountains on the north. S^ankha-kuta, Vrishabha, and the mountain Haipsa-n^bha, and the moun-

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्वा मदालसागर्भे पीत्वा सत्सास्तथा स्तनम् । नान्यनारीसुतैर्यातं वर्त्म यात्विति पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: uṣṭvā madālasāgarbhe pītvā satsāstathā stanam / nānyanārīsutairyātaṃ vartma yātviti pārthiva
verses.translation: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-
verses.hindi: देवी देवशरीरेभ्यो जगत्त्रयहितैषिणी  ४० ।।
verses.wordMeaning: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-
verses.commentary: Sense: tain Kapilendra, Sanu-mat, and Nila, Svarna-^ringin, S'dta-

verses.sanskrit: विचार्य तन्मया सर्वं युष्मत्संश्रयपूर्वकम् । कृतं तच्चापि निष्पन्नं प्रयास्ये सिद्धये पुनः
verses.transliteration: vicārya tanmayā sarvaṃ yuṣmatsaṃśrayapūrvakam / kṛtaṃ taccāpi niṣpannaṃ prayāsye siddhaye punaḥ
verses.translation: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on
verses.hindi: वधाय दुष्टहैत्यानां तथा शुम्भनिशुम्भयो: ।। ४१ ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on
verses.commentary: Sense: Mayura, and Jarudhi; these are said to be the mountains on

verses.sanskrit: उपेक्ष्यते सीदमानः स्वजनो बान्धवः सुहृत् । यैर्नरेन्द्र ! न तान् मन्ये सेन्द्रिया विकला हि ते
verses.transliteration: upekṣyate sīdamānaḥ svajano bāndhavaḥ suhṛt / yairnarendra ! na tān manye sendriyā vikalā hi te
verses.translation: Rdkshasas, and the gods, and the Gandharvas, which possess great merit and are studded with charming groves which tho gods frequent. And the lakes are charming; the breeze is
verses.hindi: रक्षणाय च लोकानां देवानामुपकारिणी ।
verses.wordMeaning: Rdkshasas, and the gods, and the Gandharvas, which possess great merit and are studded with charming groves which tho gods frequent. And the lakes are charming; the breeze is

verses.sanskrit: स चोक्तो वै पृथक् स्त्रीत्वं पुरुषत्वं तथाकरोत् । बिभेद पुरुषत्वञ्च दशधा चैकधा तु सः
verses.transliteration: sa cokto vai pṛthak strītvaṃ puruṣatvaṃ tathākarot / bibheda puruṣatvañca daśadhā caikadhā tu saḥ
