verses.sanskrit: मया च याचितः पुर्वं ब्रह्ममित्रो ऽभवन्मुनिः । आयुर्वेदमशेषं मे भगवन् ! दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: mayā ca yācitaḥ purvaṃ brahmamitro 'bhavanmuniḥ / āyurvedamaśeṣaṃ me bhagavan ! dātumarhasi
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: अवीक्षित बोले--राजन्! ये सर्प भयभीत होकर मेरी शरणमें आये हैं और मैं तुम्हें मना करता हूँ; फिर भी इन नागोंकी हिंसा करते हो तो मैं तुम्हारे अस्त्रका प्रतिकार करता हूँ। मैंने भी अस्त्र-विद्या सीखी है। पृथ्वीपर केवल तुम्हीं अस्त्रवेत्ता नहीं हो। भला, मेरे आगे तुम्हारा पुरुषार्थ क्या है।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु बहुशो वीर ! प्रश्रयावनतस्य मे । न प्रादाद्याचितो विद्यामायुर्वेदात्मिकां मम
verses.transliteration: yadā tu bahuśo vīra ! praśrayāvanatasya me / na prādādyācito vidyāmāyurvedātmikāṃ mama
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: यह कहकर क्रोधसे लाल आँखें किये अवीक्षितने धनुष चढ़ाया और उसपर कालास्त्रका सन्धान किया; फिर तो समुद्र और पर्वतोंसहित समूची पृथ्वी, जो संवर्तस्त्रिसे सन्तप्त हो रही थी, कालास्त्रका सन्धान होते ही काँप उठी। मरुत्तने भी पिताद्वारा उठाये हुए कालास्त्रको देखकर कहा--“तात! मैंने तो दुष्टोंको दण्ड देनेके लिये यह अस्त्र उठाया
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्येभ्यो ददतस्तस्य मयान्तर्धानगेन हि । आयुर्वेदात्मिका विद्या गृहीताभूत्तदानघ
verses.transliteration: śiṣyebhyo dadatastasya mayāntardhānagena hi / āyurvedātmikā vidyā gṛhītābhūttadānagha
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: है, आपका वध करनेके लिये नहीं। फिर आप मुझपर कालास्त्रका प्रयोग क्‍यों करते हैं? महाभाग! मुझे प्रजाजनोंका पालन करना है। आप क्‍यों मेरा वध करनेके लिये अस्त्र उठाते
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीतायान्तु विद्यायां मासैरष्टाभिरन्तरात् । ममातिहर्षादभवद्धासो ऽतीव पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītāyāntu vidyāyāṃ māsairaṣṭābhirantarāt / mamātiharṣādabhavaddhāso 'tīva punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: अवीक्षित बोले--हम शरणागतोंकी रक्षा करनेपर तुल गये हैं और तुम इसमें विघ्न डालनेवाले हो; अतः मैं तुम्हें जीवित नहीं छोड७ूँगा। जो शरणमें आये हुए पीड़ित मनुष्यपर, वह शत्रुपक्षका ही क्‍यों न हो, दया नहीं दिखाता, उस पुरुषके जीवनको धिक्‍कार है। मैं
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यभिज्ञाय मां हासान्मुनिः कोपसमन्वितः । विकम्पिकन्धरः प्राह मामिदं परुषाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: pratyabhijñāya māṃ hāsānmuniḥ kopasamanvitaḥ / vikampikandharaḥ prāha māmidaṃ paruṣākṣaram
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय हूँ। ये भयभीत होकर मेरी शरणमें आये हैं और तुम्हीं इनके अपकारी हो। फिर
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसेनैव यस्मान्मे त्वयादृश्येन दुर्मते । हृता विद्यावहासश्च मामवज्ञाय वै कृतः
verses.transliteration: rākṣasenaiva yasmānme tvayādṛśyena durmate / hṛtā vidyāvahāsaśca māmavajñāya vai kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: मरुत्तने कहा--ित्र, बान्धव, पिता अथवा गुरु भी यदि प्रजा-पालनमें विघ्न डाले तो राजाके द्वारा वह मार डालने योग्य है। अत: पिताजी! मैं आपपर प्रहार करूँगा। आप मुझपर क्रोध न कीजियेगा। मुझे अपने धर्मका पालनमात्र करना है। आपपर मेरा रत्तीभर भी क्रोध नहीं है।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं राक्षसः पाप ! मच्छापेन निराकृतः । भविष्यसि न सन्देहः सप्तरात्रेण दारुणः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ rākṣasaḥ pāpa ! macchāpena nirākṛtaḥ / bhaviṣyasi na sandehaḥ saptarātreṇa dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: उन दोनोंको एक-दूसरेका वध करनेके लिये दृढ़संकल्प देख भार्गव आदि मुनि बीचमें आ पड़े और मरुत्तसे बोले--'तुम्हें अपने पितापर हथियार चलाना उचित नहीं है।” फिर अवीक्षितसे बोले--“आपको भी अपने विख्यात पुत्रका वध नहीं करना चाहिए।”'
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते प्रणिपाताद्यैरुपचारैः प्रसादितः । स मामाह पुनर्विप्रस्तत्क्षणान्मृदुमानसः
verses.transliteration: ityukte praṇipātādyairupacāraiḥ prasāditaḥ / sa māmāha punarviprastatkṣaṇānmṛdumānasaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: मरुत्तने कहा--ब्राह्मणो! मैं राजा हूँ, मुझे दुष्टोंका वध और साधु पुरुषोंकी रक्षा करनी है। ये सर्पलोग दुष्ट हैं। अत: मेरा इसमें क्या अपराध है?
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: यन्मयोक्तमवश्यन्तद्भावि गन्धर्व ! नान्यथा । किन्तु त्वं राक्षसो भूत्वा पुनः स्वं प्राप्स्यसे वपुः
verses.transliteration: yanmayoktamavaśyantadbhāvi gandharva ! nānyathā / kintu tvaṃ rākṣaso bhūtvā punaḥ svaṃ prāpsyase vapuḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: अवीक्षित बोले--मुझे शरणागतोंकी रक्षा करनी है और यह उन्हीं शरणागतोंका वध करता है; अतः मेरा पुत्र होनेपर भी अपराधी है।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टस्मृतिर्यदा क्रुद्धः स्वमपत्यञ्चिखादिषुः । निशाचरत्वं गन्तासि तदस्त्रानलतापितः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭasmṛtiryadā kruddhaḥ svamapatyañcikhādiṣuḥ / niśācaratvaṃ gantāsi tadastrānalatāpitaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--से नाग कह रहे हैं कि दुष्ट सर्पोने जिन ब्राह्मणोंको काट खाया है, उन्हें हम जीवित किये देते हैं। अत: युद्ध करनेकी आवश्यकता नहीं है। आप दोनों श्रेष्ठ राजा प्रसन्न हों।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः संज्ञामवाप्य स्वामवाप्स्यसि निजं वपुः । तथैव स्वमधिष्ठानं लोके गन्धर्वसंज्ञिते
verses.transliteration: punaḥ saṃjñāmavāpya svāmavāpsyasi nijaṃ vapuḥ / tathaiva svamadhiṣṭhānaṃ loke gandharvasaṃjñite
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: इसी समय वीराने आकर अपने पुत्र अवीक्षितसे कहा--“वत्स! मेरे कहनेसे ही तुम्हारा पुत्र इन नागोंका वध करनेके लिये उद्यत हुआ है। यदि मरे हुए ब्राह्मण जीवित हो जाते हैं तो अपना कार्य सिद्ध हो जायगा और तुम्हारे शरणागत सर्प जीवित छूट जायँगे।' तब नागोंने विष खींचकर दिव्य ओषधियोंके प्रयोगसे उन ब्राह्मणोंको जीवित कर दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं त्वया महाभाग ! मोक्षितो ऽस्मान्महाभयात् । निशाचरत्वाद् यद्वीर ! तेन मे प्रार्थनां कुरु
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ tvayā mahābhāga ! mokṣito 'smānmahābhayāt / niśācaratvād yadvīra ! tena me prārthanāṃ kuru
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर राजा मरुत्तने पुनः अपने माता-पिताके चरणोंमें प्रणाम किया। अवीक्षितने भी मरुत्तको प्रेमपूर्वक हृदयसे लगा लिया और कहा--“वत्स! तुम शत्रुओंका मान मर्दन करो, चिरकालतक पृथ्वीका पालन करते रहो। पुत्र और पौत्रोंक साथ आनन्द भोगो तथा तुम्हारे कोई शत्रु न हों।'
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: इमान्ते तनयां भार्यां प्रयच्छामि प्रतीच्छ ताम् । आयुर्वेदश्च सकलस्त्वष्टाङ्गो यो मया ततः । मुनेः सकाशात् संप्राप्तस्तं गृह्णीष्व महामते
verses.transliteration: imānte tanayāṃ bhāryāṃ prayacchāmi pratīccha tām / āyurvedaśca sakalastvaṣṭāṅgo yo mayā tataḥ / muneḥ sakāśāt saṃprāptastaṃ gṛhṇīṣva mahāmate
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद ब्राह्मणों और वीराकी आज्ञा ले अवीक्षित, मरुत्त और भामिनी रथपर आरूढ़ हो अपनी राजधानीको चले गये। धर्मात्माओंमें श्रेष्ठ महाभागा पतिव्रता वीरा भी भारी तपस्या करके पतिके लोकमें चली गयीं। राजा मरुत्तने भी काम, क्रोध आदि छः शत्रुओंको जीतकर धर्मपूर्वक पृथ्वीका पालन किया। महाबली महाराज मरुत्तका ऐसा ही
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्त्वा प्रददौ विद्यां स च दिव्याम्बरोज्जवलः । स्त्रग्भूषणधरो दिव्यं पुराणं वपुरास्थितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityuktvā pradadau vidyāṃ sa ca divyāmbarojjavalaḥ / stragbhūṣaṇadharo divyaṃ purāṇaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: पराक्रम था। सातों द्वीपोंमें कहीं भी उनकी आज्ञाका उल्‍लड्घन नहीं होता था। उनके समान दूसरा कोई राजा न हुआ है, न होगा। वे सत्त्व तथा पराक्रमसे युक्त और महान् तेजस्वी थे। द्विजश्रेष्ठ! महात्मा मरुत्तके उत्तम जन्म एवं चरित्रकी यह कथा सुननेसे मनुष्य सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा विद्यां ततः कन्यां स दातुमुपचक्रमे । तमाह सा तदा कन्या जनितारं स्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā vidyāṃ tataḥ kanyāṃ sa dātumupacakrame / tamāha sā tadā kanyā janitāraṃ svarūpiṇam
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: राजा नरिष्यन्त और दमका चरित्र
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: अनुरागो ममाप्यत्र तातातीव महात्मनि । दर्शनादेव संजातो विशेषेणोपकारिणि
verses.transliteration: anurāgo mamāpyatra tātātīva mahātmani / darśanādeva saṃjāto viśeṣeṇopakāriṇi
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--मरुत्तके अठारह पुत्रोंमें नरिष्यन्त सबसे ज्येष्ठ और श्रेष्ठ थे। क्षत्रियोंमें श्रेष्ठ महाराज मरुत्तने पचासी हजार वर्षोतक समूची पृथ्वीका राज्य किया। धर्मपूर्वक राज्यका पालन और उत्तमोत्तम यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान करके मरुत्तने अपने ज्येष्ठ पुत्र नरिष्यन्तको राजपदपर अभिषिक्त कर दिया और स्वयं वनमें चले गये। वहाँ एकाग्रचित्त
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: किन्त्वेषा मे सखी सा च मत्कृते दुः खपीडिते । अतो नाभिलषे भोगान् भोक्तुमेतेन वै समम्
verses.transliteration: kintveṣā me sakhī sā ca matkṛte duḥ khapīḍite / ato nābhilaṣe bhogān bhoktumetena vai samam
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: होकर उन्होंने बड़ी भारी तपस्या की और अपने सुयशसे पृथ्वी एवं आकाशको व्याप्त करके वे स्वर्गलोकमें चले गये। तदनन्तर उनके बुद्धिमान् पुत्र नरिष्यन्तने अपने पिता तथा अन्य पूर्वजोंके चरित्रकी आलोचना करके मन-ही-मन सोचा--वंशकी मान-मर्यादाका पालन, लज्जाकी रक्षा, शत्रुओंपर क्रोध, सबको अपने-अपने धर्ममें लगाना और युद्धसे
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषैरपि नो शक्या कर्तुमित्थं नृशंसता । स्वभावरुचिरैर्मादृक् कथं योषित् करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: puruṣairapi no śakyā kartumitthaṃ nṛśaṃsatā / svabhāvarucirairmādṛk kathaṃ yoṣit kariṣyati
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: कभी पीठ न दिखाना--इन सब बातोंका मेरे पूर्वपुरुषोंने तथा पिताजीने जैसा पालन किया है, वैसा दूसरा कौन कर सकता है। मेरे पूर्वजोंने कौन ऐसा शुभ कर्म नहीं किया है, जिसको मैं करूँ। वे बड़े-बड़े यज्ञ करनेवाले जितेन्द्रिय, संग्रामसे पीछे न हटनेवाले, बड़े-बड़े युद्धोंमें भाग लेनेवाले तथा अनृपम पुरुषार्थी थे; मैं निष्काम कर्मका अनुष्ठान करूँगा। मेरे पहलेके
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: साहं यथा ते दुः खार्ते मत्कृते कन्यके पितः । तथा स्थास्यामि तद्दुः खे तच्छोकानलतापिता
verses.transliteration: sāhaṃ yathā te duḥ khārte matkṛte kanyake pitaḥ / tathā sthāsyāmi tadduḥ khe tacchokānalatāpitā
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: राजाओंने स्वयं ही निरन्तर यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान किया है, दूसरोंसे नहीं कराया है; मैं ऐसा करूँगा, जिससे दूसरे भी यज्ञ करें।
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरोचिरुवाच आयुर्वेदप्रसादेन ते करिष्ये पुनर्नवे । सख्यौ तव महाशोकं समुत्सृज सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: svarociruvāca āyurvedaprasādena te kariṣye punarnave / sakhyau tava mahāśokaṃ samutsṛja sumadhyame
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: यों विचारकर महाराज नरिष्यन्तने धन-दानसे सुशोभित एक ऐसा यज्ञ किया, जिसके समान यज्ञ दूसरे किसीने नहीं किया था। उन्होंने ब्राह्मणोंके जीवन-निर्वाहके लिये बहुत बड़ी सम्पत्ति देकर उसकी अपेक्षा सौगुना अन्न दान किया। इस भूमिपर रहनेवाले प्रत्येक ब्राह्यणको धन और अन्न देनेके अतिरिक्त गौ, वस्त्र, आभूषण तथा धान्य भण्डार आदि भी
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततः पित्रा स्वयं दत्तां तां कन्यां स विधानतः । उपयेमे गिरौ तस्मिन् स्वरोचिश्चारुलोचवनाम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ pitrā svayaṃ dattāṃ tāṃ kanyāṃ sa vidhānataḥ / upayeme girau tasmin svarociścārulocavanām
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: दिये। इसके बाद जब राजाने दूसरा यज्ञ आरम्भ करना चाहा, तब इसके लिये उन्हें कहीं ब्राह्मण ही नहीं मिले। वे जिस-जिस ब्राह्मणका वरण करते, वही उत्तर देता, “हम तो स्वयं ही यज्ञ कर रहे हैं। आप दूसरे किसी ब्राह्मणका वरण कीजिये। आपने पहले ही यज्ञमें हमें इतना धन दे दिया है, जो अनेक यज्ञ करनेपर भी समाप्त नहीं होगा। अब हमें और धनकी
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तान्तु तां तदा कन्यामभिशान्त्य च भामिनीम् । जगाम दिव्यया गत्यागन्धर्वः स्वपुरन्ततः
verses.transliteration: dattāntu tāṃ tadā kanyāmabhiśāntya ca bhāminīm / jagāma divyayā gatyāgandharvaḥ svapurantataḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: जब एक भी ऋत्विज् ब्राह्मण नहीं मिला, तब महाराजने बहिर्वेदीमें दान देनेका आयोजन किया तथापि धनसे घर भरा रहनेके कारण ब्राह्मणोंने वह दान नहीं ग्रहण किया। उस समय राजाने यह उद्घार प्रकट किया--“अहो! इस पृथ्वीपर कहीं एक भी निर्धन ब्राह्मण नहीं है, यह कितनी सुन्दर बात है!” तदनन्तर उन्होंने भक्तिपूर्वक बारंबार प्रणाम करके कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि सहितस्तन्व्या सदुद्यानन्तदा ययौ । कन्यकायुगलं यत्र तच्छापोत्थगदातुरम्
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi sahitastanvyā sadudyānantadā yayau / kanyakāyugalaṃ yatra tacchāpotthagadāturam
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको ऋत्विज् बनाया और बहुत बड़ा यज्ञ आरम्भ किया। उस समय बड़े आश्वर्यकी बात यह हुई कि भूमण्डलके सभी ब्राह्मण यज्ञ करने लगे, इसलिये राजाके यज्ञ-मण्डपमें कोई सदस्य न बन सका। कुछ ब्राह्मण यजमान थे और कुछ यज्ञ करानेवाले पुरोहित बन गये। राजा नरिष्यन्तने जिस समय यज्ञ आरम्भ किया, उस समय पृथ्वीके समस्त ब्राह्मण
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तयोः स तत्त्वज्ञो रोगघ्नैरौषधै रसैः । चकार नीरुजौ देहौ स्वरोचिरपराजितः
verses.transliteration: tatastayoḥ sa tattvajño rogaghnairauṣadhai rasaiḥ / cakāra nīrujau dehau svarociraparājitaḥ
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: उन्हींके दिये हुए धनसे यज्ञ करने लगे। पूर्व दिशामें अठारह करोड़, पश्चिममें सात करोड़, दक्षिणमें चौदह करोड़ और उत्तरमें पंद्रह करोड़ यज्ञ एक ही समय आरम्भ हुए। इस प्रकार मरुत्तनन्दन राजा नरिष्यन्त बड़े धर्मात्मा हुए। वे अपने बल और पुरुषार्थके लिये सर्वत्र
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽतिशोभने कन्ये विमुक्ते व्याधितः शुभे । स्वकान्त्योद्योति दिग्भागं चक्राते तन्महीधरम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'tiśobhane kanye vimukte vyādhitaḥ śubhe / svakāntyodyoti digbhāgaṃ cakrāte tanmahīdharam
verses.translation: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.hindi: नरिष्यन्तके दम नामक पुत्र हुआ, जो दुष्ट शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाला था। उसमें इन्द्रके समान बल और मुनियोंके समान दया एवं शील था। बश्रुकी कन्या इन्द्रसेना नरिष्यन्तकी पत्नी थी। उसीके गर्भसे दमका जन्म हुआ था। उस महायशस्वी पुत्रने नौ वर्षोतक माताके गर्भमें रहकर उसके द्वारा दमका पालन कराया, तथा स्वयं भी दमनशील था। इसीलिये
verses.wordMeaning: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, lustrous as the immortals, then took the hands of both in marriage, while heavenly musical instruments sounded out and the Apsarases danced.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे स्वारोचिषे मन्वन्तरे त्रिषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः चतुः षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः- ६४ मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवं विमुक्तरोगा तु कन्यका तं मुदान्विता । स्वरोचिषमुवाचेदं शृणुष्व वचनं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe svārociṣe manvantare triṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ catuḥ ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ- 64 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ vimuktarogā tu kanyakā taṃ mudānvitā / svarociṣamuvācedaṃ śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ prabho
verses.translation: Then the adorable god made the Prajdpati named Svaro- cisha D)’uti-mat a Manu. Listen to his Manv-antara; who
verses.hindi: त्रिकालवेत्ता पुरोहितने उसका नाम “दम” रखा। राजकुमार दमने हैत्यराज वृषपर्वासे सम्पूर्ण धनुर्वेदकी शिक्षा पायी। तपोवननिवासी हैत्यराज दुन्दुभिसे सम्पूर्ण अस्त्र प्राप्त किये। महर्षि शक्तिसे वेदों तथा समस्त वेदाड़ोंका अध्ययन किया और राजर्षि आर्टिषेणसे योगविद्या प्राप्त की। वे सुन्दर रूपवान्, महात्मा, अस्त्रविद्याके ज्ञाता और महान् बलवान् थे; अतः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the adorable god made the Prajdpati named Svaro- cisha D)’uti-mat a Manu. Listen to his Manv-antara; who
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the adorable god made the Prajdpati named Svaro- cisha D)’uti-mat a Manu. Listen to his Manv-antara; who

verses.sanskrit: मन्दारविद्याधरजा नाम्ना ख्याता विभावरी । उपकारिन् ! स्वमात्मानं प्रयच्छामि प्रतीच्छ माम्
verses.transliteration: mandāravidyādharajā nāmnā khyātā vibhāvarī / upakārin ! svamātmānaṃ prayacchāmi pratīccha mām
verses.translation: were the gods during that period, who were the munis and their sons, who were the princes, listen while I tell of them^
verses.hindi: राजकुमारी सुमनाने पिताद्वारा आयोजित स्वयंवरमें उन्हें अपना पति चुन लिया। वह दशार्ण देशके बलवान् राजा चारुवर्माकी पुत्री थी। उसकी प्राप्तिके लिये वहाँ जितने राजा आये थे, सब देखते ही रह गये और उसने दमका वरण कर लिया। मद्रराजकुमार महानन्द, जो बड़ा बलवान् और पराक्रमी था, सुमनाके प्रति अनुरक्त हो गया था; इसी प्रकार विदर्भ देशके
verses.wordMeaning: were the gods during that period, who were the munis and their sons, who were the princes, listen while I tell of them^
verses.commentary: Sense: were the gods during that period, who were the munis and their sons, who were the princes, listen while I tell of them^

verses.sanskrit: विद्याञ्च तुभ्यं दास्यामि सर्वबूतरुतानि ते । ययाभिव्यक्तिमेष्यन्ति प्रसादपुरगो भव
verses.transliteration: vidyāñca tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sarvabūtarutāni te / yayābhivyaktimeṣyanti prasādapurago bhava
verses.translation: The gods in that period were the Paravatas and also the Tnshitas. 0 brahman; and in Svarocisha’s period the
verses.hindi: राजा संक्रन्दनका राजकुमार वपुष्मान् तथा उदारबुद्धि महाधनु भी सुमनाकी ओर आकृष्ट थे। उन सबने देखा, सुमनाने दुष्ट शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाले दमका वरण कर लिया; तब कामसे मोहित होकर आपसमें सलाह की--“'हमलोग इस सुन्दरी कन्याको बलपूर्वक पकड़कर घर ले चलें। वहाँ यह स्वयंवरकी विधिसे हममेंसे जिसको वरण करेगी, उसीकी
verses.wordMeaning: The gods in that period were the Paravatas and also the Tnshitas. 0 brahman; and in Svarocisha’s period the
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods in that period were the Paravatas and also the Tnshitas. 0 brahman; and in Svarocisha’s period the

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमस्त्विति तेनोक्ते धर्मज्ञेन स्वरोचिषा । द्वितीया तु तदा कन्या इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evamastviti tenokte dharmajñena svarociṣā / dvitīyā tu tadā kanyā idaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Inclra was famed as Yipad-cit. l/rja, Tamba and Prana, Dattoli and Rishabha, Ni^cara and Carva-virat were the seven
verses.hindi: ऐसा निश्चय करके उन तीनों राजकुमारोंने दमके पास खड़ी हुई उस सुन्दरी कन्याको पकड़ लिया। उस समय जो राजा दमके पक्षमें थे, उन्होंने बड़ा कोलाहल मचाया। कुछ लोग कुपित होकर रह गये और कुछ लोग मध्यस्थ बन गये। इस घटनासे दमके चित्तमें तनिक भी घबराहट नहीं हुई। उन्होंने चारों ओर खड़े हुए राजाओंको देखकर कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Inclra was famed as Yipad-cit. l/rja, Tamba and Prana, Dattoli and Rishabha, Ni^cara and Carva-virat were the seven
verses.commentary: Sense: Inclra was famed as Yipad-cit. l/rja, Tamba and Prana, Dattoli and Rishabha, Ni^cara and Carva-virat were the seven

verses.sanskrit: कुमारब्रह्मचार्यासीत् पारो नाम पिता मम । ब्रह्मर्षिः सुमहाभागो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः
verses.transliteration: kumārabrahmacāryāsīt pāro nāma pitā mama / brahmarṣiḥ sumahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
verses.translation: rishis in that 'period. And seven sons had that high souled
verses.hindi: --'भूपालगण! स्वयंवरकी धार्मिक कार्योंमें गणना है, किन्तु वह वास्तवमें अधर्म है या धर्म? इस कन्याको इन लोगोंने जो बलपूर्वक पकड़ लिया है--यह उचित है या अनुचित? यदि स्वयंवर अधर्म है, तब तो मुझे इससे कोई मतलब नहीं है; यह भले ही दूसरेकी पत्नी हो जाय। किन्तु यदि वह धर्म है, तब तो यह मेरी पत्नी हो चुकी; उस दशामें इन प्राणोंको
verses.wordMeaning: rishis in that 'period. And seven sons had that high souled
verses.commentary: Sense: rishis in that 'period. And seven sons had that high souled

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुंस्कोकिलालापरमणीये मधौ पुरा । आजगामाप्सराभ्यासं प्रख्याता पुञ्जिकास्तना
verses.transliteration: tasya puṃskokilālāparamaṇīye madhau purā / ājagāmāpsarābhyāsaṃ prakhyātā puñjikāstanā
verses.translation: the earth. So long as his Manv-antara lasted, all this earth was enjoyed among the outspreadings of his family. That was the second Ifawr-antara.
verses.hindi: धारण करके क्‍या होगा, जो शत्रुकी उपेक्षा करके बचाये जाते हैं।! तब दशार्णनरेश चारुवर्माने कोलाहल शान्त कराकर सभासदोंसे पूछा--'राजाओ! दमने जो यह धर्म और अधर्मसे सम्बन्ध रखनेवाली बात पूछी है, इसका उत्तर आपलोग दें, जिससे इनके और मेरे धर्मका लोप न हो।'
verses.wordMeaning: the earth. So long as his Manv-antara lasted, all this earth was enjoyed among the outspreadings of his family. That was the second Ifawr-antara.
verses.commentary: Sense: the earth. So long as his Manv-antara lasted, all this earth was enjoyed among the outspreadings of his family. That was the second Ifawr-antara.

verses.sanskrit: कामवक्तव्यतां नीतः स तदा मुनिपुङ्गवः । तत्संयोगे ऽहमुत्पन्ना तस्यामत्र महाचले
verses.transliteration: kāmavaktavyatāṃ nītaḥ sa tadā munipuṅgavaḥ / tatsaṃyoge 'hamutpannā tasyāmatra mahācale
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: तब कुछ राजाओंने कहा--'परस्पर अनुराग होनेपर गान्धर्व-विवाहका विधान है। परन्तु यह क्षत्रियोंके लिये ही विहित है; वैश्य, शूद्र और ब्राह्मणोंके लिये नहीं। दमका वरण कर लेनेसे आपकी इस कन्याका गान्धर्व-विवाह सम्पन्न हो गया। इस प्रकार धर्मकी दृष्टिसे आपकी पुत्री दमकी पत्नी हो चुकी। जो मोहवश इसके विपरीत आचरण करता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: विहाय मां गता सा च मातास्मिन्निर्जने वने । बालामेकां महीपृष्ठे व्यालश्वापदसंकुले
verses.transliteration: vihāya māṃ gatā sā ca mātāsminnirjane vane / bālāmekāṃ mahīpṛṣṭhe vyālaśvāpadasaṃkule
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: कामासक्त है।' यह सुनकर दमके नेत्र क्रोधसे लाल हो गये। उन्होंने धनुषको चढ़ाया और यह वचन कहा--'यदि मेरी पत्नी मेरे देखते-देखते बलवान् राजाओंके द्वारा हर ली जाय तो मुझ-जैसे नपुंसकके उत्तम कुलसे तथा इन दोनों भुजाओंसे क्या लाभ हुआ। उस दशामें तो मेरे अस्त्रोंकोी, शौर्यको, बाणोंको, धनुषको तथा महात्मा मरुत्तके कुलमें प्राप्त हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कलाभिः सोमस्य वर्धन्तीभिरहः क्षये । आप्याय्यमानाहरहो वृद्धिं यातास्मि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalābhiḥ somasya vardhantībhirahaḥ kṣaye / āpyāyyamānāharaho vṛddhiṃ yātāsmi sattama
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: जन्मको भी धिक्‍कार है।” यों कहकर दमने महानन्द आदि समस्त शत्रुओंसे कहा --'भूपालो! यह बाला अत्यन्त सुन्दरी और कुलीन है। यह जिसकी पत्नी नहीं हुई, उसका जन्म लेना व्यर्थ है--यह विचारकर तुमलोग युद्धमें इस प्रकार यत्न करो, जिससे युद्धमें मुझे परास्त करके इसे अपनी पत्नी बना सको।'
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कलावतीत्येतन्मम नाम महात्मना । गृहीतायः कृतं पित्रा गन्धर्वेण शुभानना
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalāvatītyetanmama nāma mahātmanā / gṛhītāyaḥ kṛtaṃ pitrā gandharveṇa śubhānanā
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: यह कहकर राजकुमार दमने वहाँ बाणोंकी बौछार आरम्भ की। जैसे अन्धकार वृक्षोंको ढक देता है, उसी प्रकार दमने उन राजाओंको बाणोंसे आच्छादित कर दिया। वे भी वीर थे; अतः बाण, शक्ति, ऋष्टि तथा मुद्गरोंकी वर्षा करने लगे। किन्तु दमने उनके चलाये हुए सब हथियारोंको खेल-खेलमें ही काट डाला। तब महापराक्रमी महानन्द वहाँ आ पहुँचा और
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: न दत्ताहं तदा तेन याचितेन महात्मना । देवारिणालिना सुप्तस्ततो मे घातितः पिता
verses.transliteration: na dattāhaṃ tadā tena yācitena mahātmanā / devāriṇālinā suptastato me ghātitaḥ pitā
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: उनके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। तब दमने उसकी छातीमें एक कालाग्निके समान भयड्कर बाण मारा। उससे उसकी छाती विदीर्ण हो गयी; तो भी उसने उस बाणको खींचकर निकाल दिया और दमके ऊपर चमचमाती हुई तलवार फेंकी। उसे उल्काके समान अपनी ओर आते देख दमने शक्तिके प्रहारसे काट डाला और वेतसपत्र नामक बाणसे महानन्दका
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहमतिनिर्वेदादात्मव्यापादनोद्यता । निवारिता शम्भुपत्न्या सत्या सत्यप्रतिश्रवा
verses.transliteration: tato 'hamatinirvedādātmavyāpādanodyatā / nivāritā śambhupatnyā satyā satyapratiśravā
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: मस्तक धड़से अलग कर दिया। महानन्दके मारे जानेपर अधिकांश राजा पीठ दिखाकर भाग गये; केवल कुण्डिनपुरका स्वामी वपुष्मान् डटा रहा और दमके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। युद्ध करते समय उसकी भयड्कर तलवारको दमने बड़ी फुर्तीसे काट दिया तथा उसके सारथिके मस्तक और ध्वजाको भी काट गिराया। तलवार कट जानेपर वपुष्मानने एक गदा
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: मा शुचः सुभ्रु ! भर्ता ते महाभागो भविष्यति । स्वरोचिर्नाम पुत्रश्च मनुस्तस्य भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: mā śucaḥ subhru ! bhartā te mahābhāgo bhaviṣyati / svarocirnāma putraśca manustasya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: उठायी, जिसमें बहुत-सी काँटियाँ गड़ी हुई थीं; किन्तु दमने उसको भी उसके हाथमें ही काट डाला। फिर वषुष्मान् ज्यों ही कोई श्रेष्ठ आयुध हाथमें लेने लगा, त्यों ही दमने उसे बाणोंसे बींधकर पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया। पृथ्वीपर गिरते ही उसका सारा शरीर व्याकुल हो गया। वह थर-थर काँपने लगा। अब युद्ध करनेका उसका विचार न रहा। उसको इस
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाञ्च निधयः सर्वे करिष्यन्ति तवादृताः । यथाभिलषितं वित्तं प्रदास्यन्ति च ते शुभे
verses.transliteration: ājñāñca nidhayaḥ sarve kariṣyanti tavādṛtāḥ / yathābhilaṣitaṃ vittaṃ pradāsyanti ca te śubhe
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: अवस्थामें देखकर दमने जीवित छोड़ दिया और प्रसन्नचित्त हो सुमनाको साथ ले वहाँसे चल दिया। तब दशार्ण देशके राजा चारुवर्मने प्रसन्न होकर दम और सुमनाका विधिपूर्वक विवाह कर दिया। तदनन्तर कुछ काल ठहरनेके पश्चात् दम अपनी स्त्रीसहित अपने घरको चले गये। दशार्णराजने भी बहुत-से हाथी, घोड़े, रथ, गौ, खच्चर, ऊँट, दास-दासियाँ, वस्त्र,
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: यस्या वत्से प्रभावेण विद्यायास्तां गृहाण मे । पद्मिनी नाम विद्येयं महापद्माभिपूजिता
verses.transliteration: yasyā vatse prabhāveṇa vidyāyāstāṃ gṛhāṇa me / padminī nāma vidyeyaṃ mahāpadmābhipūjitā
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: आभूषण और धनुष आदि श्रेष्ठ सामग्री तथा बहुत-से बर्तन दहेजमें देकर वर-वधूको विदा
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याह मां दक्षसुता सती सत्यपरायणा । स्वरोचिस्त्वं ध्रुवं देवी नान्यथा सा वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: ityāha māṃ dakṣasutā satī satyaparāyaṇā / svarocistvaṃ dhruvaṃ devī nānyathā sā vadiṣyati
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: महामुने! दम सुमनाको पत्नीरूपमें पाकर बड़े प्रसन्न थे। घर आकर उन्होंने माता- पिताके चरणोंमें प्रणाम किया। सुमनाने भी सास-ससुरके चरणोंमें मस्तक झुकाया। तब उन दोनोंने भी आशीर्वाद देकर नव-दम्पतिका अभिनन्दन किया। फिर तो नरिष्यन्तके नगरमें बड़ा भारी उत्सव मनाया गया। दशार्णराज सम्बन्धी हुए और बहुत-से राजा पुत्रके हाथों
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: साहं प्राणप्रदायाद्य तां विद्यां स्वं तथा वपुः । प्रयच्छामि प्रतीच्छ त्वं प्रसादसुमुखो मम
verses.transliteration: sāhaṃ prāṇapradāyādya tāṃ vidyāṃ svaṃ tathā vapuḥ / prayacchāmi pratīccha tvaṃ prasādasumukho mama
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: युद्धमें परास्त हो गये, यह सुनकर महाराज नरिष्यन्त बहुत प्रसन्न हुए। दशार्णराजकुमारी सुमना दमके साथ बहुत समयतक विहार करती रही। फिर उसने गर्भ धारण किया। राजा नरिष्यन्त भी सब भोगोंको भोगकर वृद्धावस्थामें पहुँच चुके थे, इसलिये वे दमको राजपदपर अभिषिक्त करके स्वयं वनमें चले गये। उनकी यशस्विनी पत्नी इन्द्रसेनाने भी
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमस्त्विति तामाह स तु कन्यां कलावतीम् । विभावर्याः कलावत्याः स्निग्धदृष्ट्यानुमोदितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evamastviti tāmāha sa tu kanyāṃ kalāvatīm / vibhāvaryāḥ kalāvatyāḥ snigdhadṛṣṭyānumoditaḥ
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: उनका ही अनुसरण किया, नरिष्यन्त वहाँ वानप्रस्थके नियमोंका पालन करते हुए रहने
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह च ततः पाणी स तयोरमरद्युतिः । नदत्सु देवतूर्येषु नृत्यन्तीष्वप्सरः सु च
verses.transliteration: jagrāha ca tataḥ pāṇī sa tayoramaradyutiḥ / nadatsu devatūryeṣu nṛtyantīṣvapsaraḥ su ca
verses.translation: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.hindi: एक दिन दक्षिण देशका दुराचारी राजकुमार वषुष्मान्, जो संक्रन्दनका पुत्र था, थोड़ी सी सेना साथ ले वनमें शिकार खेलनेके लिये गया। उसने तपस्वी नरिष्यन्त तथा उनकी पत्नी इन्द्रसेनाको तपस्यासे अत्यन्त दुर्बल देखकर पूछा--'“आप वानप्रस्थ-आश्रममें स्थित ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय अथवा वैश्य हैं? मुझे बताइये।” राजा नरिष्यन्तने मौन-व्रत धारण कर लिया
verses.wordMeaning: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the man who hears of Sva-rodis’ deeds and Svdro- cisha’s birth, and believes them, is delivered from his sins.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्जडेयपुराणेठस्वारोचिषे मन्वन्तरेऽ चतुः षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः- ६५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततः स ताभिः सहितः पत्नीभिरमरद्युतिः । रराम तस्मिन् शैलेन्द्रे रम्यकानननिर्झरे
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇjaḍeyapurāṇeṭhasvārociṣe manvantare' catuḥ ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ- 65 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ sa tābhiḥ sahitaḥ patnībhiramaradyutiḥ / rarāma tasmin śailendre ramyakānananirjhare
verses.translation: ask thee!
verses.hindi: था, इसलिये उन्होंने कुछ उत्तर नहीं दिया; किन्तु उनकी पत्नी इन्द्रसेनाने सब बातें सच-सच बता दीं। परिचय पाकर वपुष्मानने सोचा, अब तो मैं अपने शत्रुके पिताको पा गया हूँ। यह विचारकर उसने कुपित हो नरिष्यन्तकी जटा पकड़ ली। इन्द्रसेना आँसू बहाती हुई गद्गदकण्ठसे रोने और हाहाकार करने लगी। वपुष्मानने म्यानसे तलवार निकाल ली और

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपभोगरत्नानि मधूनि मधुराणि च । निधयः समुपाजह्रुः पद्मिन्या वशवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: sarvopabhogaratnāni madhūni madhurāṇi ca / nidhayaḥ samupājahruḥ padminyā vaśavartinaḥ
verses.translation: While I slept just as I was, with the door fastened, 0 ki why and by whom my wife was carried off— this thou, Sir*
verses.hindi: यह बात कही, “जिसने युद्धमें मुझे परास्त किया और मेरी सुमनाको हर लिया, उस दमके पिताको आज मैं मार डालूँगा। अब वह आकर इनकी रक्षा करे।'
verses.wordMeaning: While I slept just as I was, with the door fastened, 0 ki why and by whom my wife was carried off— this thou, Sir*
verses.commentary: Sense: While I slept just as I was, with the door fastened, 0 ki why and by whom my wife was carried off— this thou, Sir*

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रजो वस्त्राण्यलङ्कारान् गन्धाढ्यमनुलेपनम् । आसनान्यतिशुभ्राणि काञ्चनानि यथेच्छया
verses.transliteration: strajo vastrāṇyalaṅkārān gandhāḍhyamanulepanam / āsanānyatiśubhrāṇi kāñcanāni yathecchayā
verses.translation: I have not seen thy wife. Tell mo what is she like in body, and what is her age; and of what disposition is the brdhman lady?
verses.hindi: यों कहकर उस दुराचारीने इन्द्रसेनाको रोती-बिलखती छोड़ नरिष्यन्तका मस्तक काट डाला, तब समस्त मुनि तथा अन्य वनवासी भी उसे धिककारने लगे। वपुष्मान् अपने नगरको लौट गया। उसके चले जानेपर इन्द्रसेनाने एक शूद्र तपस्वीको अपने पुत्रके पास भेजा और कहा--'तुम शीघ्र जाकर मेरे पुत्रसे यह सब हाल कहो। मेरा सन्देश इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: I have not seen thy wife. Tell mo what is she like in body, and what is her age; and of what disposition is the brdhman lady?
verses.commentary: Sense: I have not seen thy wife. Tell mo what is she like in body, and what is her age; and of what disposition is the brdhman lady?

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णानि महाभाग ! करकान् भाजनानि च । तथा शय्याश्च विविधा दिव्यैरास्तरणैर्युताः
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇāni mahābhāga ! karakān bhājanāni ca / tathā śayyāśca vividhā divyairāstaraṇairyutāḥ
verses.translation: Sharp-eyed is she, very tall, short-armed, thin-faced, ungainly in form, 0 king. I defame her not by this description;
verses.hindi: कहना--“महाराजकी इस प्रकार तिरस्कारपूर्ण हिंसा देखकर मैं बहुत दुःखी हूँ। राजा होनेका अधिकार उसीको है, जो चारों वर्णों और आश्रमोंकी रक्षा करे। तुम जो तपस्वियोंकी रक्षा नहीं करते, क्या यही तुम्हारे लिये उचित है? तुम्हारे महाराज नरिष्यन्तके विषयमें यह बात प्रसिद्ध हो गयी कि बिना किसी अपराधके उनके केश पकड़कर वपुष्मानने उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Sharp-eyed is she, very tall, short-armed, thin-faced, ungainly in form, 0 king. I defame her not by this description;
verses.commentary: Sense: Sharp-eyed is she, very tall, short-armed, thin-faced, ungainly in form, 0 king. I defame her not by this description;

verses.sanskrit: एवं स ताभिः सहितो दिव्यगन्धाधिवासिते । रराम स्वरुचिर्भाभिर्भासिते वरपर्वते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa tābhiḥ sahito divyagandhādhivāsite / rarāma svarucirbhābhirbhāsite varaparvate
verses.translation: very harsh in speech, and ungentle is she in disposition,
verses.hindi: हत्या की; ऐसी स्थितिमें तुम वही कार्य करो, जिससे तुम्हारे धर्मका लोप न हो। इससे आगे मुझे कुछ नहीं कहना है, क्योंकि मैं तपस्विनी हूँ। तुम्हारे मन्‍्त्री वीर तथा सब शास्त्रोंके ज्ञाता हैं; उन सबके साथ विचार करके इस समय जो करना उचित हो, वह करो। अपने पिता
verses.wordMeaning: very harsh in speech, and ungentle is she in disposition,
verses.commentary: Sense: very harsh in speech, and ungentle is she in disposition,

verses.sanskrit: ताश्चापि सह तेनेति लेभिरे मुदमुत्तमाम् । रममाणा यथा स्वर्गे तथा तत्र शिलोच्चये
verses.transliteration: tāścāpi saha teneti lebhire mudamuttamām / ramamāṇā yathā svarge tathā tatra śiloccaye
verses.translation: unpleasant in look, and she has slightly passed early woman- hood, 0 king. Such is my wife in form; true is this I have spoken.
verses.hindi: शक्तिको राक्षसके हाथसे मारा गया सुनकर महर्षि पराशरने समस्त राक्षस-कुलको अग्निकुण्डमें होमकर भस्म कर दिया था। मैं तो ऐसा मानती हूँ कि तुम्हारे पिता नहीं, तुम मारे गये; उनके ऊपर नहीं, तुम्हारे ऊपर वह तलवार गिरी है। यह तुम्हारी ही मर्यादाका उल्लड्घन किया गया है। अब तुम्हें भृत्य, कुटुम्ब और बन्धु-बान्धवोंसहित वपुष्मानके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: unpleasant in look, and she has slightly passed early woman- hood, 0 king. Such is my wife in form; true is this I have spoken.
verses.commentary: Sense: unpleasant in look, and she has slightly passed early woman- hood, 0 king. Such is my wife in form; true is this I have spoken.

verses.sanskrit: कलहंसी जगादैकां चक्रवाकीं जले सतीम् । तस्य तासाञ्च ललिते सम्बन्धे च स्पृहावती
verses.transliteration: kalahaṃsī jagādaikāṃ cakravākīṃ jale satīm / tasya tāsāñca lalite sambandhe ca spṛhāvatī
verses.translation: "A wife must be guarded," 0 king — such is our highest divine teaching. When a wife is guarded, the offspring is gnai’*
verses.hindi: जो बर्ताव करना उचित हो, वह करो।'
verses.wordMeaning: "A wife must be guarded," 0 king — such is our highest divine teaching. When a wife is guarded, the offspring is gnai’*
verses.commentary: Sense: "A wife must be guarded," 0 king — such is our highest divine teaching. When a wife is guarded, the offspring is gnai’*

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽयमतिपुण्यो ऽयं यो ऽय यौवनगोचरः । दयिताभिः सहैताभिर्भुङ्क्ते भोगानभीप्सितान्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'yamatipuṇyo 'yaṃ yo 'ya yauvanagocaraḥ / dayitābhiḥ sahaitābhirbhuṅkte bhogānabhīpsitān
verses.translation: ded. For the Soul is born in her, hence she must be guarded,
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार संदेश दे इन्द्रसेनाने शूद्र तपस्वीको विदा किया और स्वयं पतिके शरीरको गोदमें ले वे अग्निमें प्रवेश कर गयीं। इन्द्रसेनाकी आज्ञाके अनुसार शूद्र तापसने वहाँ जाकर दमसे उनके पिताके मारे जानेका सब समाचार कहा। यह सुनकर दम क्रोधसे जल उठा। जैसे घी डालनेपर आग प्रज्वलित हो उठती है, उसी प्रकार दम क्रोधाग्निसे जलते हुए हाथ-
verses.wordMeaning: ded. For the Soul is born in her, hence she must be guarded,
verses.commentary: Sense: ded. For the Soul is born in her, hence she must be guarded,

verses.sanskrit: सन्ति यौवनिनः श्लाघ्यास्तत्पत्न्यो नातिशोभनाः । जगत्यामल्पकाः पत्न्यः पतयश्चातिशोभनाः
verses.transliteration: santi yauvaninaḥ ślāghyāstatpatnyo nātiśobhanāḥ / jagatyāmalpakāḥ patnyaḥ patayaścātiśobhanāḥ
verses.translation: When she is not guarded, there will arise confusion among
verses.hindi: से-हाथ मलने लगे और इस प्रकार बोले--“ओह! मुझ पुत्रके जीतेजी उस नृशंस वपुष्मानने मेरे पिताको अनाथकी भाँति मार डाला और इस प्रकार मेरे कुलका अपमान किया। यदि मैं बैठकर शोक मनाऊँ या क्षमा कर दूँ तो यह मेरी नपुंसकता है। दुष्टोंका दमन और साधु पुरुषोंका पालन--यही मेरा कर्तव्य है। मेरे पिताको मारा गया देखकर भी यदि शत्रु जीवित
verses.wordMeaning: When she is not guarded, there will arise confusion among
verses.commentary: Sense: When she is not guarded, there will arise confusion among

verses.sanskrit: अभीष्टा कस्यचित् कान्ता कान्तः कस्याश्चिदीप्सितः । परस्परानुरागाढ्यं दाम्पत्यमतिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: abhīṣṭā kasyacit kāntā kāntaḥ kasyāścidīpsitaḥ / parasparānurāgāḍhyaṃ dāmpatyamatidurlabham
verses.translation: Svarga, 0 king. And I may have loss of righteousness fro®
verses.hindi: है तो अब 'हा तात! हा तात!” कहकर बहुत अधिक विलाप करनेसे क्या होगा। इस समय जो करना आवश्यक है, वही मैं करूँगा। उस कायर, पापी एवं दुष्ट दक्षिण-देशनिवासी शत्रुको युद्धमें मारकर सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीका राज्य भोगूँगा। यदि उसे न मार सका तो स्वयं ही अग्निमें प्रवेश कर जाऊँगा। यदि देवराज इन्द्र हाथमें वज्र लिये स्वयं ही इस युद्धमें पधारें,
verses.wordMeaning: Svarga, 0 king. And I may have loss of righteousness fro®
verses.commentary: Sense: Svarga, 0 king. And I may have loss of righteousness fro®

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽयं दयिताभीष्टो ह्येताश्चास्यातिवल्लभाः । परस्परानुरागो हि धन्यानामेव जायते
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'yaṃ dayitābhīṣṭo hyetāścāsyātivallabhāḥ / parasparānurāgo hi dhanyānāmeva jāyate
verses.translation: fall. And in her will be my ofPspring, 0 king. She will give thee the sixth part; she will be a cause of righteousness.
verses.hindi: भयड्कर दण्ड लिये साक्षात् यमराज भी कुपित होकर आ जाये, कुबेर, वरुण और सूर्य भी वपुष्मानकी रक्षाका यत्न करें तो भी मैं अपने तीखे बाणोंसे उसका वध कर डालूँगा। जो नियतात्मा, निर्दोष, वनवासी, अपने-आप गिरे हुए फलका आहार करनेवाले तथा सब प्राणियोंके मित्र थे--ऐसे मेरे पिताकी जिसने मुझ-जैसे शक्तिशाली पुत्रके रहते हुए हिंसा
verses.wordMeaning: fall. And in her will be my ofPspring, 0 king. She will give thee the sixth part; she will be a cause of righteousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: fall. And in her will be my ofPspring, 0 king. She will give thee the sixth part; she will be a cause of righteousness.

verses.sanskrit: एतन्निशम्यवचनं कलहंसीसमीरितम् । उवाच चक्रवाकी तां नातिविस्मितमानसा
verses.transliteration: etanniśamyavacanaṃ kalahaṃsīsamīritam / uvāca cakravākī tāṃ nātivismitamānasā
verses.translation: For that reason I have declared this to thee. Bring back my wife who has been carried off, my lord, since your honour is placed supreme for our protection.
verses.hindi: की है, उसके मांस और रक्तसे आज गृध्र तृप्त हों।'
verses.wordMeaning: For that reason I have declared this to thee. Bring back my wife who has been carried off, my lord, since your honour is placed supreme for our protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: For that reason I have declared this to thee. Bring back my wife who has been carried off, my lord, since your honour is placed supreme for our protection.

verses.sanskrit: नायं धन्यो यतो लज्जा नान्यस्त्रीसन्निकर्षतः । अन्यां स्त्रियमयं भुङ्क्ते न सर्वास्वस्य मानसम्
verses.transliteration: nāyaṃ dhanyo yato lajjā nānyastrīsannikarṣataḥ / anyāṃ striyamayaṃ bhuṅkte na sarvāsvasya mānasam
verses.translation: The king, on hearing him so speak, took thought, and mounted his great chariot which was furnished with every
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार प्रतिज्ञा करके नरिष्यन्तकुमार दमने मन्त्रियों तथा पुरोहितको बुलाकर कहा --'शूद्र तपस्वीने जो समाचार कहा है, उसे आपलोगोंने सुन लिया होगा। पिताजी तो स्वर्गधाममें जा पहुँचे। अब मेरे लिये जो उचित हो, सो बताओ। आज मैं वही करूँगा, जिसके लिये मेरी माताने आज्ञा दी है। हाथी, घोड़े, रथ और पैदलसे युक्त चतुरड्धिणी सेना
verses.wordMeaning: The king, on hearing him so speak, took thought, and mounted his great chariot which was furnished with every
verses.commentary: Sense: The king, on hearing him so speak, took thought, and mounted his great chariot which was furnished with every

verses.sanskrit: चित्तानुराग एकस्मिन्नधिष्ठाने यतः सखि । ततो हि प्रीतिमानेष भार्यासु भविता कथम्
verses.transliteration: cittānurāga ekasminnadhiṣṭhāne yataḥ sakhi / tato hi prītimāneṣa bhāryāsu bhavitā katham
verses.translation: useful requisite. Hither and thither he wandered over the earth with that brahman, and saw a fine hermitage of ascetics
verses.hindi: तैयार करो। पिताके वैरका बदला लिये बिना, पिताके हत्यारेका प्राण लिये बिना तथा माताजीकी आज्ञाका पालन किये बिना मुझे जीवित रहनेका उत्साह नहीं है।” राजाकी यह बात सुनकर खिन्नचित्त हुए मन्त्रियोंने सेवकों और वाहनोंसहित सेनाको कूचके लिये तैयार किया और त्रिकालवैत्ता पुरोहितसे आशीर्वाद ले सब लोग तलवार, शक्ति और ऋष्टि आदि
verses.wordMeaning: useful requisite. Hither and thither he wandered over the earth with that brahman, and saw a fine hermitage of ascetics
verses.commentary: Sense: useful requisite. Hither and thither he wandered over the earth with that brahman, and saw a fine hermitage of ascetics

verses.sanskrit: एता न दयिताः पत्युर्नैतासां दयितः पतिः । विनोदमात्रमेवैता यथा परिजनो ऽपरः
verses.transliteration: etā na dayitāḥ patyurnaitāsāṃ dayitaḥ patiḥ / vinodamātramevaitā yathā parijano 'paraḥ
verses.translation: in a large forest; and alighting there he entered and saw a muni, seated on a silken cushion, and blazing as it were with
verses.hindi: आयुध लिये नगरसे बाहर निकले। महाराज दम नागराजकी भाँति फुफकारते हुए वपुष्मानूकी ओर चले। उन्होंने वपुष्मानके सीमारक्षकों तथा सामन्तोंका वध करते हुए बड़े वेगसे दक्षिण दिशामें चढ़ाई की। संक्रन्दनकुमार वपुष्मान््को यह पता लग गया कि दम
verses.wordMeaning: in a large forest; and alighting there he entered and saw a muni, seated on a silken cushion, and blazing as it were with
verses.commentary: Sense: in a large forest; and alighting there he entered and saw a muni, seated on a silken cushion, and blazing as it were with

verses.sanskrit: एतासाञ्च यदिष्टो ऽयं तत् किं प्राणान्न मुञ्चति । आलिङ्गत्यपरां कान्तां ध्यातो वै कान्तयान्यया
verses.transliteration: etāsāñca yadiṣṭo 'yaṃ tat kiṃ prāṇānna muñcati / āliṅgatyaparāṃ kāntāṃ dhyāto vai kāntayānyayā
verses.translation: splendour. Seeing the king arrived, he rose in haste, and welcoming him with full respect commanded his disciple to
verses.hindi: दल-बलसहित आ रहा है। इससे उसके मनमें तनिक भी भय या कम्प नहीं हुआ। उसने भी अपनी सेनाको युद्धके लिये तैयार होनेका आदेश दिया और नगरसे बाहर निकलकर दमके पास दूत भेजा। दूतने वहाँ जाकर कहा--'क्षत्रियाधम! तू शीघ्रतापूर्वक मेरे समीप आ। नरिष्यन्त अपनी स्त्रीके साथ तेरी प्रतीक्षा करते हैं। मेरी भुजाओंसे छूटे हुए बाण, जो
verses.wordMeaning: splendour. Seeing the king arrived, he rose in haste, and welcoming him with full respect commanded his disciple to
verses.commentary: Sense: splendour. Seeing the king arrived, he rose in haste, and welcoming him with full respect commanded his disciple to

verses.sanskrit: विद्याप्रदानमूल्येन विक्रीतो ह्येष भृत्यवत् । प्रवर्तते न हि प्रेम समं बह्वीषु तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: vidyāpradānamūlyena vikrīto hyeṣa bhṛtyavat / pravartate na hi prema samaṃ bahvīṣu tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: bring the arghya offering. His disciple said to him quietly -"Why should the arghya be given to him, 0 muni? Think well of it and command me, for I carry out thy command.’*
verses.hindi: शानपर चढ़ाकर तीक्ष्ण किये गये हैं, तेरे शरीरमें घुसकर युद्धमें तेरा रक्तपान करेंगे।'
verses.wordMeaning: bring the arghya offering. His disciple said to him quietly -"Why should the arghya be given to him, 0 muni? Think well of it and command me, for I carry out thy command.’*
verses.commentary: Sense: bring the arghya offering. His disciple said to him quietly -"Why should the arghya be given to him, 0 muni? Think well of it and command me, for I carry out thy command.’*

verses.sanskrit: कलहंसि ! पतिर्धन्यो मम धन्याहमेव च । यस्यैकस्याञ्चिरं चित्तं यस्याश्चैकत्र संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kalahaṃsi ! patirdhanyo mama dhanyāhameva ca / yasyaikasyāñciraṃ cittaṃ yasyāścaikatra saṃsthitam
verses.translation: Then the brahman being acquainted with the king’s history, with self-possession did him respect in conversation and by giving him a seat.
verses.hindi: दूतकी कही हुई सारी बातें सुनकर दमने अपनी पूर्वोक्त प्रतिज्ञाका पुनः: स्मरण किया और सर्पकी भाँति फुफकारते हुए वेगसे पैर बढ़ाया। कुण्डिनपुरके पास पहुँचकर दमने वपुष्मानको युद्धके लिये ललकारा। फिर तो दोनोंमें भयड्कर संग्राम छिड़ गया। रथी रथसवारके साथ, हाथीसवार हाथीसवारके साथ और घुड़सवार घुड़सवारके साथ भिड़
verses.wordMeaning: Then the brahman being acquainted with the king’s history, with self-possession did him respect in conversation and by giving him a seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the brahman being acquainted with the king’s history, with self-possession did him respect in conversation and by giving him a seat.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसत्त्वरुतज्ञो ऽसौ स्वरोचिरपराजितः । निशम्य लज्जितो दध्यौ सत्यमेव हि नानृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasattvarutajño 'sau svarociraparājitaḥ / niśamya lajjito dadhyau satyameva hi nānṛtam
verses.translation: Why hast thou come here, Sir; and what dost thou wish lo do? I know thee, 0 king, to be IJttana-pdda’s son Uttama.
verses.hindi: गये। इस प्रकार समस्त देवताओं, सिद्धों और गन्धर्व आदिके देखते-देखते दोनों दलोंमें घमासान युद्ध हुआ। जब दम क्रोधपूर्वक युद्ध करने लगे, उस समय पृथ्वी काँप उठी। कोई हाथीसवार, रथी या घुड़सवार ऐसा नहीं मिला, जो उनका बाण सह सके। तदनन्तर वपुष्मान्का सेनापति दमके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। दमने अपने बाणसे उसकी छातीमें गहरी
verses.wordMeaning: Why hast thou come here, Sir; and what dost thou wish lo do? I know thee, 0 king, to be IJttana-pdda’s son Uttama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why hast thou come here, Sir; and what dost thou wish lo do? I know thee, 0 king, to be IJttana-pdda’s son Uttama.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षशते याते रममाणो महागिरौ । रममाणः समं ताभिर्ददर्श पुरतो मृगम्
verses.transliteration: tato varṣaśate yāte ramamāṇo mahāgirau / ramamāṇaḥ samaṃ tābhirdadarśa purato mṛgam
verses.translation: Enough hast thou had of her, 0 brAhman. I toill give thee another wife. An excellent wife tends to one’s happiness,
verses.hindi: चोट पहुँचायी, जिससे वह गिरकर प्राणोंसे हाथ धो बैठा। सेनाध्यक्षके गिरते ही राजासहित सारी सेनामें भगदड़ पड़ गयी। तब दमने कहा--'ओ दुष्ट! तू मेरे तपस्वी पिताका, जिनके हाथमें कोई शस्त्र नहीं था, अकारण वध करके कहाँ भागा जाता है। यदि क्षत्रिय है तो लौट आ।' तब वपुष्मान् अपने छोटे भाईके साथ लौट आया। साथमें उसके पुत्र, सम्बन्धी तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Enough hast thou had of her, 0 brAhman. I toill give thee another wife. An excellent wife tends to one’s happiness,
verses.commentary: Sense: Enough hast thou had of her, 0 brAhman. I toill give thee another wife. An excellent wife tends to one’s happiness,

verses.sanskrit: सुस्निग्धपीनावयवं मृगयूथविहारिणम् । वासिताभिः सुरूपाभिर्मृगीभिः परिवारितम्
verses.transliteration: susnigdhapīnāvayavaṃ mṛgayūthavihāriṇam / vāsitābhiḥ surūpābhirmṛgībhiḥ parivāritam
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: बन्धु-बान्धव भी थे। वह रथपर आरूढ़ हो दमके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। दम अपने पिताके वधसे कुपित हो रहे थे। उन्होंने वपुष्मानके चलाये हुए समस्त बाणोंको काट डाला और उसके अड्ज-प्रत्यड्षको बींध डाला। फिर एक-एक बाण मारकर उसके सात पुत्रों, भाइयों, सम्बन्धियों तथा मित्रोंको यमराजके घर भेज दिया। पुत्रों और भाइयोंके मारे जानेपर
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्टघ्राणपुटका जिघ्रन्तीस्तास्ततो मृगीः । उवाच स मृगो रामा लज्जात्यागेन गम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣṭaghrāṇapuṭakā jighrantīstāstato mṛgīḥ / uvāca sa mṛgo rāmā lajjātyāgena gamyatām
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: वपुष्मान्को बड़ा क्रोध हुआ और वह सर्पोके समान विषैले बाणोंसे दमके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। दमने उसके बाणोंको काट डाला और उसने भी दमके बाण टुकड़े-टुकड़े कर डाले। दोनों ही अत्यन्त क्रोधमें भरकर एक-दूसरेको मार डालनेकी इच्छासे लड़ रहे थे। परस्परके बाणोंकी चोटसे दोनोंके धनुष कट गये, फिर दोनों तलवार हाथमें लेकर पैंतरे बदलने लगे।
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं स्वरोचिस्तच्छीलो न चैवाहं सुलोचनाः । निर्लज्जा बहवः सन्ति तादृशास्तत्र गच्छतः
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ svarocistacchīlo na caivāhaṃ sulocanāḥ / nirlajjā bahavaḥ santi tādṛśāstatra gacchataḥ
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: दमने क्षणभर अपने मरे हुए पिताका ध्यान किया, फिर दौड़कर वपुष्मान्की चोटी पकड़ ली। तत्पश्चात् उसे धरतीपर पटककर एक पैरसे उसका गला दबा दिया और अपनी भुजा उठाकर कहा--'समस्त देवता, मनुष्य, सिद्ध और नाग देखें, मैं इस नीच क्षत्रिय वपुष्मान्की छाती चीरे डालता हूँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: एका त्वनेकानुगता यथा हासास्पदं जने । अनेकाभिस्तथैवैको बोगदृष्ट्या निरीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: ekā tvanekānugatā yathā hāsāspadaṃ jane / anekābhistathaivaiko bogadṛṣṭyā nirīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: यों कहकर दमने अपनी तलवारसे उसकी छाती चीर डाली। इस प्रकार अपने पिताके वैरका बदला लेकर वे पुनः अपने नगरको लौट आये। सूर्यवंशके राजा ऐसे ही पराक्रमी हुए। इनके अतिरिक्त भी बहुत-से शूरवीर, विद्वान, यज्ञकर्ता और धर्मज्ञ राजा हो गये हैं। वे
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य धर्मक्रियाहानिरहन्यहनि जायते । सक्तो ऽन्यभार्यया चान्यकामासक्तः सदैव सः
verses.transliteration: tasya dharmakriyāhānirahanyahani jāyate / sakto 'nyabhāryayā cānyakāmāsaktaḥ sadaiva saḥ
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: सभी वेदान्तके पारजड्गत पण्डित थे। मैं उनकी संख्या बतलानेमें असमर्थ हूँ। इन सब राजाओंका चरित्र श्रवण करके मनुष्य पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तादृशो ऽन्यस्तच्छीलः परलोकपराङ्मुखः । तं कामयत भद्रं वो नाहं तुल्यः स्वरोचिषा
verses.transliteration: yastādṛśo 'nyastacchīlaḥ paralokaparāṅmukhaḥ / taṃ kāmayata bhadraṃ vo nāhaṃ tulyaḥ svarociṣā
verses.translation: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.hindi: पक्षी कहते हैं--जैमिनिजी! महातपस्वी मार्कण्डेय मुनिने यह सब कथा सुनाकर क्रौष्टकिजीको विदा कर दिया। उसके बाद मध्याह्नकालकी क्रिया सम्पन्न की। महामुने! हमने भी उनसे जो कुछ सुना था, वह सब आपको कह सुनाया। यह अनादिसिद्ध पुराण ब्रह्माजीने पहले मार्कण्डेय मुनिको सुनाया था।
verses.wordMeaning: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: such a one as that is verily a source of pain. Bodily beauty consists in healthfalncss,t 0 brahman, its cause is a noble disposition. She who has neither beauty nor good disposition should bo abandoned for that very reason.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमार्कण्डेयपुराणे स्वारोचिषे मन्वन्तरे पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः æञ्ःâå%>üउ꣡åßञादादनागतम् । यथाहं समतीतञ्च वर्तमानञ्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe svārociṣe manvantare pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ æñḥâå%>üúåßñādādanāgatam / yathāhaṃ samatītañca vartamānañca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Then the king prostrated himself before the great muni, and mounted his chariot, and went to the forest Utpalavata
verses.hindi: वही हमने आपसे कहा है। यह पुण्यमय, पवित्र, आयुवर्धक तथा सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको सिद्ध करनेवाला है। जो इसका पाठ और श्रवण करते हैं, वे सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। आपने प्रारम्भमें जो कई प्रश्न किये थे, उसके उत्तरमें हमने पिता-पुत्र-संवाद, ब्रह्माजीके द्वारा रची हुई सृष्टि, मनुओंकी उत्पत्ति तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Then the king prostrated himself before the great muni, and mounted his chariot, and went to the forest Utpalavata
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the king prostrated himself before the great muni, and mounted his chariot, and went to the forest Utpalavata

verses.transliteration: ālocyājñāpayetyukte tato jñātaṃ mayāpi tat / tato na dattavānarghamahaṃ tubhyaṃ vidhānataḥ

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं राजन् ! त्वमर्घार्हः कुले स्वायम्भुवस्य च । तथापि नार्घयोग्यं त्वां मन्यामो वयमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ rājan ! tvamarghārhaḥ kule svāyambhuvasya ca / tathāpi nārghayogyaṃ tvāṃ manyāmo vayamuttamam
verses.translation: lam daughter of the brdhman Ati-ratra, who dwells in the forest, and wife of Vi^ala’s son whose name thou hast uttered.
verses.hindi: सातवाँ पुराण समझना चाहिए। पहला ब्रह्मपुराण, दूसरा पद्मपुराण, तीसरा
verses.wordMeaning: lam daughter of the brdhman Ati-ratra, who dwells in the forest, and wife of Vi^ala’s son whose name thou hast uttered.
verses.commentary: Sense: lam daughter of the brdhman Ati-ratra, who dwells in the forest, and wife of Vi^ala’s son whose name thou hast uttered.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच किं कृतं हि मया ब्रह्मन् ! ज्ञानादज्ञानतो ऽपि वा । येन त्वत्तोर्ऽघमर्हामि नाहमभ्यागतश्चिरात्
verses.transliteration: rājovāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ hi mayā brahman ! jñānādajñānato 'pi vā / yena tvattor'ghamarhāmi nāhamabhyāgataścirāt
verses.translation: from ray brothers and mother. May that Rakshasa become ashes, by whom I have been parted thus from my mother brothers and other relatives! Here I remain in great affliction. Bringing me to this very dense forest he has cast me off. I know not what is the reason he neither has intercourse with me nor devours me.
verses.hindi: सातवाँ मार्कण्डेयपुराण, आठवाँ अग्निपुराण, नवाँ भविष्यपुराण, दसवाँ ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराण, ग्यारहवाँ नृसिंहपुराण, बारहवाँ वाराहपुराण, तेरहवाँ स्कन्दपुराण, चौदहवाँ वामनपुराण, पंद्रहवाँ कूर्मपुराण, सोलहवाँ मत्स्यपुराण, सत्रहवाँ गरुडपुराण और अठारहवाँ ब्रह्माण्डपुराण माना गया है। जो प्रतिदिन
verses.wordMeaning: from ray brothers and mother. May that Rakshasa become ashes, by whom I have been parted thus from my mother brothers and other relatives! Here I remain in great affliction. Bringing me to this very dense forest he has cast me off.…
verses.commentary: Sense: from ray brothers and mother. May that Rakshasa become ashes, by whom I have been parted thus from my mother brothers and other relatives! Here I remain in great affliction. Bringing me to this very dense forest he has cast me off.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच किं विस्मृतन्ते यत्पत्नी त्वया त्यक्ता च कानने । परित्यक्तस्तया सार्धं त्वया धर्मो नृपाखिलः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiruvāca kiṃ vismṛtante yatpatnī tvayā tyaktā ca kānane / parityaktastayā sārdhaṃ tvayā dharmo nṛpākhilaḥ
verses.translation: Perchance thou knowest, where has the Rakshasa gone after leaving thee? I have been sent here by thy husband indeed, 0 brahman lady.
verses.hindi: अठारह पुराणोंका नाम लेता तथा प्रतिदिन तीनों समय उनका जप करता है, उसे अश्वमेध-यज्ञका फल मिलता है। मार्कण्डेयपुराण चार प्रश्नोंसे युक्त है। इसके श्रवणसे सौ करोड़ कल्पोंके किये हुए पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं। ब्रह्महत्या आदि पाप तथा अन्य अशुभ इसके श्रवणसे उसी प्रकार नष्ट होते हैं, जैसे
verses.wordMeaning: Perchance thou knowest, where has the Rakshasa gone after leaving thee? I have been sent here by thy husband indeed, 0 brahman lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perchance thou knowest, where has the Rakshasa gone after leaving thee? I have been sent here by thy husband indeed, 0 brahman lady.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षेण कर्मणो हान्या प्रयात्यस्पर्शतां नरः । विण्मूत्रैर्वार्षिकी यस्य हानिस्ते नित्यकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: pakṣeṇa karmaṇo hānyā prayātyasparśatāṃ naraḥ / viṇmūtrairvārṣikī yasya hāniste nityakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The night-stalking demon stands at the edge of this ve^ forest. Enter and see him, Sir, if thou dost not fear him. Then he entered by the path that she showed, and saw the
verses.hindi: हवाका झोंका लगनेसे रूई उड़ जाती है। इसके श्रवणसे पुष्करतीर्थमें स्नान करनेका पुण्य प्राप्त होता है।-

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्यानुकूलया भाव्यं यथाशीले ऽपि भर्तरि । दुः शीलापि तथा भार्या पोषणीया नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: patnyānukūlayā bhāvyaṃ yathāśīle 'pi bhartari / duḥ śīlāpi tathā bhāryā poṣaṇīyā nareśvara
verses.translation: That excellent brdhman, learned in spells, keeps on expelling me, when I go to sacrifice after sacrifice, by uttering spells that destroy Rakshasas, 0 king. By reason of his spells and ex- pulsive rites we were a- hungered; whore shall wo go? that inflicted this damage J on him; without a wife a man becomes nntit to perform sacrifices.
verses.hindi: वन्ध्या अथवा मृतवत्सा स्त्री यदि यथावत् इस पुराणका श्रवण करे तो वह समस्त शुभ लक्षणोंसे सम्पन्न पुत्र प्राप्त करती है। इसका श्रवण करनेसे मनुष्य आयु, आरोग्य, ऐश्वर्य, धन, धान्य, पुत्र तथा अक्षय वंश प्राप्त करता है। ब्रह्मन! इस पुराणको पूरा सुन लेनेके बाद जो आवश्यक कर्तव्य है, वह सुनो।
verses.wordMeaning: That excellent brdhman, learned in spells, keeps on expelling me, when I go to sacrifice after sacrifice, by uttering spells that destroy Rakshasas, 0 king. By reason of his spells and ex- pulsive rites we were a- hungered;…
verses.commentary: Sense: That excellent brdhman, learned in spells, keeps on expelling me, when I go to sacrifice after sacrifice, by uttering spells that destroy Rakshasas, 0 king. By reason of his spells and ex- pulsive rites we were a- hungered;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिकूला हि सा पत्नी तस्य विप्रस्य या हृता । तथापि धर्मकामो ऽसौ त्वामुद्योतितवान् नृप
verses.transliteration: pratikūlā hi sā patnī tasya viprasya yā hṛtā / tathāpi dharmakāmo 'sau tvāmudyotitavān nṛpa
verses.translation: Thou hast done me great favour in that thou hast come to my abode here. Give me thy command. What shall I do, such as [ am here? I dwell within thy country. Accept thou this arghya offering, and let this seat be placed for thee. are servants, thou. Sir, art master; command me firmly*
verses.hindi: विधिपूर्वक अग्निकी स्थापना करके विद्वान् पुरुष होम करे; पुराणस्वरूप भगवान् गोविन्दका हृदयकमलमें ध्यान करके गन्ध, पुष्प, माला, वस्त्र तथा

verses.sanskrit: चलतः स्थापयस्यन्यान् स्वधर्मेषु महीपते । त्वां स्वधर्माद्विचलितं को ऽपरः स्थापयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: calataḥ sthāpayasyanyān svadharmeṣu mahīpate / tvāṃ svadharmādvicalitaṃ ko 'paraḥ sthāpayiṣyati
verses.translation: Thou hast done everything, even every rite due to a guest. • Why hast thou brought the bmhman’s wife h&re, 0 night-

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् ! केन नीता सा पत्नी विप्रस्य कुत्र वा । अतीतानागतं वेत्ति जगत्यवितथं भवान्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan ! kena nītā sā patnī viprasya kutra vā / atītānāgataṃ vetti jagatyavitathaṃ bhavān
verses.translation: consume the natural disposition of men and women, being treated with disrespect, and yet honoured; we are not eaters
verses.hindi: आदिसहित शगय्या, जूता, कमण्डलु, सोनेकी अँगूठी, सप्तधान्य, भोजनके लिये काँसेकी थाली और घृतपात्र दान करे। ऐसा करनेसे मनुष्य कृतकृत्य हो जाता है। जो उत्तम विधिके साथ इसका श्रवण करता है, वह हजार अश्वमेध और सौ राजसूय-यज्ञोंका फल पाता है। उसे न यमराजसे भय होता है न नरकोंसे। वह
verses.wordMeaning: consume the natural disposition of men and women, being treated with disrespect, and yet honoured; we are not eaters
verses.commentary: Sense: consume the natural disposition of men and women, being treated with disrespect, and yet honoured; we are not eaters

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच तां जहाराद्रितनयो बलाको नाम राक्षसः । द्रक्ष्यसे चाद्य तां भूप ! उत्पलावतके वने
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiruvāca tāṃ jahārādritanayo balāko nāma rākṣasaḥ / drakṣyase cādya tāṃ bhūpa ! utpalāvatake vane
verses.translation: of living creatures. When we have eaten the patience of men, they become enraged; and when we have eaten their evil nature, they also become virtuous. We have Rakshasis who are fascinating, rivalling the Apsarases in beauty, 0 king; while they are with us, how should we delight in
verses.hindi: मनुष्य सब पापोंसे मुक्त होकर कृतार्थ हो जाता है। इस पृथ्वीपर उसकी वंश- परम्परा सदा कायम रहती है तथा वह इन्द्रलोक एवं सनातन ब्रह्मलोकमें जाता है। वहाँसे पुन: च्युत होकर मनुष्य-योनिमें उसे नहीं आना पड़ता।
verses.wordMeaning: of living creatures. When we have eaten the patience of men, they become enraged; and when we have eaten their evil nature, they also become virtuous. We have Rakshasis who are fascinating, rivalling the Apsarases in beauty, 0 king; while they are with us,…
verses.commentary: Sense: of living creatures. When we have eaten the patience of men, they become enraged; and when we have eaten their evil nature, they also become virtuous. We have Rakshasis who are fascinating, rivalling the Apsarases in beauty, 0 king; while they are with us,…

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ संयोजयाशु त्वं भार्यया हि द्विजात्तमम् । मा पापास्पदतां यातु त्वमिवासौ दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: gaccha saṃyojayāśu tvaṃ bhāryayā hi dvijāttamam / mā pāpāspadatāṃ yātu tvamivāsau dine dine
verses.translation: If she is not for sensual enjoyment nor for food, 0 night- roamer, why then didst thou enter the brahman’s house and carry her off?
verses.hindi: इस पुराणके श्रवणसे ही मनुष्य परम योग प्राप्त कर लेता है। नास्तिक, वेदनिन्दक शाद्र, गुरुद्रोही, व्रत-भंग करनेवाले, माता-पिताके त्यागी, सुवर्णचोर, मर्यादा भंग करनेवाले तथा जातिको कलड्कित करनेवाले पुरुषोंको प्राण कण्ठमें आ जायेँ तो भी इस पुराणका उपदेश नहीं देना चाहिए। यदि लोभ, मोह
verses.wordMeaning: If she is not for sensual enjoyment nor for food, 0 night- roamer, why then didst thou enter the brahman’s house and carry her off?
verses.commentary: Sense: If she is not for sensual enjoyment nor for food, 0 night- roamer, why then didst thou enter the brahman’s house and carry her off?

verses.transliteration: iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe auttamamanvantare ekonasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ saptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ- 70 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca athāruroha svarathaṃ praṇipatya mahāmunim / tenākhyātaṃ vanantacca prayayāvutpalāvatam
verses.translation: There lived on the earth a famous king, by name Sva- rash^ra, valiant, an offerer of many sacrifices, wise, invincihio
verses.hindi: अथवा विशेषत: भयके कारण कोई उक्त मनुष्योंको यह पुराण सुनाता अथवा पढ़ाता है तो वह निश्चय ही नरकमें पड़ता है।-
verses.wordMeaning: There lived on the earth a famous king, by name Sva- rash^ra, valiant, an offerer of many sacrifices, wise, invincihio
verses.commentary: Sense: There lived on the earth a famous king, by name Sva- rash^ra, valiant, an offerer of many sacrifices, wise, invincihio

verses.sanskrit: यथाख्यातस्वरूपाञ्च भार्यां भर्त्रा द्विजस्य ताम् । भक्षयन्तीं ददार्शाथ श्रीफलानि नरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yathākhyātasvarūpāñca bhāryāṃ bhartrā dvijasya tām / bhakṣayantīṃ dadārśātha śrīphalāni nareśvaraḥ

verses.hindi: जैमिनि बोले--'पक्षियो! महाभारतमें मेरे जिस सन्देहका निवारण नहीं हो सका, उसका निवारण आपलोगोंने मित्रभावसे किया है; ऐसा दूसरा कौन करेगा। आपलोग दीर्घायु, नीरोग तथा उत्तम वृत्तिसे युक्त हों। सांख्ययोगमें आपकी बुद्धि अविचलभावसे स्थित रहे। पिताके शापजनित दोषसे जो आपके

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्युवाच सुताहमतिरात्रस्य द्विजस्य वनवासिनः । पत्नी विशालपुत्रस्य यस्य नाम त्वयोदितम्

verses.translation: and people came to their end. And he, being bereft* * * § of his wives and his servants who were his equals in age, was dejected in mind atid dwindled in vigour day and night.

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇyuvāca asyaiva kānanasyānte sa tiṣṭhati niśācaraḥ / praviśya paśyatu bhavān na bibheti tato yadi
